title: Childfree – Ein pro-choice Rollenspiel
content:
Childfree ist ein LARP darüber, dass dein Körper nur dir gehört. Darüber, sich zu ermächtigen, lebensverändernde Entscheidungen zu treffen und den eigenen Träumen und Projekten zu folgen. Es ist ein LARP über die Entscheidung, eine Schwangerschaft abzubrechen.


Es ist uns eine große Freude, unsere Ausgabe des Rollenspiels „childfree“ von Axiel Cazeneuve vorstellen zu dürfen. Wir hatten dieses Spiel im Jahr 2023 auf Französisch und Englisch herausgebracht. Zwei Jahre später haben unsere Freund*innen von

LarpPunk

 es ins Polnische übersetzt, und nun hat das autonome Gesundheitskollektiv Geko aus Bern es ins Deutsche übersetzt.


Die Möglichkeit, frei über den eigenen Körper zu verfügen, ist nach wie vor ein umkämpftes Thema – und wird es wahrscheinlich auch bleiben, solange Einzelpersonen, Institutionen oder Nationen sich die Macht über andere anmaßen. Mit dieser Neuauflage möchten wir uns solidarisch mit all jenen zeigen, die für den freien Zugang zu Schwangerschaftsabbrüchen kämpfen, sei es durch den Kampf gegen

Abtreibungsgesetze in Polen

 oder durch die Entwicklung von I

T-Sicherheitstools zum Schutz von Pro-Choice-Aktivist*innen in Brasilien

.


Wie alle unsere anderen Produktionen kann „Childfree“ zum freien Preis bestellt werden, und eine PDF-Version steht auf unserer Website kostenlos zur Verfügung. Um das Spiel in gedruckter Form zu bestellen oder bei der Verbreitung und Übersetzung dieses Spiels mitzuhelfen, kontaktiere uns bitte unter evasions@riseup.net.


Einleitung Von Axiel


„Childfree“ ist ein Live-Action-Rollenspiel – die Teilnehmenden schlüpfen physisch in Rollen, um gemeinsam eine Geschichte zu erzählen, ohne dass ein Publikum anwesend ist – für 5 bis 7 Personen, das in insgesamt vier Stunden gespielt wird. Es befasst sich mit Abtreibung, genauer gesagt mit dem freiwilligen Schwangerschaftsabbruch und bietet den Spielerinnen die Möglichkeit, einerseits die gesellschaftlichen Zwänge im Zusammenhang mit Schwangerschaft oder Abtreibung und andererseits die Individualität der schwangeren Person zu verkörpern. Der flexible und nicht-direktive Rahmen des Spiels ermöglicht es den Spielerinnen, verschiedene Situationen zu entwerfen und vorzuschlagen. Das Geschlecht der schwangeren Person, die Details ihres Lebens, der rechtliche Kontext … all dies bleibt ganz den Spielenden überlassen, die dabei durch die Spielunterlagen unterstützt werden, die so klar und einfach wie möglich gehalten sind. Die Entscheidung, die Schwangerschaft abzubrechen oder fortzusetzen, liegt natürlich ebenfalls bei der schwangeren Rolle (und somit bei der Person, die sie spielt). Indem ich eine Erfahrung biete, die vollständig von den Teilnehmenden gemeinsam gestaltet wird, wollte ich ein wenig von dem weitergeben, was ich durch einen freiwilligen Schwangerschaftsabbruch gelernt habe, sowie das Gefühl der Befreiung, das damit einherging.


Ich habe dieses Spiel 2018 geschrieben: Anlässlich der Veröffentlichung der Ausgabe durch Projet Évasions möchte ich auf meine persönliche Erfahrung zurückblicken und darauf, was mich zum Schreiben motiviert hat.


Ein Spiel mit wunderschönen Illustrationen von Nemo


Erfahrungen mit einer freiwilligen Schwangerschaftsunterbrechung in Frankreich im Jahr 2017


Anfang 2017 blieb meine Periode eine Woche aus. Da das ungewöhnlich war und ich zudem starke Schmerzen im unteren Rücken und in der Brust hatte, ging ich los, um einen Schwangerschaftstest zu kaufen. (Auf dem Weg dorthin machte ich einen Abstecher in den Laden um die Ecke, weil ich Heißhunger auf Fruchtgelee hatte. Als ich die einsame Pappschachtel auf dem Förderband vorbeiziehen sah, fragte ich mich, ob es sich wirklich lohnte, den Test zu machen).


Natürlich war das Testergebnis positiv. Als ich die beiden Striche erscheinen sah, versuchte ich zu weinen. Ähm … Nein, das klappt nicht. Ich versuchte zu lachen. Nein. Also griff ich zum Telefon – es war, glaube ich, ein Montag, gegen Mittag – und rief beim „Planning Familial“ an (ein Netzwerk aus Vereinen und aktivistischen Gruppen, das in Frankreich Dienstleistungen im Bereich der sexuellen Gesundheit anbietet). Folgendes habe ich wörtlich gesagt:


– „Hallo, ich habe mir vor neun Monaten bei Ihnen eine Spirale einsetzen lassen, ich habe gerade einen Schwangerschaftstest gemacht und er ist positiv.


Stille.


– Oh Scheiße. Können Sie in zwanzig Minuten vorbeikommen?“


Ich sprang in mein Auto, das mein Partner fuhr, und innerhalb einer halben Stunde waren wir im Planing-Familial 31 …

title: ExisTransInter 2026
content:
Appel de l'

interorga de l'ExisTransInter

 pour l'édition 2026 : rendez-vous vendredi 16 octobre à 19h devant Gare de l'Est à Paris


L'autodétermination au pouvoir


Vendredi 16 octobre à 19h à gare de l'Est

, l'ExisTransInter réunira

les personnes intersexes, les personnes trans, et leurs allié·es

. Notre histoire commune est faite d'entraide et de transmission, de lutte et de résistance, de victoires arrachées. En 2016, nous réclamions déjà le changement d'état civil libre et gratuit, le libre choix des parcours médicaux, l'arrêt des mutilations des enfants intersexes, la reconnaissance de droit pour les personnes migrantes et les travailleur·euses du sexe (

TDS

). Dix ans plus tard, et en l'absence affligeante d'avancées majeures sur ces sujets, notre détermination reste intacte et sans concession. Nous ne voulons plus d'une société où l'accès au droit, au soin, au logement, dépendent de notre conformité aux normes cis et dyadiques –- pas plus que de notre classe sociale, de notre pratique du

TDS

, de nos origines, de notre validité ou de nos titres de séjour.


Dans un contexte politique particulièrement menaçant, nous refusons plus que jamais la réduction de nos vies à des controverses médiatiques, à des paniques morales, à des cases administratives. Nous refusons d'être les boucs émissaires de cel·leux qui alimentent la peur et la haine des minorités.

Nos luttes sont antifascistes, anti-impérialistes, anti-coloniales

. Elle sont, en cela, indissociables de celles des peuples palestinien, congolais, soudanais et iranien.


Enfant·es ou adultes, nos corps nous appartiennent


Nos luttes sont indissociables des luttes féministes et enfantistes

. En ce sens, nous défendons l'autonomie corporelle de tous·tes les enfant·es, dont les droits fondamentaux ne commencent pas à la majorité. De la naissance à l'adolescence, les jeunes sont des personnes, et doivent être écouté·es avant tout.


Tout en prétendant protéger les enfants, les mouvements réactionnaires internationaux continuent les mutilations des enfant·es intersexes, dont le corps doit être “normalisé”. L'extrême-droite et ses lobbies alimentent ainsi un continuum de violences (familiales, sociales, physiques, sexuelles) qui doit absolument cesser. Ils privent les enfant·es trans de soin, violentent les enfants racisé·es, invisibilisent cel·leux qui, en ce moment même, meurent sous des génocides.


Peu importent les rapports, les promesses et les demi-mesures partisanes : les mutilations des enfants inters doivent cesser, et leurs droits doivent être protégés avant 2027. Nous soutenons, en cela, les

propositions de loi n° 1914 et n° 2286

. Un rassemblement pour le droit des personnes inters aura lieu

le 7 novembre à 15h, place Stravinsky

.


La Haute Autorité de Santé (

HAS

) a entamé, en 2026, l'élaboration de recommandations spécifiques sur l'accompagnement des mineur·es trans, dont la publication est prévue pour 2027. Nous condamnons fermement l'exclusion des associations d'auto-support, aux côtés des mineur·es trans et inters depuis des années, de ce processus. Nos savoirs expérientiels doivent être au centre de ces travaux, et le lobbying réactionnaire n'a rien à faire dans un travail scientifique.


Les personnes transinters existent

 

!


Les personnes intersexes représentent environ 13 000 naissances par an. Leurs corps sont en dehors de la binarité des sexes, mais on les assigne malgré tout à un sexe et à un genre à la naissance. Un récent rapport européen montre que 6

3% des personnes inters se déclarent sur le spectre trans/non-binaire

, donc en dehors du genre qui leur a été assigné à la naissance. La panique morale exercée par les réactionnaires à l'encontre des mouvements trans, qui “mutileraient des enfant·es” est hypocrite : ce sont el·leux qui mutilent les enfant·es inters. Les enfant·es transinters subissent ainsi une

double transition forcée

, dans leur chair et dans leur genre. Le rapport indique aussi que

44% des personnes inters estiment avoir subi une thérapie de conversion en France

. Ainsi, pour nombre d'entre nous, le parcours de transition, choisi à l'âge adulte, représente une forme de réparation de nos corps.


Le sexe, tout autant que le genre, est une construction sociale qui, factuellement, n'a rien de binaire. Un des piliers de la transphobie est la haine envers les personnes sortant de la binarité des sexes, d'où l'animosité féroce des réactionnaires, à international, envers la non-binarité. Nous …

author: anred
title: Histórico: Buenos Aires será la sede del 40° Encuentro Plurinacional en 2027
content:
Tras cuatro décadas de recorrido federal y de manera ininterrumpida, el máximo evento de los feminismos y las disidencias regresa al territorio donde nació en 1986. La elección se realizó mediante el tradicional «aplausómetro» durante el cierre de la edición número 39 en Córdoba.

Por ANRed

 


CÓRDOBA — En una jornada cargada de mística, debate y organización colectiva, la Comisión Organizadora del 39° Encuentro Plurinacional de Mujeres, Lesbianas, Travestis, Trans, Bisexuales, Intersexuales y No Binaries anunció que la Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires albergará la próxima edición del evento en 2027. La decisión se tomó a través del histórico sistema de «aplausómetro», el mecanismo asambleario y masivo con el que este espacio federal define democráticamente sus destinos año tras año. Tras la elección de la sede, se procedió a la lectura de las conclusiones de los más de 100 talleres que funcionaron durante el fin de semana.


Este regreso a las callee porteñas tiene una profunda carga simbólica y política. La última vez que el Encuentro se realizó en Buenos Aires fue en su edición fundacional de 1986. En aquel momento, apenas unas 600 mujeres provenientes de diferentes provincias y de diversas comunidades de pueblos originarios se congregaron para sembrar la semilla de una experiencia asamblearia y colectiva que terminaría transformando por completo la historia de los feminismos en la Argentina.


Cuarenta años después de aquella primera convocatoria, el espacio se ha masificado, transformado y complejizado. Con la única y lógica excepción del parate obligado por la pandemia de COVID-19, los Encuentros se sostuvieron de forma ininterrumpida durante cuatro décadas. Su persistencia en el tiempo consolida un formato único en el mundo: un espacio completamente autónomo de los gobiernos y los partidos, federal, plural, autofinanciado y autoconvocado que sirve como usina de organización, debate y posterior lucha en las calles.


De cara al próximo año, el desafío se traslada al centro político del país. En un contexto que demanda la articulación constante frente a las violencias y opresiones, el 40° Encuentro Plurinacional abrirá un nuevo capítulo en Buenos Aires con el objetivo de seguir reconociendo diversidades, compartiendo experiencias desde los territorios y fortaleciendo el tejido social hacia una comunidad más justa e igualitaria.


Todo en pleno año electoral, en el marco de una profunda crisis política social y cultural, en el gobierno de la Libertad Avanza. «Vamos a Buenos Aires a sacar a Milei, contra todos los fascismos. Seremos Nostres quienes les pongamos un freno a estas politicas de precarización de nuestras vidas» cerro una encuentrera.

author: Mike Ludwig
title: In Virginia, Racism and Redlining Are Fueling a Flock Camera Backlash
content:
Police in Hampton Roads saturated Black and low-income neighborhoods with Flock-style cameras, a study found.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

Local governments in Virginia are under mounting pressure to cancel contracts for surveillance cameras known as automated license plate readers (ALPRs). On October 6, the Henrico County Police Division announced that it would terminate its contract for such cameras after residents shared “legitimate concerns about Flock Safety.” In nearby Richmond, Mayor Danny Avula said on October 13 that the city would cancel its contract with Flock Safety, the most famous purveyor of the cameras, but did not rule out using ALPRs from a different company.

“It is a good first step, but we do need to keep the pressure on the city to not automatically switch to another ALPR vendor,” Richmond Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) member Victoria McCullough told Truthout.

DSA activists and residents in Richmond pushing police to ditch the contract have powerful research to point to from elsewhere in the state. In the neighboring Hampton Roads region of Virginia, race and class are the primary predictors of locations where police installed ALPRs, a groundbreaking study found earlier this year.

The study found police were more likely to install ALPRs in majority Black census tracts in each of the nine cities across the Hampton Roads region, an East Coast metroplex with 1.8 million residents and multiple cities, including Norfolk and Virginia Beach. About 80 percent of majority Black neighborhoods contain at least one camera compared to fewer than 40 percent of majority white tracts. ALPR surveillance is also more intense in majority Black neighborhoods, where on average there are four times as many cameras than in white neighborhoods when weighted for population share.

In Virginia Beach, police deployed ALPRs in only five of 76 majority white census tracts (6.6 percent), compared to one of two Black census tracts (50 percent). Black residents of the locality are 7.6 times more likely than white residents to live in a census tract with at least one ALPR. When weighted for the number of cameras deployed in each area, Black drivers in Virginia Beach were roughly eight times more likely than white drivers to be regularly surveilled by Flock-style cameras.

Published in January 2026, the study found a “similarly consistent pattern of disproportionate camera coverage” in low-income areas and concluded that ALPR deployment in Hampton Roads follows historical patterns of housing discrimination, racist segregation, and disinvestment. In other words, police have deployed the cameras so Black and lower-income people are more likely to live under high-tech, AI-powered traffic surveillance than whiter, wealthier people.

Dr. Steven Keener is a co-author of the study and director of the Center for Crime, Equity and Justice Research at Christopher Newport University. He pointed to Norfolk State University in Norfolk, one of only five historically Black colleges and universities (HBCUs) in Virginia, as an example of the increased surveillance presence. The area in and around the university is heavily saturated with Flock brand ALPR cameras, compared to whiter and higher-income areas of Norfolk, the study found.

“The census tract with the most ALPR cameras surrounds Norfolk State, which is the only public HBCU in the region,” Keener told Truthout in an interview. “The cameras completely encircle the campus, so you can’t enter or exit in a vehicle without being surveilled.”

Of the census tracts with the highest number of ALPRs, nine are located in Norfolk, where the cameras are concentrated in historically Black neighborhoods and near public housing. The ALPR data used in the study was only available because a federal judge ordered police to release the records in November 2025 as part of a privacy rights lawsuit filed by two residents of Norfolk. Keener’s team used the data to map out ALPR locations across Hampton Roads and compare the results to Census data on race and income.

“Economic and social policy failures have led to your life being constantly surveilled,” Keener said of lower-income and Black communities. “They’re still doing racialized surveillance and policing, but instead of having an officer on the corner, they are watching you to criminalize your behavior based on where you …

title: Irkçı Le Pen'den Türkiye'ye AB desteğini kesme çağrısı
content:
Fransa’da ırkçı Ulusal Birlik Partisi’nin lideri Marine Le Pen, 15 Ekim’de Brüksel’de düzenlenen Avrupa Birliği liderler zirvesi öncesinde yaptığı açıklamada, Türkiye’ye yönelik AB politikalarının sona erdirilmesini istedi.

Euronews’ün haberine göre Le Pen, Türkiye’ye sağlanan mali desteğin yanı sıra üyelik öncesi politikaların ve kalkınma programlarının da bitirilmesi gerektiğini savundu.

Le Pen, “Üyelik öncesi politikalar, Türkiye’ye destek ve kalkınma programları sona ermeli” ifadelerini kullandı.

Le Pen, açıklamasında Avrupa Komisyonu’nun mevcut yetkilerini de hedef aldı. Komisyonun yetki alanını aştığını öne süren ırkçı lider, kurumun rolünün üye ülkelere hizmet veren bir sekretaryayla sınırlandırılması gerektiğini savundu.

Sağlık ve iç güvenlik gibi alanlarda Komisyonun kendi yetki sınırlarının dışına çıktığını ileri süren Le Pen, Avrupa Birliği’nin ortak karar mekanizmalarının ulusal egemenlikleri zayıflattığını iddia etti.

Avrupa’nın ulusal egemenliklerini koruması, sınır güvenliğini sağlaması ve bağımsız hareket edebilmesi gerektiğini söyleyen Le Pen, mevcut AB politikalarının bu hedefleri karşılamadığını ileri sürdü.

Fransa’nın AB kurumlarının diplomasi, askeri konular ve istihbarat alanlarında daha fazla yetki üstlenmesini kabul etmeyeceğini belirten Le Pen’in açıklamaları, Avrupa Birliği’nin yetki alanı ve Türkiye ile ilişkiler konusunda aşırı sağın yaklaşımını bir kez daha gündeme taşıdı.

Le Pen’in çağrısı, Türkiye’nin AB üyelik süreci ve Birlik tarafından sağlanan mali desteklerin geleceğine ilişkin siyasi tartışmaların sürdüğü bir dönemde geldi.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Le massacre du 17 octobre 1961 à Paris : « ici on noie les Algériens ! »
content:
Ce jour-là, des dizaines d'Algériens ont été noyés dans la Seine ou massacrés par la police française à Paris. C'est un devoir de justice de ne pas l'oublier. Le 17 octobre 1961 alors que la guerre d'Algérie touche à sa fin, le

FLN

 appelle à une manifestation pacifique dans les rues de Paris pour dénoncer le couvre-feu raciste imposé quelques jours plus tôt aux Algériens et par extension à tous les Maghrébins (obligation d'être sans cesse isolé, et interdiction aux travailleurs algériens de sortir de 20h30 à 5h30, les cafés tenus par des musulmans doivent fermer à 19h...). Cette manifestation rassemble environ 30.000 personnes.


Début de la manifestation pacifique le 17 octobre 1961 à Paris


Le préfet de police de Paris, Maurice Papon, qui a reçu carte blanche des plus hautes autorités, dont de Gaulle, lance, avec 7.000 policiers, une répression sanglante. Il y aura 11.730 arrestations, et peut-être beaucoup plus de 200 morts, noyés ou exécutés, parmi les Algériens.


Ce crime au coeur de l'État français n'a toujours pas été reconnu officiellement alors même que les partisans de la Nostalgérie prônent la promotion de l'oeuvre positive française durant la colonisation dans les programmes scolaires

 

!!!


Le 27 octobre 1961, Claude Bourdet, alors conseiller municipal de Paris et aussi journaliste à "France-Observateur", avait interpellé le préfet de police, Maurice Papon, en plein conseil municipal de Paris sur l'exactitude des faits qui se lisaient dans la presse parisienne, à savoir le repêchage dans la Seine de 150 cadavres d'Algériens depuis le 17 octobre 1961 entre Paris et Rouen.


«

 

Monsieur le Préfet de Police

 

»


Intervention de Claude Bourdet au Conseil municipal de Paris, le 27 octobre 1961


- Les silences de Monsieur Maurice Papon


Claude Bourdet


«

 

J'en viens d'abord aux faits. Il n'est guère besoin de s'étendre. Parlerai-je de ces Algériens couchés sur le trottoir, baignant dans le sang, morts ou mourants, auxquels la Police interdisait qu'on porte secours

 

? Parlerai-je de cette femme enceinte, près de la place de la République, qu'un policier frappait sur le ventre

 

? Parlerai-je de ces cars que l'on vidait devant un commissariat du quartier Latin, en forçant les Algériens qui en sortaient à défiler sous une véritable haie d'honneur, sous des matraques qui s'abattaient sur eux à mesure qu'ils sortaient

 

? J'ai des témoignages de Français et des témoignages de journalistes étrangers. Parlerai-je de cet Algérien interpellé dans le métro et qui portait un enfant dans ses bras

 

? Comme il ne levait pas les bras assez vite, on l'a presque jeté à terre d'une paire de gifles. Ce n'est pas très grave, c'est simplement un enfant qui est marqué à vie

 

!


Je veux seulement mentionner les faits les plus graves et poser des questions. Il s'agit de faits qui, s'ils sont vérifiés, ne peuvent pas s'expliquer par une réaction de violence dans le feu de l'action. Ce sont des faits qui méritent une investigation sérieuse, détaillée, impartiale, contradictoire.


D'abord, est-il vrai qu'au cours de cette journée, il n'y ait pas eu de blessés par balle au sein de la Police

 

? Est-il vrai que les cars radio de la Police aient annoncé au début de la manifestation dix morts parmi les forces de l'ordre, message nécessairement capté par l'ensemble des brigades... et qui devait donc exciter au plus haut point l'ensemble des policiers

 

? C'était peut-être une erreur, c'était peut-être un sabotage, il faudrait le savoir

 

; et peut-être, d'autre part, n'était-ce pas vrai. C'est pour cela que je veux une enquête.


Photo d'Elie Kagan prise le 17 octobre 1961


De même, est-il vrai qu'un grand nombre des blessés ou des morts ont été atteints par des balles du même calibre que celui d'une grande manufacture qui fournit l'armement de la Police

 

? Qu'une grande partie de ces balles ont été tirées à bout portant

 

? Une enquête dans les hôpitaux peut donner ces renseignements. Il est clair que ce n'est pas n'importe quelle enquête et que ceux qui la feraient devraient être couverts par son caractère officiel et savoir qu'ils ne risqueraient rien en disant la vérité.


De même, est-il vrai qu'un grand nombre des blessés ou des morts ont été atteints par des balles du même calibre que celui d'une grande manufacture qui fournit l'armement de la Police

author: Binoy Kampmark
title: Sportswashing the Racing Circuit: Rwanda and Formula One
content:
Tyrants and demagogues love sports and the governing bodies that preside over them. Despite strictures, injunctions and warnings about dealing with unsavoury regimes, a sporting body or organisation can always be relied on to ignore the fine print of their charters and make a dash for the revenue till. While the candidates for such a list are long – the International Olympic Committee and the world footballing body FIFA figure with amoral sprightliness in that regard – Formula One (F1) has shown itself to be most promiscuous.

In its October 13 statement, FI glows with the announcement that motor racing will “return to Africa for the first time since 1993.” Then, the apartheid government of South Africa, one nearing expiration, still offered their good services to F1 to run the tournament as part of a controversial tradition. (The South African Grand Prix had been something of a fixture since the 1960s, barring the interrupting hiccup in the latter 1980s.) In a ten-year agreement with the Rwandan government, the Formula 1 African Grand Prix will become a part of the racing calendar in the early 2030s, beginning its first race at the still to be completed Bugesera circuit. “The new track will be developed to FIA Grade 1 standards as part of a wider sports, tourism, infrastructure, and commercial development project led by the Rwanda Development Board.”

The language of the announcement resembles the best traditions of sporting colonialism on the hunt for willing consumers. “Africa represents one of the most exciting growth opportunities for the sport, with more than 100 million fans already following F1 across the continent, and almost 60% of fans in key Sub-Saharan African Markets under the age of 35.” The project is celebrated as beneficial with its promise of creating “a legacy of supporting tourism, attracting investment, developing local talent and creating new opportunities for communities and businesses.”

F1 also praises Rwanda for its appeal “as one of Africa’s leading destinations for international events, successfully hosting major sport and global gatherings”. These include, amongst others, the UCI Road World Championships, the ICC Women’s Challenge Trophy, the 2023 FIFA Congress and the Basketball Africa League.

The Rwandan President, Paul Kagame, heaped praise on the project. As is a tendency befalling many African leaders, the decision of one country is treated as having been made for the benefit of an entire, neglected continent. “Today belongs to Africa. For more than three decades, the world’s premier motorsport championship has raced without this continent, and that changes with this agreement.”

What, then is there not to like? The answer: much and more besides. For one thing, the motorsport body, despite stipulating the need to respect “internationally recognised human rights in its operations globally” in its own charter, has decided to overlook the distinct unpleasantness of the Kagame regime, one not above using arbitrary detention, torture and stomping on free speech. In its 2026 accounting of the country’s human rights record, Human Rights Watch (HRW) notes continued attacks on freedom of expression and association, including the arrest of Victore Ingabire in June of the unregistered opposition party Development and Liberty for All (DALFA-Umurinzi). Among the charges she faces are forming a criminal group and planning activities with the purpose of inciting public disorder. HRW also notes a lack of progress in investigating the “suspicious deaths of disappearance of critics, journalists, and opposition activists.” Kigali’s spotty record on protecting refugee and migrant rights is reiterated. In terms of foreign policies, a stern eye is trained on the ongoing support for the notorious M23 armed group in eastern Congo, responsible for “mass summary executions, arbitrary detention, torture, forced labor, forced recruitment including child recruitment, forced deportations, sexual violence, and intimidation of journalists and activists.”

In June, the Democratic Republic of Congo filed a case against Rwanda in the International Court of Justice concerning “abuses attributable to Rwanda over a period extending from 1996 to the present day”. author: Ash Sarkar
title: A Motion, a Meltdown, and an Andy Burnham-Shaped Opportunity
content:
They’re calling it the E motion heard around the world, as the fallout continues from the Green party’s ‘Zionism is Racism’ policy, passed at its conference earlier this month.


The motion has dominated the headlines since making it onto the agenda for autumn conference, eclipsing what the leadership had hoped would be the party’s trademark rent controls policy. It kicked off a briefing war, led by GPEW stalwart and second referendum-enthusiast Caroline Lucas. It also prompted 

pointed queries

 from the Equalities and Human Rights Commission.


And now, unwilling to let a good crisis pass him by, prime minister Andy Burnham has piled in, 

ruling out any future coalition

 with the Greens while the policy remains in place. Supporters of the motion may greet this news as a strategic win – distance from Labour cements the Greens’ status as an insurgent, anti-establishment force. But there are rumblings of discontent amongst parts of the Green party of England and Wales.


It’s no secret that Zack Polanski (while publicly supportive of the argument that Israel’s displacement of, and genocide against, the Palestinians is the result of racist ideology) needed this motion like he needed a hole in the head. He was careful to neither unequivocally back nor deride the motion, and warned that it may “create a distraction” by putting Green members and pro-Palestine activists in a position of being attacked.


Whatever the virtues of the motion were, and still might be, Polanski was proved right on this latter point. The days leading up to his unsuccessful attempt to become the MP for Holborn and St Pancras were a storm of negative media coverage, in which he was forced to defend his party against accusations of being a threat to Jewish people. It would be wrong to characterise the byelection loss as a direct result of the ‘Zionism is Racism’ motion. But it didn’t exactly help his efforts to get elected either.


What followed were the first stirrings of Green infighting. For those steeped in the factional bloodletting of Labour party politics, this is all fairly tame stuff: Lucas, the night of the count, 

failing to shut down talk

 of Polanski stepping down, Ellie Chowns 

calling on her leader to “step up”

. But while the Greens might put the ‘civil’ in civil war, this level of publicly-litigated internal division is new for the party.


What’s more, local Green parties and councils have had to manage the reactions of a significant number of Jewish residents and organisations. Haringey council, led by the Greens, found its attempts at overture 

knocked back

 by one local synagogue. “We take it from both the tone and the content of your email that you are deeply embarrassed with the decision taken by your party,” wrote Highgate United Synagogue. “[Your] embarrassment is not enough. If you really want us to feel you do not agree with the racist and genocidal implications of your party’s policy, the least we can expect is for you to publicly resile yourself from that policy and commit yourself and your party colleagues to reverse that policy.”


Enter one Andrew Burnham. Though the early months of his premiership have been marked by his attempts to mend fences with voters alienated from Labour by the party’s moral turpitude on Palestine, the temptation to kick his progressive rivals while they’re down was seemingly too much to resist.


Condemning the motion in the House of Commons at this week’s PMQs, 

Burnham thundered

: “It is wrong, it is antisemitic, and this side of the House will have nothing to do with it.” Polanski, in a statement, hit back, pointing out that he’s the only Jewish leader of a political party and himself a victim of antisemitism – while the prime minister “arms a genocide and locks pensioners up for opposing it”.


Westminster grandstanding has since filtered down to local governance. Yesterday, Labour issued an ultimatum, saying it would scrap any power-sharing deals with Greens in local authorities unless local Green electeds reject the ‘Zionism is Racism’ motion passed by members at conference. According to the New Statesman, such agreements prop up 

more than a dozen local authorities

, including in Bristol. Nice gauntlet you’ve got there, shame if anyone threw it.


Perhaps Alanis Morissette might have something to say about a devolution-loving prime minister imposing the will of the Westminster government on local authorities the minute he thinks it’s advantageous to do so. It’s worth …

author: Marcelo Oliveira
title: Mulheres são maioria das vítimas de violência política, mesmo sendo minoria das candidatas
content:
O primeiro turno da campanha eleitoral de 2026 durou 50 dias e registrou 134 episódios de violência política contra candidatos e candidatas, além de agentes políticos.

Um aumento de 11% em relação aos 121 casos registrados no mesmo período da eleição municipal de 2022.


Os 134 episódios representam um caso de violência política a cada nove horas de campanha.

 E apesar das mulheres serem apenas 35% do total de candidatos, elas foram a maioria (52%) das vítimas do primeiro turno, segundo o levantamento.


Os dados integram a 4ª edição da pesquisa Violência Política e Eleitoral no Brasil, realizada pelas organizações de direitos humanos Terra de Direitos e Justiça Global, que pesquisa o tema desde 2016. O levantamento foi divulgado nesta quarta, dia 7 de outubro.


A porcentagem de

vítimas mulheres aumenta

 mais ainda quando a pesquisa separa apenas os casos envolvendo candidatas e candidatos. Dos 134 episódios de violência política durante o primeiro turno, 102 foram dirigidos a pessoas que disputavam o pleito. Desse total, 60 eram mulheres, quase 59% do total.


Para a coordenadora do Setor de Incidência da Terra de Direitos, Gisele Barbieri, “os dados trazem importantes achados para identificar os ambientes em que agentes políticos estão mais vulneráveis e pensar medidas de proteção. Quando eleitas, essas pessoas passam a ser vítimas de violências nos seus locais de atuação, seja no Parlamento ou no Executivo”, afirma.


Machismo e misoginia se misturam nos casos de violência política


A pesquisa mostra que a violência política é marcada pela discriminação de gênero e raça.

Quando se considera o universo completo de 70 casos de violência política contra mulheres, 45 casos envolveram machismo ou misoginia, nove envolveram racismo e cinco envolveram transfobia. Mulheres pretas foram vítimas de 25% dos casos de violência política medidos nesse primeiro turno.


A ameaça foi o tipo de violência política mais recorrente no período, com 64 casos registrados. Na sequência, aparecem 33 episódios de ofensa e 19 de agressão física. Também foram registrados 11 atentados, cinco casos de criminalização e dois assassinatos.


Mais da metade dos casos (71 ocorrências) aconteceu nas ruas, durante atividades públicas de campanha. O ambiente virtual concentrou 31,3% dos episódios.


Além disso, apenas candidatas sofreram ameaças de violência sexual. Em todos os sete casos, as vítimas eram mulheres.


“Enquanto os homens são atacados por sua atuação política, mulheres, pessoas negras e pessoas trans enfrentam também o racismo, o machismo e a transfobia que estruturam a sociedade brasileira”, afirmou em nota Glaucia Marinho, diretora-executiva da Justiça Global.


Policiais e outros agentes públicos foram a maioria dos autores


Em quase 20% dos casos o autor identificado da violência política era um agente público, incluindo parlamentares e forças de segurança.

Até o encerramento da coleta de dados pelas organizações autoras da pesquisa, nenhum dos 134 episódios havia resultado em alguma punição efetiva, limitando-se a medidas cautelares de urgência determinadas pela Justiça Eleitoral.


A região Nordeste liderou o número de casos (48), seguido pelo Sudeste (38). Entre os estados, São Paulo lidera com 16 casos, seguido por Rio Grande do Norte (13), Minas Gerais (12) e Rio Grande do Sul (10).


A presença de policiais entre os autores de violência política já havia sido detectada também em

levantamento

 realizado pela

Agência Pública

 durante o primeiro turno.

title: Los sepultureros de Gaza de Norman Finkelstein es una obra maestra
content:
Hay hechos sin consecuencias, libros sin seguimiento. ¿Qué haremos de esta monumental investigación y razonamiento que apela a nuestra conciencia y debería impulsarnos a la acción? Lo que está en juego es la esencia misma de la existencia civilizada, los valores de la Declaración Universal de los Derechos Humanos, los propósitos y principios de las Naciones Unidas. El genocidio en Gaza no es solo otro Holocausto monstruoso, es un espectáculo público.

[1]

 El fracaso de las Naciones Unidas para detenerlo y la inacción de la mayoría de los estadounidenses y europeos nos hacen a todos cómplices del crimen, porque

qui tacet consentire videtur

. Si solo somos

voyeurs

de esta masacre en curso, tenemos, como mínimo, responsabilidad moral. Por Alfred de Zayas 


En los últimos 30 años, Norman Finkelstein nos ha brindado muchos libros brillantes, entre ellos

Método y locura, Acuso, Saber demasiado,

Gaza

,

Más allá de la desfachatez

y

La industria del Holocausto.


Este libro de más de 400 páginas documenta el colapso civilizatorio de las clases dominantes en Occidente, la traición a todos los valores humanistas, el rechazo demasiado público por parte de Israel del derecho internacional y la moral, con la complicidad,

entre otros

, de Estados Unidos, Reino Unido, Francia, Alemania y la Unión Europea.


Todo esto se ve acompañado por la cacofonía de los medios de comunicación convencionales orwellianos, que difunden noticias falsas, historia falsa y leyes falsas, especialmente con respecto a los palestinos como pueblo, a quienes se les representa erróneamente como “terroristas”, cuando poseen el derecho, reconocido en el derecho internacional, a resistir la colonización y la ocupación.

[2]


Nelson Mandela también fue tildado de «terrorista», pero fue fundamental en la lucha por la liberación de su pueblo. Hoy todos reconocen que el fin del apartheid en Sudáfrica era algo que debió haberse hecho hace mucho tiempo. ¿Cuándo veremos el fin del apartheid en Israel y los Territorios Ocupados? Esto es lo que Jimmy Carter exigió en su libro

Palestina: Paz, no apartheid

.

[3]


Los políticos occidentales y los principales medios de comunicación han invertido los papeles y han culpado a la víctima de su desgracia. Israel es el terrorista que practica el terrorismo de Estado y coloca trampas explosivas en los buscapersonas, como demostró de forma obscena el primer ministro israelí Benjamin Netanyahu durante su diatriba en la Asamblea General de la ONU el 24 de septiembre de 2026.

[4]


Israel nació del terrorismo

[5]

 contra británicos y palestinos, ha sido un Estado agresor desde su creación, en un sentido muy real un

Estado fallido

, porque no ha aprendido a vivir en paz con sus vecinos.


Israel ha atacado Líbano, Siria, Irak, Irán, Egipto, etc. En una infame operación de falsa bandera, incluso atacó el buque de inteligencia de la Armada de los Estados Unidos USS

Liberty

[6]

 en junio de 1967, matando a 34 marineros estadounidenses, en un intento fallido de involucrar a los Estados Unidos en la guerra de agresión de Israel.


Israel ha sido un estado paria desde su creación en 1948, e incluso antes.


El genocidio de Gaza no es más que una continuación de la intención criminal de establecer un «Gran Israel» anacrónico e imperialista en medio del mundo árabe y musulmán.


[Fuente:

cartooningforpeace.org

]


Sin duda, los gobiernos de Israel, Estados Unidos y la UE están moralmente en bancarrota.

[7]


Lamentablemente, la

percepción

de la realidad es más determinante que la realidad misma. Dado que nuestras acciones están condicionadas por la información de la que disponemos, nuestro juicio se ve influenciado —e incluso subvertido— por las narrativas odiosas que recibimos de los principales medios de comunicación, y nuestras opiniones se distorsionan por el incesante discurso de odio y la propaganda contra los palestinos. Esto constituye una incitación al odio y a la violencia, en contravención del artículo 20 del Pacto Internacional de Derechos Civiles y Políticos.

[8]


Los principales medios de comunicación difunden la versión israelí y suprimen las opiniones disidentes. No solo nos mienten, sino que nos privan de información crucial que cambia radicalmente la situación.


El público es manipulado, pero muchos se dejan manipular. Como escribió Julio César en

De Bello Civili (II, 27, 2): «quae volumus, ea credimus libenter»

(Creemos lo que queremos creer). O peor aún, como decían los romanos …

author: Aallyah Wright
title: Organizers Are Pushing to Reach “Forgotten” Black Voters Ahead of the Midterms
content:
The efforts target college students, first-time voters, and the formerly incarcerated, particularly in the South.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

Kamora Greggs returned to her college campus with voting on her mind. She’d just visited her home in Jackson, Mississippi, about three hours away, when her mom encouraged her to exercise her right.

“And don’t have anybody change your mind about what you want to do,” Greggs recalled.

As a first time voter, the 19-year-old health and kinesiology major wanted to know more about the process, the role of government, and hear directly from her peers about why they thought voting is important.

She and dozens of other Coahoma Community College students participated in a September town hall – playing games like Levels, learning history and the power of the ballot box — at their school in Clarksdale.

“It’s a good way to learn with your friends,” Greggs said. “It really impacted me and made me want to actually get out there and spread the word and make sure other people my age know that it’s a good idea to get registered to vote.”

With Election Day just weeks away, the experience is part of the Voting Is No Laughing Matter Tour. Rita Brent, an Emmy-winning comedian from Jackson, partnered with the Southern Poverty Law Center to host the five-stop campus initiative, which aims to empower students at the ballot box.

“To witness young people who are not only civically engaged but genuinely concerned about the state of our communities, our country, and the world gives me tremendous hope,” Brent said. “Their passion for justice, thirst for knowledge and their commitment to creating meaningful change remind me that our future is in capable hands.”

It mirrors renewed energy in civic engagement nationwide. It is one of several efforts focused on what some are calling the forgotten voters: college students, first-time voters, and the formerly incarcerated.

In another effort to mobilize younger voters, companies and groups transformed campus spaces into art installations, alongside on-site voter registration. And in North Carolina, a group is working to engage more with formerly incarcerated people who don’t always utilize their right to vote.

Since the weakening of the Voting Rights Act, attention has shifted to the South, where many communities are underserved, organizers told Capital B. The region is both a battleground and testing ground for voting rights. Decades of voter suppression, gerrymandering or redistricting, and landmark decisions such as Louisiana v. Callais have shaped the current political landscape.

In Mississippi, citizens don’t have an option when it comes to whether to vote or not, said Waikinya Clanton, the state’s director for the SPLC. Despite the decline in voter participation, it’s more about conditions, racism, and restricting access and opportunity.

In the Magnolia State, an appeals court recently refused to overturn a centuries-old lifetime voting ban for those with certain felony convictions, which was embedded in the state’s constitution. Nearly 60% of people who lost their right under this law were Black. Mississippi also does not offer early voting or drop boxes.

“So many people have felt disillusioned by the fact that they don’t feel like their vote matters. It can be depressing for people who are really trying to find their way out,” Clanton said. “For folks to be working so adamantly to make people feel like their votes don’t matter, that’s a problem.”

Over the past five years, 86 million eligible voters — about one-third nationwide — live in states that have passed more restrictive voting and election-related laws, according to a new report by the Movement Advancement Project. It is disproportionately impacting Black adults in the South, said Brian Hinkle, author of the report and senior democracy program manager for MAP.

“It was really striking that we saw that the Americans who live in the states with the most restrictive voting laws are disproportionately Black. While that was also true in 2021, the proportion has nearly doubled in the last five years, from 27% to over 48%,” Hinkle said.

According to the MAP report, the 2020 election and subsequent Jan. 6 attack prompted an unprecedented wave of state legislation limiting voter access. For example, 13 states passed laws that gave state legislatures the power to interfere …

title: Jake Lang’s Tour of American Courtrooms Continues
content:
St. Paul, MN – White supremacist agitator and violent J6er Edward Jacob “Jake” Lang Zoomed into a court hearing in St. Paul on Friday, Oct. 9, as the Minnesota state government argued its case against him for kicking over an ice sculpture reading “Prosecute ICE” in front of the State Capitol building in February.


The hearing marked Lang’s second appearance for his

criminal charges

 after the previous hearing scheduled for July was canceled. It saw the state’s attorneys make the case for a hate crime charge in addition to property destruction against Lang that could carry a prison sentence, while Lang’s attorney argued in favor of a pretrial hearing to dismiss the additional charge.


Lang, wearing a polka dot dress shirt beneath a navy blue suit jacket, was making his video call from a familiar location where he frequently gives interviews, sitting in front of a backdrop branded for his “Blessed News Network,” which markets itself as “AI-curated Christian and conservative headlines.”


Jake Lang appearing on a monitor hanging above the court room.


Photo contributed by L. Cam Anderson.


The previous day, Lang was protesting at Cornell University in New York, carrying a sign on campus claiming the “Cornell 7” were innocent, potentially explaining his absence in the Minnesota court room. According to Lang, he was “thrown out” of the campus for this.


[Source: Jake Lang on X]


Throughout the hearing, Lang was quiet and relatively stoic, breaking from this demeanor to shake his head and show disbelief whenever the prosecuting attorney spoke to the judge. It was clear he learned from his run-in with Judge Reid Poland III in Tennessee,

where he was held in contempt of court and jailed for the maximum amount of time after interrupting the trial of Dalton Eatherly

, also known online as “Chud the Builder.”


The bedraggled Brian Karalus, Lang’s attorney, sat at a table in the center of the room across from the two prosecuting attorneys. Karalus, who earlier this year represented Shiloh Hendrix – the woman who was filmed at a park in Rochester calling an 8-year-old the N-word – had only papers before him where the two across from him had laptops.


Brian Karalus, Jake Lang’s attorney.


Photo contributed by L. Cam Anderson.


Lang watched silently over Zoom, suspended above the courtroom from a wall-mounted TV, while Karalus did not contest the government’s first charge against Lang, the destruction of property, but made the case to dismiss the second charge, that the destruction was hate or bias-motivated.


Justifying Lang’s actions as a form of “political speech,” Karalus added in a rambling speech to the judge that the majority of Americans and Minnesotans support deportations.


“Mr. Lang’s political position on this is not in the minority,” Karalus said. “The state might not like some of his antics and his theatrics, but that’s not a crime.”


Contrary to Karalus’ point,

YouGov polling conducted on Jan. 24

, less than two weeks before Lang’s vandalism, revealed that 57% of U.S. adults somewhat or strongly disapproved of U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE).


On the topic of deportations specifically,

according to Pew Research Center polling from February and March last year

, 51% of U.S. adults distinguish between immigrants who have committed violent crimes from those who have not committed any crimes and have a job. The data reveals that a majority of those polled actually are opposed to deporting such immigrants,

who make up a significant number of those targeted by ICE under the second Trump administration

.


Karalus made the case that the state’s decision to prosecute Lang represented “selective prosecution,” mentioning the

toppling of a Columbus statue

 in front of the State Capitol in 2020.


The statue, which was pulled down by a large group of activists two weeks after the

police murder of George Floyd

, was not destroyed, and damage on the statue itself was restricted to a scuff on its nose when the solid-bronze statue made impact with the concrete below. Ramsey County charged just one person who was involved, Mike Forcia, with a

felony of first degree criminal destruction of property

.


Forcia ultimately agreed to

a restorative justice sentencing

 which saw his criminal charges dropped after he completed 100 hours of community service educating the public about the genocide of Indigenous peoples during the development of the U.S.

Author

: Ejército Zapatista de Liberación Nacional

Title

: A Declaration... For Life

Date

: January 1, 2021

Notes

: Translated by Ediciones Bloodfruit/Malvivientes from https://enlacezapatista.ezln.org.mx/2021/01/01/primera-parte-una-declaracion-por-la-vida/

Source

: Retrieved 10/19/2026 from https://www.patreon.com/bloodfruit/posts/new-zine-for-148153724


 First of January, 2021.


 TO THE PEOPLES OF THE WORLD:


 TO THE PEOPLE WHO STRUGGLE IN THE FIVE CONTINENTS:


 BROTHERS AND SISTERS AND COMRADES:


 In these past months we have established contact among ourselves through various means. We are women, lesbians, gay, transgender, transvestites, intersex, queer and more, men, groups, collectives, associations, organizations, social movements, first peoples, neighbor associations, communities and a long

et cetera

 that identifies us.


 We are differentiated and separated by lands, skies, mountains, valleys, steppes, jungles, deserts, oceans, lakes, rivers, streams, lagoons, race, cultures, languages, histories, age, geographies, sexual and non-sexual identities, roots, borders, forms of organization, social classes, purchasing power, social prestige, fame, popularity, followers, likes, coinage, degree of education, ways of being, chores, virtues, defects, pros, cons, howevers, rivalries, enmities, conceptions, arguments, counter-arguments, debates, disputes, denunciations, accusations, disdains, phobias, philias, praises, repudiations, jeers, applause, divinities, demons, dogmas, heresies, joys, dislikes, modes, and a long

et cetera

 that makes us different and, not infrequently, opposites.


 We are united only in a few things:


 In that we make the Earth’s sorrows our own: the violence against women; the persecution and contempt for those different in their affective, emotional, sexual identity; the annihilation of childhood; the genocide against the First Peoples; racism; militarism; exploitation; spoliation; nature’s destruction.


 The understanding that it is a system which is responsible for these sorrows. The executioner is an exploiting, patriarchal, pyramidal, racist, thieving and criminal system: Capitalism.


 The knowledge that it is not possible to reform, educate, allay, soften, domesticate, or humanize this system.


 The commitment to fight, everywhere and at all times —each in their own field— against this system until it is completely destroyed. Humanity’s survival depends on Capitalism’s destruction. We do not surrender, we do not sell out and we do not waver.


 The certainty that the struggle for Humanity is global. Just as the ongoing destruction recognizes no borders, nationalities, flags, tongues, cultures, races; so, too, is the struggle for Humanity everywhere, at all times.


 The conviction that many worlds live and fight in The World. And that all pretense of homogeneity and hegemony threatens the human being’s essence: Liberty. Humanity’s equality lies in respecting the different. Its resemblance lies in its diversity.


 The understanding that it is not the vanity of imposing our gaze, our steps, company, paths and fates what allows us to advance, but rather listening and the sight of the other who, distinct and different, has the same calling to liberty and justice.


 Due to these convergences, and without abandoning our convictions nor leaving behind who and what we are, we have agreed:


 First ‒ To realize gatherings, dialogues, exchanging of ideas, experiences, analysis and evaluations amongst the committed we find —from among different conceptions and in different lands— in the struggle for life. Afterwards, each will continue on their own path, or not. Seeing and listening to the other may or may not help us on our way. But to learn of the different is also part of our struggle and our commitment, of our humanity.


 Second ‒ That these gatherings and activities take place in the five continents. That, with regards to the European continent, these take place in the months of July, August, September and October of the year 2021 with the active participation of a Mexican delegation made up of CNI-CIG, the People’s Front in Defense of the Water and Land of Morelos, Puebla and Tlaxcala, and EZLN. title: The Gaza Flotillas Will Not Stop
content:
By Colonel (Ret) Ann Wright, World BEYOND War, October 20, 2026


International Solidarity Against the Israeli Genocide and Ethnic Cleansing of Palestinians Grows with each Israeli Atrocity.


While Palestinians are exhausted from the Israeli genocide and ethnic cleansing and the coordinators and volunteers of the Gaza Flotillas are tired, they like the Palestinians, will never give up challenging the immoral, criminal actions of the Israeli state.


Recent History (2023-2026) of the Gaza Flotillas


In the past two years a remarkable number of persons have confronted the Israeli military at sea. Over 1,000 persons on hundreds of boats have risked their lives by direct confrontation with the Israeli genocidal military.


The latest of the boats on the journey to Gaza is the

Kate/Tenacity

.


After a two-month journey from northern Europe, the

Kate/Tenacity

 arrived in Sicily on October 14, 2026 with 12 persons onboard.

The Kate

 left Bristol, United Kingdom on August 17, 2026 and participated in Palestine solidarity community events in Ireland, France and Spain before arriving in Sicily.


In the past year and one-half, nineteen months, the flotillas have launched over 120 boats to attempt to break the Israeli naval blockade of Gaza.  Prior to that, from 2008-2024, more than 35 boats had sailed to attempt to break the illegal naval blockade of Gaza.


Incredible Amount of Logistics and Outreach Needed for Each Mission


Each attempt to break the illegal Israeli naval siege on Gaza required fund raising in our local communities for the mission, locating and purchasing boats, repairing and outfitting the boats with safety and communications equipment, food for the journey and symbolic medical and provisions to take to Gaza, locating captains and crew, vetting volunteer participants, getting participants to the boats and making preparations for the return of those involved when Israeli military forces attacked the vessels, kidnapped, assaulted, abused and imprisoned the participants and deported them.


Each time a boat is launched for the mission to Gaza, an incredible network of volunteers from the 18 national campaigns of the Freedom Flotilla Coalition spring into action to fill all the roles needed for these missions.


Since 2008, when the predecessor of the Freedom Flotilla Coalition, the Free Gaza Movement, successfully sailed five boats that arrived in Gaza, none of the 35 boats that we have sailed to break the illegal Israeli naval blockade of Gaza have escaped from attacks in international waters the brutal Israeli military forces. 

In 2010 Israeli military commandos shot

 and killed ten and wounded over 50 participants among the 600 participants on the

Mavi Marmara

No flotilla boats sailed during the four years of the worldwide COVID epidemic.


Citizen activist against the horrific Israeli brutality toward Palestinians ramped up again as the Israeli-US genocide of Palestinians in Gaza began in October 2023.

renamed Handala 1 from Scandinavia to Sicily

Handala 1

title: Di Deryaya Egeyê de yek jê zarok 12 penaber mirin
content:
Li Deryaya Egeyê, li peravên giravên Midillî (Lesvos) û Sisamê (Samos) yên Yewnanistanê di 19ê Cotmehê de di du bûyerên cuda de, yek jê pitik bi giştî 12 penaber û koçber mirin.


Bûyer di dema midaxeleya Hêzên Ewlekariya Qeraxan ên Yewnanistanê de pêk hatine û di bûyeran de herî kêm 22 kes hatin rizgarkirin. Xebatên lêgerîn û rizgarkirinê yên ji bo sê kesên ku hatine ragihandin li peravên Sisamê winda bûne berdewam dikin.


Li peravên Yewnanistanê heta niha 79 penaber mirine


15 Hezîran 2023


Li peravên Midilliyê şeş kes mirin


Di bûyera yekem a ku li peravên Agrilia ya li başûrê Girava Midilliyê pêk hatiye de, keştiya penaberan û bota Hêzên Ewlekariya Qeraxan ên Yewnanistanê li hev qelibîne.


Piştî lihevxistinê, di encama wergerîna keştiyê de çar mêr, jinek û pitikekî jiyana xwe ji dest dan. 8 kesên ku hatin rizgarkirin birin nexweşxaneyê. Di keştiyê de penaberên sûrî û fîlistînî hebûn.


Polîsên Yewnanistanê, welatiyekî Tirkiyeyê yê 37 salî ku di nav kesên hatine rizgarkirin de bû, bi gumana ku keştî ya wî ye û qaçaxçitiya mirovan kiriye, desteser kirin.


Li Sisamê jî şeş kes mirin


Bûyera duyem li Girava Sisamê pêk hat. Li gorî daxuyaniya Hêzên Ewlekariya Qeraxan ên Yewnanistanê, keştiya lezgîn a ku ji beravên Tirkiyeyê birê ketibû, di nav sînorê ava Yewnanistanê de hat tespîtkirin. Hêzên Ewlekariya Qeraxan îdîa kir ku keştiyê manevrayeke dijwar kiriye û piştre jî serobino bûye.


Di bûyerê de pênc mêr û jinekî mirin. Di daxuyaniyên destpêkê de hat ragihandin ku 14 kes hatine rizgarkirin. Welatiyekî Îranê ku di nav kesên hatine rizgarkirin de bû, bi gumana qaçaxçitiya mirovan hat desteserkirin.


Hêzên Ewlekariya Qeraxan ên Yewnanistanê û helîkoptereke leşkerî tevlî xebatên lêgerîn û rizgarkirinê bûn.


Hejmara penaberên li Yewnanistanê mirine gihîştiye 82yan


21 Hezîran 2023


Hikûmeta Yewnanistanê: Qaçaxçî berpirs in


Wezîrê Deryavanî û Polîtîkayên Giravan ê Yewnanistanê Vassilis Kikilias di daxuyaniya piştî bûyeran de qaçaxçiyên mirovan ji van mirinan berpirsiyar girt.


Kikilias diyar kir ku daneyên destpêkê ên têkildarî lihevxistina li Midilliyê nîşan didin ku keştiya lezgîn li aliyê çepê yê keştiya ewlekariyê xistiye û rewşa rastîn a bûyerê jî tê lêkolînkirin.


Mirinên li Egeyê pêk tên


Li gorî lêkolîna rêxistina Refugee Support Aegean (RSA) a ku navenda wê li Yewnanistanê ye û di meha Adara 2025an de hatibû weşandin, di seranserê sala 2024an de di 35 karesatên keştiyan yên li Deryaya Egeyê de herî kêm 171 kes mirin a an jî winda bûne.


Di Deryaya Egeyê di Sibata 2026an de li peravên Girava Sakizê di encama lihevxistina keştiya penaberan û bota Hêzên Ewlekariya Qeraxan ên Yewnanistanê, de herî kêm 15 kesan jiyana xwe ji dest dabûn.


(FY/AY)

title: Συγκέντρωση ενάντια στην κρατική δολοφονία μεταναστ(ρι)ών σε Λέσβο & Σάμο, Τρίτη 20/10, 18.30, στη πλατεία Βικτωρίας
content:
Κάλεσμα/αφίσα από την

 Ανοιχτή Συνέλευση ενάντια στα pushbacks και στη συνοριακή βία:


Ανακοίνωση και συγκέντρωση για τη δολοφονία μεταναστ(ρι)ών από το Λιμενικό στη Λέσβο και στη Σάμο και ενάντια στο ρατσιστικό πλάνο εκτοπισμού στο κέντρο της Αθήνας , Τρίτη 20/10 6.30μμ στην πλατεία Βικτωρίας


Δεν ήταν ατύχημα, δεν ήταν τραγωδία, ήταν άλλη μία κρατική δολοφονία.


Το ελληνικό λιμενικό έκαναν ξανά μαζική δολοφονία. Κατά τη διάρκεια της νύχτας της 18/10/26, η ελληνική ακτοφυλακή πραγματοποιήσε δυο επαναπροώθησεις στα ανοικτά της Λέσβου και της Σάμου, που είχαν ως αποτέλεσμα το θάνατο 12 μεταναστ(ρι)ών, ενά εκ των οποίων ήταν βρέφος.


Παράλληλη, στη Λέσβο νοσηλεύονται 8 άτομα.


Τα μέσα ενημέρωσης προσπάθησαν να συγκαλύψουν το μακελειό διαδίδοντας ψευδείς ειδήσεις από την αρχή, αρνούμενα τη δολοφονική επίθεση του λιμενικού εναντίον των μεταναστ(ρι)ών. Η βίαιη επίθεση του πάνοπλου σκάφους του λιμενικού σε μια φουσκωτή βάρκα από την οποία υπήρξαν τόσοι θάνατοι από τη μία μόνο πλευρά, ονομάστηκε “σύγκρουση μεταξύ των δύο σκαφών”. Η μη διάσωση αιτούντων ασύλου εντός ελληνικών συνόρων και το εγκληματικό pushback του λιμενικού σε γυναίκες, άντρες, παιδιά, βαφτίστηκαν “καταδίωξη διακινητών”.


Στο Αιγαίο πνιγμένοι και εδώ εκτοπισμένοι. Με τη νέα επιχείρηση ”Καθαρές πλατείες” που ανακοίνωσε ο Χρυσοχοΐδης, ακόμη μια ρατσιστική πολιτική που στοχοποιεί τους μετανάστες και αυτή φορά στοχεύει στον εκτοπισμό τους από το κέντρο της Αθήνας, με σκοπό τον εξευγενισμό και τη τουριστικοποίηση των γειτονιών μας. Μόνο τυχαίο δεν είναι αυτό το πλάνο, διότι ανακοινώθηκε έπειτα απο το ψήφισμα ανάπλασης της περιόχης του Μουσείου. Ένα πλάνο εκτοπισμού και μπατσοκρατίας, με καθημερινούς ελέγχους από μπάτσους κυρίως σε μετανάστ(ρι)ες, σταθερή παρουσία μπάτσων στις πλατείες με αυτομάτα και τη δημιουργία ενός κλίματος φόβου.


ΜΕ ΤΙΣ ΜΕΤΑΝΑΣΤΡΙΕΣ ΕΙΜΑΣΤΕ ΜΑΖΙ, ΕΠΑΝΑΠΡΟΩΘΗΣΗ ΣΕ ΜΠΑΤΣΟΥΣ ΚΑΙ ΝΑΖΙ ΑΝΑΠΛΑΣΗ ΣΗΜΑΙΝΕΙ, ΦΤΩΧΟΙ ΕΚΤΟΠΙΣΜΕΝΟΙ

title: Invitación abierta al “Seminario Justiciables: Expectativas de justicia en un mundo cada vez más injusto” en Temuco
content:
Reflexionar críticamente sobre la administración de la justicia es lo que propone este seminario que tendrá lugar en la Universidad de la Frontera, Campus Andrés Bello, el lunes 19 de octubre en el Auditorio Selva Saavedra y el martes 20 de octubre en el Auditorio Dra. Marianela De Negri Coria, de 9:30 a 18:00 horas. Junto a investigadoras/es, abogadas/os, actores comunitarios, defensoras/es, estudiantes de grado y posgrado, y personas en búsqueda activa por justicia. Invitación abierta, sin costo ni inscripción previa.


Fabien Le Bonniec es Dr. en Antropología e Investigador principal del Fondecyt “Hacia una antropología de las injusticias en el sur de Chile: Expectativas de justicia, multidimensionalidad de las experiencias de injusticia, constitución de comunidades morales y producción de praxis y saberes situados”, desde donde surge el “Seminario Justiciables: Expectativas de justicia en un mundo cada vez más injusto”.


Instancia de encuentro en la que, durante dos días, invitan a reflexionar críticamente sobre la administración de justicia a partir del enfoque etnográfico, el análisis de las políticas punitivas y la experiencia directa de actores del ámbito socio-jurídico y comunitario. “Proponemos mirar los tribunales, las cárceles y las normativas del Estado como espacios donde se producen, reproducen o disputan activamente las desigualdades e injusticias”, señaló Fabien Le Bonniec.


Para ello, convocaron de manera transversal a investigadoras/es, abogadas/os, actores comunitarios, defensoras/es, estudiantes de grado y posgrado, y lo que se denomina “justiciables”, que en este caso, son familiares de personas privadas de libertad y víctimas de siniestros u otras formas de violencia. Para llegar al título de este Seminario, el equipo pensó en el sentir de personas con quienes se han encontrado en tribunales. “Expectativas de que van a encontrar algo de justicia, al mismo tiempo que sentimientos de desconfianza al confrontar un mundo injusto y desigual”, frustraciones cada vez más presentes en la sociedad y que “van más allá de los grupos que consideramos tradicionalmente vulnerables», puntualizó Le Bonniec.


En el marco del seminario, el término «justiciables» trasciende a la definición que uno puede encontrar en un diccionario, esto es, “persona que puede o debe someterse a la acción de los tribunales de justicia». La Dra. Gloria Carrillo, Antropóloga y Co-investigadora de Injusticias del Sur, señaló que “es importante entender a las y los justiciables como sujetos activos con agencia, personas, familias, comunidades y colectivos que entran en contacto directo con el sistema judicial, estatal o carcelario”.


Para quienes organizan esta instancia, las personas justiciables, lejos de ser receptores pasivos del castigo o del procedimiento judicial, son quienes experimentan las barreras e inteligibilidades del derecho estatal y, al mismo tiempo, organizan formas de resistencia, buscan alternativas de reparación y disputan el sentido de la justicia y de la injusticia.


Para ampliar las reflexiones, las mesas están compuestas por personas que están investigando para su tesis de pregrado, doctoral u otros proyectos, problemáticas relacionadas con los tribunales, la privación de libertad y los usos y apropiaciones de la normatividad estatal. Se harán presentes también diversos actores que como «justiciables» han experimentado la justicia estatal y las injusticias asociadas a ella.


Para este equipo de trabajo, co-producir conocimientos y teorías situadas implica generar espacios de encuentro como este seminario, donde se aborda principalmente problemáticas locales pero con una mirada que no se puede sustraer de los contextos globales. “De esta forma, esperamos aportar desde el sur, con sus particularidades, a problemas que afectan a todo el país, y que se expresa por ejemplo, bajo la forma de la desconfianza y la crisis del sistema judicial en Chile”, señaló Fabien Le Bonniec.


El seminario es organizado por el equipo Fondecyt Nº1242009 Injusticias del Sur; apoyado por la Facultad de Educación, Ciencias Sociales y Humanidades, la Línea de Antropología del Departamento de Ciencias Sociales de la Universidad de la Frontera; financiado por la Agencia Nacional de Investigación y Desarrollo, ANID; con la colaboración de Conexión 2030; Doctorado en Ciencias Sociales y Magíster en Ciencias Sociales UFRO; Vio Demos; Centro de Estudios y Promoción de los Derechos Humanos y el Núcleo Científico Tecnológico en Ciencias …

author: Unknown
title: Meriç Nehri’nde kaybolan 2 mülteci çocuğu arama çalışmaları 2'nci gününde
content:
Edirne - Iraklı 5 kişilik mülteci aile, Yunanistan'a geçmek için Edirne'ye geldi. Çift ile 3 çocuğu, botla Bosnaköy yakınlarındaki NATO Köprüsü mevkisinden Meriç Nehri'ne açıldı. Bir süre sonra bot alabora oldu. Suya düşen anne, baba ve bir çocuğu, nehirdeki adacığa çıktı, 2 çocuk ise akıntıya kapılıp kayboldu. İhbar üzerine bölgeye, jandarma, AFAD, sağlık ekipleri sevk edildi. Ekiplerin yaptığı çalışmayla Iraklı çift ile 12 yaşındaki kızları kıyıya çıkarıldı. Trakya Üniversitesi Tıp Fakültesi Hastanesi'ne kaldırılan çocuk, kurtarılamadı.

Kayıp 2 çocuk için ise nehirde arama ve kurtarma çalışması başlatıldı. AFAD ekipleri dün nehirde botla, jandarma ekipleri de kıyıdan çalışma yaptı. Gün boyu süren çalışmaların sonuç alınamadı.

Bugün yeniden başlayan arama ve kurtarma çalışmalarına İzmir İl Jandarma Komutanlığı’ndan gelen 6 kişilik Su Altı Arama ve Kurtarma ekibi ile Tekirdağ’dan dalgıç polisler destek verdi. Ekipler, nehre inerek özel ekipmanlarla arama yapıyor. Ekiplerin çalışmaları sürüyor.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: Les lieux de pouvoirs et de l'économie capitaliste à Lyon
content:
En 2019, Agnès Stienne a publié dans le Monde Diplomatique

une carte des lieux de pouvoir à Paris

 associée aux parcours classiques des manifestations dans la capitale... et aux lieux de protestation des gilets jaunes. Une petite analyse cartographique finalement assez simple à interpréter : la rue n'est pas menaçante pour un gouvernement seulement par son nombre et son offensivité, mais aussi lorsqu'elle s'approche physiquement des lieux de pouvoir.


C'est quoi un lieu de pouvoir

 

?


L'interprétation de ce qu'est un lieu de pouvoir peut varier selon le prisme d'analyse qu'on choisit. Pour notre part, on décidé d'inclure dans les lieux de pouvoir les mairies/hôtel de ville, en temps que sièges administratifs et politiques, les institutions régionales mais aussi métropolitaines (comme l'Hôtel de Région et le siège de la Métropole), mais aussi les antennes locales d'institutions nationales (comme l'antenne lyonnaise de la Banque de France). On y a également inclu les implantations locales des entreprises du

CAC

 40, en temps que hauts-lieux de l'économie capitaliste, ainsi que les sièges sociaux des banques lyonnaises. Enfin, parce sans son bras armé, le pouvoir n'est pas grand chose, on a choisi de faire apparaître, à toutes fins utiles, les comicos, postes de la police municipale, et gendarmeries...


Alors à Lyon, ça donne quoi

 

?


Comme à Paris, la première chose qui saute aux yeux, c'est à quel point les parcours classiques de manif lyonnais contournent soigneusement les lieux de pouvoirs locaux. On laisse le soin aux lecteur·ices de Rebellyon d'en tirer les conclusions sur les secteurs de la ville les plus brûlants.


Cliquez sur la carte pour la voir en bonne qualité


Les nœuds stratégiques du capitalisme


L'économie capitaliste mondialisée repose des échanges de flux, financiers dématérialisés, matériels de marchandises, et humains. Pour les premiers, il est possible de les représenter sur une carte, par contre, manifester devant c'est plus dur : faire coucou aux sièges des entreprises côtés en bourse et des banques peut à la limite faire le taf. Pour les deux autres en revanche, ils s'incarnent matériellement dans l'espace : les marchandises, les matières premières, et même l'énergie, sont transportés par voie ferrovière, routière, aérienne (ou

via

 des réseaux électriques...). Et ces flux convergent dans des espaces logistiques proches d'échangeurs autoritiers, de gares de triage, de ports, parfois les trois à la fois. L'enjeu pour le capitalisme est d'aller vite, on va pas s'amuser à perdre 1/2 heure de transport en se foutant trop loin d'une autoroute.


Bon, jusque là on vous apprend probablement pas grand chose, mais la conclusion à ça, on invente rien ici, c'est que ces espaces logistiques sont centraux pour le bon fonctionnement de l'économie capitaliste, et donc sont des lieux qu'il serait particulièrement embêtant pour le pouvoir de bloquer dans le cadre, par exemple, d'une mobilisation. Il en va de même pour les flux de personnes : bloquer un aéropot, une gare, un péage ça fout le bordel assez rapidement.


Alors à Lyon ça donne quoi

 

? Pas la peine d'aller à Marseille ou Toulon bloquer les ports, on peut repérer des espaces dont le blocage à Lyon peut vite être assez pénible économiquement. Le Rhône, est une voie de transport de marchandises (et oui, pas juste des touristes qui te regardent rouiller sur les quais comme un animal de foire, et sans te jeter de cacahuètes avec ça

 

!), et d'ailleurs l'idée tourne déjà dans les milieux militants, puisque le port Edouard Herriot est régulièrement un lieu de rdv, comme ça a été le cas le 17/10. On y trouve notamment une zone de dépôt pétrolier, et le pétrole c'est important paraît-il. Cerise sur le gâteau, si on identifie comme on a joué à le faire, les points d'accès routier au port, il n'y en a que deux.


Ensuite, majoritairement au Sud de l'agglo et aussi à Meyzieu, on trouve plusieurs zones industrielles, proches de gares de triage et de voies rapides, qui concentrent les entreprises de logistique, spécialisées dans l'organisation des flux et le transport de marchandises.


Enfin, on compte quelques gares, et trois péages routiers, qui peuvent (et ont déjà fait) l'objet de blocages lors de mobilisations (on pense notamment péage de Saint-Quentin Fallavier).


Cliquez sur la carte pour la voir en bonne qualité

author: CNT Santander
title: La jornada laboral de 30 horas como elemento de lucha de clases
content:
Una de nuestras reivindicaciones de

huelga general

 es la

reducción de la jornada laboral a 30 horas semanales

. Os dejamos con

este artículo de opinión

 de nuestro compañero

Luis

 sobre

esta reivindicación

:


CONTEXTO


La duración de la jornada laboral ha sido una de las reivindicaciones históricas del movimiento obrero. No obstante, a pesar de los enormes avances tecnológicos y productivos, en los últimos 100 años, la jornada laboral se ha mantenido prácticamente igual. Ya en el año 1919 la huelga de La Canadiense terminó con la conquista de las ocho horas de trabajo diarias. Tras décadas de dictadura franquista y de brutal represión del movimiento obrero, en 1983 se estableció por ley la jornada laboral de 40 horas semanales, que sigue vigente a día de hoy.


Hoy necesitamos recuperar esa fuerza y capacidad de organización de la clase trabajadora de aquella época para volver a conquistar una reducción real y significativa de la jornada laboral. Si la productividad y la tecnología han avanzado tanto, esos avances deben servir para que tengamos más tiempo para vivir y no para seguir aumentando los beneficios de unos pocos capitalistas.


SITUACIÓN ACTUAL


En los últimos años, la reducción de la jornada laboral ha sido una de las principales promesas del Gobierno del PSOE y Sumar. La propuesta inicial de avanzar hacia las 35 horas semanales acabó concretándose en una reducción de la jornada máxima legal a 37,5 horas, sin reducción salarial. El Gobierno llegó a un acuerdo con los sindicatos mayoritarios, pero no consiguió el apoyo de la patronal. Finalmente, la propuesta llegó al Congreso y, en septiembre de 2025, PP, Vox, Junts y UPN votaron en contra, bloqueando la medida.


La patronal y los partidos que rechazaron la propuesta argumentaron que reducir la jornada sin rebajar los salarios aumentaría los costes empresariales, dificultaría la contratación y perjudicaría la competitividad. También defendieron que limitaría la capacidad de las empresas para organizar los horarios según sus necesidades. De este modo, presentaron la reducción de jornada como una amenaza para sus inmensos beneficios privados, anteponiendo la rentabilidad del capital al derecho de la clase trabajadora a disponer de más tiempo para vivir.


Si analizamos cómo ha evolucionado la producción, cabe preguntarse por qué, después de décadas de enormes avances tecnológicos y de productividad, seguimos considerando prácticamente intocable una jornada máxima legal de 40 horas semanales. Hace un siglo una parte enorme del trabajo era manual y requería muchas más horas para producir lo mismo que hoy. La mecanización, la automatización, la informática y todos los avances tecnológicos posteriores han multiplicado nuestra capacidad para producir bienes y servicios.


Esto nos lleva a una cuestión fundamental: ¿por qué debe decidir el capital cuánto tiempo de nuestras vidas dedicamos al trabajo? Que los empresarios sean propietarios de los medios de producción no significa que tengan derecho a decidir sobre el tiempo de trabajo ni les concede un derecho natural a decidir cuánto y cómo debe producir la sociedad.


El salario ya constituye una relación de poder en la que quien posee el capital compra nuestra fuerza de trabajo durante un determinado tiempo; pero eso no les da derecho a decidir unilateralmente cuánto debe ser ese tiempo. La duración de la jornada laboral no es una cuestión puramente económica, sino también política, porque afecta directamente a nuestras vidas y a nuestro tiempo libre.


Si los avances tecnológicos nos permiten producir más en menos tiempo, ese progreso debería traducirse también en más tiempo libre y una mejor calidad de vida, en lugar de servir únicamente para aumentar la producción y los beneficios de unos pocos. De hecho, una economía basada en la cooperación y en una planificación racional de los recursos podría aprovechar mejor nuestra capacidad de producir que un sistema en el que empresas y trabajadores tienen que competir constantemente entre sí para sobrevivir. Así, la reducción de jornada dejaría de verse como un coste o una amenaza para la competitividad y pasaría a entenderse como lo que debería ser: una conquista social derivada del propio progreso productivo, que permite que una parte cada vez mayor de la riqueza social se traduzca en tiempo de vida para la clase trabajadora.


Por todo esto, entendemos que, aunque pasar de 40 a 37,5 horas pueda ser una mejora, no puede ser el objetivo de nuestra …
