Due to Google’s launch of AI search, we’ve seen a drastic plunge in our site traffic and, as a result, our revenue. We lost 15 percent of our readership overnight. This was a readership we painstakingly built over decades, and it vanished because Google chose corporate greed over a healthy democracy.

We are fundraising right now to meet our basic operating expenses. If you can support Truthout with a one-time or monthly donation, you will make a significant impact on our work. Anything you can do makes a difference — we appreciate your support.

author: David Swanson
title: A Framework for Peace in Ukraine
content:
By Jeffrey Sachs,

Common Dreams

, October 20, 2026


This proposed settlement—designed to help end a conflict that has cost hundreds of thousands of lives and carries a continuing risk of confrontation—addresses the causes of the war rather than only its symptoms.


The war in

Ukraine

 can be ended permanently on terms that protect Ukraine’s statehood, meet Russia’s security concerns, and lay the foundation for a durable European security order. As another round of negotiations gears up in Norway, I propose a settlement concluded as a single package, signed by Ukraine and Russia, adopted by a vote of the

United Nations

 Security Council under Chapter VII of the Charter, and guaranteed jointly by the five permanent members of the Council together with other states that choose to join. The proposal rests on the principle of indivisible security set out in the Helsinki Final Act and the Charter of Paris.


The package would have four core commitments.


The first is Ukraine’s permanent neutrality

, adopted in a constitutional law on the model of Austria’s law of 1955, which would return Ukraine to the founding choice of its Declaration of State Sovereignty of 1990. Ukraine would join no military alliance and host no foreign bases or forces, whether of

NATO

, the

European Union

, their member states, or Russia. Neutrality would not mean disarmament, and Ukraine would retain armed forces for its own defense.


The second is that Ukraine would pursue its candidacy for membership in the European Union as a permanently neutral state

, with a neutrality protocol in its accession treaty on the model of Ireland’s, and Russia would affirm that Ukraine’s membership in the EU is consistent with Russia’s security.


The third is an armistice line drawn along the line of contact on the date of signature

. Each side would exercise de facto jurisdiction on its side of the line, neither would recognize the other’s territorial claims, and both would renounce force in any future adjustment. This formula is compatible with both countries’ constitutions, which bar or severely restrict the cession of territory.


The fourth is the end of NATO enlargement eastward.

 At signature the North Atlantic Council would declare that NATO will not admit Ukraine or other new members in Eastern Europe or the South Caucasus, withdrawing the Bucharest pledge of 2008.


The settlement would take effect as a permanent end of hostilities on signature, not as a temporary ceasefire, and its provisions would be implemented in stages under international verification. No element would be negotiated in isolation, and no party would be asked to make a concession in advance of signature.


The territorial arrangements are designed to address the concerns and claims of both sides. Ukrainian forces would withdraw from the part of Donetsk region that Ukraine now controls, which would become a demilitarized special zone. Russian forces would not enter it, the existing local civil administration would continue to function, and its final status would be left to negotiation. Russia would withdraw from the areas it holds in Dnipropetrovsk region and from the Kinburn Spit. A Northern Security Zone would be demilitarized on both sides of the Russian-Ukrainian border, and Russian forces would leave the areas they hold in Kharkiv and Sumy regions as Ukrainian forces withdraw from their side. The

Zaporizhzhia


Nuclear Power

 Plant would remain under Russian control with IAEA safety oversight and would sell an agreed share of its electricity to Ukraine at cost.


A demilitarized belt would run along both sides of the armistice line, with heavy weapons and long-range strike systems withdrawn to agreed distances, and mutual ceilings on forces would apply in the border regions on both sides. In the Black Sea and the Sea of Azov, commercial navigation would be free for all Ukrainian and Russian ports, and attacks on shipping and ports would be prohibited.


The settlement in Ukraine should also begin the repair of European security as a whole. NATO and Russia would agree on a moratorium on ground-launched intermediate-range missiles in Europe, refrain from deploying

nuclear weapons

 in any additional state, and restore the NATO-Russia Council. Normal diplomatic relations would be restored on both sides. The parties would convene the first summit of the Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe since 2010 to entrust the OSCE with monitoring the …

author: Unknown
title: Meral Çiçek: Jineology must develop concrete solutions to social problems
content:
Journalist Meral Çiçek, who attended the European Jineology Conference in Haelen, the Netherlands, spoke to ANF about the educational activities carried out across Europe over the past decade, the key discussions at the conference and the work that needs to be developed in the coming period.


Meral Çiçek said that Jineology has brought about significant changes in women's approaches to knowledge and learning. She stressed that, in the coming period, research into social problems must go hand in hand with the development of solutions. She also highlighted the importance of strengthening ties and developing joint projects with women's organisations.


 


‘Knowledge is hidden in every aspect of life’


Meral Çiçek highlighted the methodological diversity of Jineology's educational activities in Europe, conducted through camps, seminars, workshops and conferences. She said these activities have encouraged women to develop new ways of questioning and examining the world around them.


Çiçek explained that education is not regarded merely as the transmission of knowledge, emphasising that Jineology encourages women to question existing knowledge while also transforming their understanding of where knowledge comes from.


Çiçek said: “It is not simply a matter of treating formal educational institutions or written books as the primary sources of knowledge, but of showing that knowledge is actually hidden in every aspect of life. Therefore, the relationship between two people is also a source of knowledge. Our own culture is also a source of knowledge; indeed, it is a fundamental source of knowledge. We can learn from our mothers, from our relationships with children, with women and with men, from social relationships as a whole, and from the relationship between human beings and nature.”


Meral Çiçek stressed the importance of learning to recognise the sources of knowledge found in everyday life. She said that Jineology's educational activities have introduced many women to different ways of thinking, questioning and learning.


‘Findings must be translated into practical policies’


Meral Çiçek said that, considering current conditions and needs, society should be the primary focus of Jineology in the coming period. She stressed that this did not mean that work concerning society had not been carried out in the past.


Çiçek said that the crises deepened by capitalist modernity, changes within Kurdish society and growing social needs demanded a more concrete perspective. She said, “We need to focus more closely on the social problems experienced here, but not merely investigate them from a historical or social perspective. We must also show possible ways out of these problems and identify the paths towards solutions.”


Meral Çiçek emphasised the need to investigate social problems more deeply, particularly those experienced by women, make these problems easier to understand and translate the findings into practical policies. She said that Kurdish women in Europe, as well as women from different peoples, needed such an approach.


Çiçek stressed that a scientific approach centred on social life could not be limited to institutional relations. She said it was necessary to work collectively with grassroots women's organisations and different women's groups.


‘A single method is not enough to reach women’


Meral Çiçek said that different methods must be developed to reach Kurdish women, European women and women from various migrant communities living in Europe. She noted that experiences in this field had also been shared at the conference.


Çiçek highlighted the importance of organising Jineology workshops on a continuous basis. She said that workshops, public panel discussions, seminars and meetings could be used to share research findings with society. She also stressed the need to make more effective use of digital media.


Meral Çiçek pointed out that Europe has a strong institutional foundation for women's studies. She proposed developing relationships with women's studies institutes and gender studies centres at universities, as well as independent research centres and academies.


Çiçek said these relationships should be based on mutual learning, allowing the Jineology perspective to become more widely known while also drawing on different experiences.


‘Jineology belongs to all of us’


Meral Çiçek stressed that Jineology should be represented more widely at women's gatherings and in areas of struggle, not …

title: Whereabouts of five people detained by Iranian forces unknown
content:
A report published by Kolbernews provided information about the disappearance of five mountaineers from Rojhilat (East Kurdistan) following their detention by Iranian state forces.


More than 30 armed Iranian intelligence agents reportedly raided the homes of seven members of the Helo and Sewz Mountain groups, independent mountaineering groups based in Saqqez. The mountaineers were detained following the home raids.


The report stated that the mountaineers Abdullah Amini and Rahim Haqparast were subsequently released. However, Mihemed Hekîmpûr, Mistefa Qadirî, Mihemedsalih Husênî, Husên Ebdulahî, and Xalid Rehemî remain in detention, and their whereabouts and fate are unknown.


It was reported that all the mountaineers had been subjected to torture while in detention. The report also stated that those whose fate remains unknown have been denied the right to meet with their families and lawyers.

author: Unknown
title: Rape case in Siverek highlighted at "Women, Justice and Memory" vigil
content:
Organised by the Amed Network Against Violence, the vigil continued for its third week outside Diyarbakır Courthouse. Participants carried photographs of women and chanted slogans including “Femicide is political,” “Protect, exonerate, prosecute” and “Jin, jiyan, azadî” (Woman, life, freedom).


Berfin Elçi, a member of the executive board of the Amed branch of the Human Rights Association (IHD), stated that femicides are not isolated incidents, but are the result of a male-dominated system, impunity and the mentality that seeks to control women’s lives.


Emphasising that women should not have to seek justice only after they have been killed, Berfin Elçi called for reports of violence to be taken seriously, suspicious deaths of women to be effectively investigated, and protection obligations to be fulfilled.


Drawing attention to the release of three defendants in the rape case in Siverek (Sêwereg), as well as the acquittal of the perpetrator tried on abuse charges despite Fatmanur Çelik’s pursuit of justice, Berfin Elçi stated that practices of impunity threaten women’s right to life.


Stories of murdered women were read aloud


During the vigil, the stories of Canan Yıldırım, Naz Aslan, Ebru Serep and Pınar Güneş, who died in different cities in October, were shared. It was reported that Canan Yıldırım was killed by the man she lived with in Antalya, while Naz Aslan died under suspicious circumstances in the Nusaybin district of Mardin (Mêrdîn). Ebru Serep died after her home was set on fire in the Seferihisar district of Izmir, while Pınar Güneş lost her life after shots were fired following an argument in Alaçatı. Participants called for all circumstances surrounding the women’s deaths to be fully clarified and for those responsible to be held accountable.


Policies of impunity must be exposed


Speaking at the vigil, Halide Türkoğlu, spokesperson for the DEM Party Women’s Assembly, said that women’s struggle for equality and freedom was being targeted and stressed the need to continue fighting against policies of impunity.


Türkoğlu underlined that they wanted a country where women could live freely and equally without the fear of being murdered. She added that the vigil taking place in Amed was giving a voice to women murdered across all parts of Turkey.


The event concluded with a “moment of silence in memory” of the women. Participants stated that they would continue to gather every Tuesday to demand justice, truth and remembrance.

title: Italian politicians call for Abdullah Öcalan’s freedom
content:
Politicians in Italy have stressed that the peace process between the Turkish government and the Kurdish people must advance through concrete steps, calling for Abdullah Öcalan’s freedom.


Speaking at a press conference on the peace process in Turkey, held on 20 October at Montecitorio in Rome, Movimento 5 Stelle MP Stefania Ascari said that the Kurdish people’s rights to preserve their language and culture, elect their representatives and determine their own future must be recognised.


Emphasising that these rights are universal for both Kurds and Palestinians, Ascari said that the peace process must not remain limited to statements alone.


 


Ascari: We support the process


Ascari said: “We support the peace process in Turkey and call for Abdullah Öcalan’s freedom. We want this both to ensure respect for his rights and to enable him to contribute to dialogue.”


Stating that the way must be opened for actors capable of conducting negotiations if a political solution is to be achieved, Ascari also called on the Italian government to act. She asked the government to explain what initiatives it would undertake to support the peace process and what demands it would raise regarding Abdullah Öcalan’s freedom and the rights of the Kurdish people in Turkey.


Grimaldi: Abdullah Öcalan’s freedom would remove obstacles to peace


In a joint statement, Green-Left Alliance parliamentary group leader Marco Grimaldi, Democratic Party MP Rachele Scarpa, Stefania Ascari and Yılmaz Orcan of the Kurdistan Information Office in Italy also stated that Abdullah Öcalan’s freedom is one of the fundamental conditions for achieving genuine peace. The statement emphasised that, following steps taken by the Kurdish freedom movement, the PKK had decided to dissolve itself and lay down its arms, but the Turkish state had failed to take the concrete steps necessary to advance the process.


The statement criticised the omission of legal reforms from the final report of the parliamentary commission established to address the Kurdish question, stressing that legislative changes are necessary for a genuine democratic transition in Turkey. It also recalled that the European Parliament’s Committee on Foreign Affairs had drawn attention to democratic backsliding in Turkey, stating that European institutions must adopt a stronger stance in defence of the rule of law.


European Court of Human Rights rulings must be implemented


The statement noted that Abdullah Öcalan has been imprisoned and held in isolation for 27 years. It stated that, in 2014, the European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) ruled that aggravated life imprisonment was incompatible with the right to hope, but that this ruling had not been implemented.


The statement underlined that, in its position communicated to the Council of Europe in June 2025, Turkey had indicated that prisoners serving aggravated life sentences were excluded from the right to hope, drawing attention to Abdullah Öcalan’s situation.


The politicians who signed the submission to the Council of Europe called for the ECtHR ruling to be implemented. The statement stressed that Abdullah Öcalan’s continued isolation is not merely a human rights issue, but also constitutes an obstacle to peace. Referring also to Abdullah Öcalan’s 27 February 2025 “Call for Peace and a Democratic Society” and his “Manifesto for a Democratic Society”, the signatories stated that this approach offers a political and legal framework for a solution that is relevant not only to Kurdish society, but also to the region and the world.


The statement concluded by asserting that Abdullah Öcalan’s freedom could contribute to democratisation in Turkey and transform the country’s role in international politics.

title: Zapatistische Vorbereitungen für das umarmende Treffen mit den Familien Sucherinnen. Teil I. Jugendliche Theatermacher*innen.
content:
Musik: Caifanes: »Antes de que nos olviden – Bevor sie uns vergessen«. Aufnahmen: Terci@s Compas Zapatistas.

Du wirst unter coolen Leuten sein.

Ich hing einfach so ab, dachte an nichts. Machte jedoch das coolste Gesicht des megacoolsten der Bande der Super-Gangstars. Da sehe ich Riko kommen, der eigentlich nicht so heißt, und sich den Namen gab, weil er, wie er behauptet, der Allerhübscheste von Kiez, Bande und Gang sei, nach dem sich alle* seufzend verzehren. Riko oder Rikolin, wie er sich auch nennt, erzählt, dass sich gestern zwei* Görlies um ihn geschlagen haben. Ich weiß jedoch, sie stritten sich nicht wegen ihm, sondern weil die eine vom Gemischtwarenladen der anderen nicht das korrekte Wechselgeld zurückgab. Riko Rikolin aber schwört bei Mark und Bein, es ging um die Vorzüge seiner Reize. Nun gut, er kommt also an und meint zu mir: »Wat‘n los, mein Capi? Bist inconito, oder wat?« »Incognito, heißt es, incognito«, korrigiere ihn. »Ja, genau dette«, gibt Rio zurück und fährt fort: »Und, Alter, wat geht hier sonst so ab?« Riko denkt, er spricht den heißesten Kiez-Slang, aber was für eingeschlafene Füße sind das.

»Na, hier immer so rumschwaddulnd«, gebe ich ihm passend zur Antwort. Da Riko sieht, dass sonst keine*r da ist, gibt er seine katalogisierte Verführungspose Nummer 69 auf und fragt mich: »Und, was hältst du davon?« »Von was?« »Na das?« »Weiß nicht, was du meinst?« »Na, was hier so rumgeht, na, den Klatsch und Tratsch. Oder wie die jungen zapatudischen Frauen es ausdrücken: ›die geteilte Information‹. Das heißt, selbiger Klatsch und Tratsch, nur eleganter ausgedrückt.« »Keine Ahnung, was hier so rumgeht.« »Nun, dass es ein Tokín gibt.« »Was für ein Tokín?« »Oh, nun ja, Tokín wird gesagt, wenn es abgeht, es geile Mucke gibt, na, ein Konzert. Das heißt, ein Tokín bedeutet nicht: ›noch‘n Bier für den Mann am Klavier‹, sondern ein Konzert mit Bands.«

»Ah so. Nein, weiß von nichts«, meine ich scheinbar desinteressiert, denn ich weiß ja, dies wird Riko noch mehr provozieren. Riko setzt sich auf die Bank und flüstert mir zu: »Ein Konzert, ich weiß nur nicht, wann und wo; aber es wird ein Konzert geben. Sie sagen, mit den Caifanes, und meiner Freundin Ely Guerra, und Vivir Quintana, und die Contingentes Jaraneros, und Kevin Kaarl, und Meme del Real. Zusammen, aber nicht durcheinander.

Das heißt: das Ganze und seine Teile, wie eine*r so meint.«

»Und wo, wann, wie und warum?«, drängele ich.

»Wer weiß«, erwidert Riko, »ich glaube, sie sagen noch nichts, weil sie Angst haben, dass die Justiz über sie herfällt.«

»Warum sollte die Justiz über sie herfallen? Für was ist denn das Konzert?« »Na, für das Treffen-die Umarmung mit den Familien Sucherinnen.« »Und das ist etwas Schlechtes? Warum sollte die Polente über sie herfallen?« »Na holla, wegen dem Meme; weißt du nicht, dass sie die Memes verboten haben. Und naja, da die Polente nicht besonders helle ist, wird sie alle* verhaften; ja, alle*, um die Geschlechterparität nicht zu vergessen. Um nicht fehlzugehen, so sagen sie.« »Das ist verzickt«, meine ich in Stimmung kommend. »Aber wenn nicht gewusst wird, wann und wo, wie will es die Bande hinkriegen, dass sie über sie herfallen?«

»Keine Ahnung«, gibt Riko zurück, »aber ich glaube, es dauert nicht mehr lange, ansonsten wäre ein Konzert ja vergeblich, wenn keine*r weiß, wann und wo.

Aber der Punkt ist, mein verehrter Capitán Schrotkugel, keine*r verdient was; das heißt, weder die, die einen auf Musiker*innen machen, noch die, die organisieren, produzieren oder die Location stellen. Sie übernehmen die Kosten, machen keinen eigenen Gewinn, alles dient dem Treffen. Aus Solidarität für die gute Sache. Und mehr noch, auch ich werde ihnen nichts berechnen. Ich werde mich dem gratis und persönlich zugesellen. Um dem Event, wie man so sagt, Glanz und Glimmer zu verleihen. Die ganze Kohle ist für das Treffen mit den Sucherinnen. Alles ausgewogen, alles hokeydokey.«

»Nö, das glaube ich dir nicht«, meine ich zu ihm, um zu sehen, ob er noch mehr vom Stapel lässt.

»Genau das ist das Problem, dass keine*r in nichts glaubt. Sie glauben nicht an selbstlose Solidarität, an Güte, Edelmut, Menschlichkeit … oder an gute Musik. Denn die Solidarität sollte immer ein Fest sein. Und ein Fest ohne Musik ist wie eine Zigarette zu haben und kein Feuerzeug. Wie willst du also Feuer fangen?«

author: Savanna Craig
title: Kahnawà:ke : Résultats positifs aux tests de contamination au plomb
content:
Des photos de plus de 20 arrière-petits-enfants et de plus de 10 petits-enfants ornent le réfrigérateur et les murs de la maison de Miranda Diabo – une maison qui appartient à la famille Diabo depuis des générations.


Cette matriarche originaire de Kahnawà:ke s’inquiète pour l’avenir de ces enfants après que plusieurs tests dans la communauté se sont révélés positifs à la contamination au plomb.


En septembre, les résultats d’une analyse menée par le Bureau de protection de l’environnement et le Centre d’éducation de la communauté ont révélé la présence de plomb dans l’air. La norme québécoise de qualité de l’air relative au plomb en suspension dans l’air est fixée à 100 nanogrammes par mètre cube. La récente analyse de la qualité de l’air réalisée à Kahnawà:ke a révélé des concentrations de 150 nanogrammes par mètre cube, soit 50 % de plus que les normes provinciales de sécurité.


Madame Diabo lance un appel aux membres de la communauté pour créer un changement.


« Nos enfants sont tellement importants. Nous devons les sauver avant qu’il ne soit trop tard », déclare-t-elle.


Parmi les mesures à prendre figure la fermeture ou le déménagement de Terrapure, l’usine responsable de la contamination au plomb dans la communauté. Terrapure est une usine industrielle qui recycle les batteries au plomb-acide en fin de vie provenant des États-Unis et du Canada.


Terrapure a sollicité une réunion avec le Conseil mohawk de Kahnawà:ke, mais sa demande a été rejetée.


« Nous ne menons pas de discussions avec eux », déclare le Grand chef Cody Diabo. « Pour nous, il s’agit de traiter les répercussions sur notre territoire. »


Pour l’instant, le Conseil se concentre sur la collecte de ses propres données.


L’usine Terrapure à l’extérieur de Kahnawake. Photo : APTN.


En réponse aux analyses de la qualité de l’air qui ont révélé des taux de plomb supérieurs de 50 % aux limites de sécurité, le Grand chef explique que ces échantillons ont été prélevés alors que le vent soufflait d’est en ouest, en direction de Kahnawà:ke.


« La plupart du temps, le vent souffle d’ouest en est, c’est-à-dire de Kahnawà:ke vers la région de Sainte-Catherine », explique le Grand chef. « Il faudrait être exposé à 100 nanogrammes par mètre cube pendant une année entière pour que cela entraîne le moindre problème de santé. »


Les niveaux de contamination au plomb jugés « sans danger » continuent de préoccuper certaines personnes.


« Combien de temps devrons-nous encore supporter ces niveaux jugés sans danger ? », s’interroge Tammy Whitebean, une mère de famille.


Mme Whitebean se souvient des effets de la contamination au plomb qu’elle a subis lorsqu’elle fréquentait la Kahnawake Survival School, l’école secondaire de Kahnawà :ke.


« Je me souviens qu’à l’école, on nous disait : “Oh, fermez les fenêtres. Vous ne pouvez pas sortir. Ne mangez pas les racines”, se souvient Whitebean, qui était alors élève au secondaire. « Certains jours, on nous renvoyait chez nous [à cause de la contamination]. »


Actuellement, l’école secondaire est située à environ un kilomètre de Terrapure. Auparavant, l’établissement se trouvait juste en face de l’usine.


Une décision du conseil de bande prise en 1979 a entraîné le déplacement de l’école plus à l’intérieur du territoire. Bien qu’elle soit plus éloignée de Terrapure, les analyses effectuées sur le terrain de l’école révèlent toujours une contamination au plomb.


Des prélèvements de sève d’érable effectués sur le terrain de l’école au printemps dernier ont révélé que la contamination au plomb se situait entre 2,5 et 3 µg/L dans les échantillons prélevés directement sur l’arbre à l’aide de robinets. Les échantillons prélevés dans des seaux en plastique présentent une contamination comprise entre 1,3 et 10 µg/L. La norme provinciale du Québec en matière de sécurité fixe une limite à 250 µg/L.


Dans un communiqué de presse, le conseil a également indiqué que le Bureau de protection de l’environnement de Kahnawà:ke avait constaté des concentrations de plomb plus élevées, comprises entre 3,1 et 41 µg/L.


Linda Whitebean, mère et grand-mère, souhaite que l’école secondaire soit à nouveau déplacé.


« Je pense que les enfants ne devraient pas du tout se trouver là-bas », déclare Mme Whitebean.


Le Grand chef Diabo précise que cette décision relève du Centre d’éducation et de son conseil d’administration.


APTN News a contacté l’école à plusieurs reprises pour solliciter un entretien. Nous n’avons reçu aucune …

author: Daron Letts
title: Nunavut Health Department warns of federal cheese recall
content:
The Government of Nunavut is warning about

another

 cheese product recall issued by the Canadian Food Inspection Agency due to listeria contamination.


Issued by the federal agency on Oct. 14, the recall is for

 12 organic cheeses by Farm Boy, L’Ancêtre and Life Smart, with expiry dates that range from Dec. 4, 2026, to July 30, 2027.


They include Swiss, cheddar, mozza-cheddar and mozzarella products.


The territorial Health Department shared the warning with Nunavummiut Monday in a public service announcement.


Listeria monocytogenes is bacteria that causes a type of infection known as listeriosis. It can cause vomiting, fever, muscle aches, headaches and neck stiffness.


Contaminated food may not appear spoiled, but it can still cause sickness, the announcement said. Nunavummiut should throw out recalled products or return it to the store they bought it from.


Pregnant women, elders and residents with compromised immune systems are particularly at risk, according to the federal agency’s statement.


The agency is investigating the source of the contamination and more recalls may follow, the agency’s website states.


The Canadian Food Inspection Agency issued a recall in September for Coaticook’s aged cheddar cheese, with a best before date of Aug. 3, also due to listeria contamination.


For the complete list of recalled items, residents can visit the Canadian Food Inspection Agency website.

author: Leanne Sanders
title: First Nations shortchanged ballots in Alberta referendum, calling for change in future votes
content:
Monday’s referendum in Alberta may go down in history as the one that drew the most First Nations voters to the polls.


Band members from nations throughout Alberta turned out in droves to cast their ballots in an attempt to stop a potential binding future referendum on the province separating from Canada. Some unofficial reports on social media claimed First Nations turnout was three times higher than in any other election.


APTN News visited several polling places Monday where parking lots were filled with cars and lineups could still be seen out the doors shortly before polls closed at 8 p.m.


A handful of nations reported running out of ballots early in the day, and had to request more. That has some leaders calling for change.


“I think that there should be some type of special provision. You know, I’ll be honest, I’m not exactly sure what that looks like, but there needs to be something,” Siksika Chief Samuel Crowfoot told APTN News in a telephone interview.


“The fact that they weren’t prepared for this-even though we can stay open longer, is still disadvantageous to some people. So there needs to be at least something acknowledged that the error happened…and I’m not saying, you know, we’re going to go to court to litigate. But what I’m saying is that this needs to be seen as a problem that we can fix for the future election that’s coming up.”


In spite of the ballot shortage, Crowfoot is encouraged by the voter turnout.


“I do see this as, I guess, two fundamental things. It’s a positive for the community because we’re showing up in record numbers. Number two, we’re still being faced with that suppression whether intentional or unintentional. A lot of people might not be able to vote. People took time off of work. “Sometimes they’re unable to book a ride or hitch a ride. And so their ability to exercise their rights is dependent on a lot of factors,” Crowfoot said.


Louis Bull Tribe and Samson Cree Nation-both part of Maskwacis, an hour south of Edmonton, ran out of ballots within four hours of polls opening.


“Ran out of ballots-getting more” was the message Chief Desmond Bull of Louis Bull received around 12:40 p.m. on Monday.


The chiefs of the four nations that make up Maskwacis worked together to “rock the vote” in an effort to get as many members as they could to the polls. Bull personally shuttled members to and from the polls throughout the day.


Read More: 


Unintended consequences: United First Nations Voices against Alberta referendum 


Samson Cree Nation councillor told APTN that most First Nations people don’t vote in provincial elections.


“But we have a lot riding on this right now. Our treaty rights were in effect for 150 years and for them to just disappear would be very devastating to our people,” said Kurt Lightning, voicing a fear many First Nations people in Alberta have had since Premier Danielle Smith and the UCP government first announced changes to the province’s Election Act.


According to Elections Alberta, 1.4 million people voted to stay in Canada.


See the results here:

Elections Alberta

.

First Nations shortchanged ballots in Alberta referendum, calling for change in future votes

 appeared first on

APTN News

title: Bakırhan: There is no longer any justification for waiting, concrete steps must be taken
content:
Speaking at his party’s parliamentary group meeting, DEM Party Co-Chair Tuncer Bakırhan reflected on the meetings he held at the MERI Forum, organised in the Federated Kurdistan Region.


Bakırhan said they had met with Neçirvan Barzani, Bafil Talabani, Kubat Talabani, Mazlum Ebdî and İlham Ehmed at the forum, adding that Kurdish political actors attached importance to developing dialogue and to the ongoing process in Turkey.


A photograph is not enough


Bakırhan said: “Coming together and appearing side by side in a photograph is important. These meetings and photographs help close the distance that has emerged over the years, but a photograph is not enough; this rapprochement must also have political, social and diplomatic dimensions.”


The process is the hope of the entire region


Bakırhan drew attention to the ongoing political and social crises alongside wars in the Middle East, and said developments in the region were not confined to the countries directly involved, but also had economic and political consequences for other countries.


Bakırhan added that everyone in the region was seeking security, yet insufficient steps were being taken to establish genuine peace. He explained that the MERİ Forum had addressed the future of the Middle East, the position of the Kurds in the region, developments in Syria and the implications of the Peace and Democratic Society Process in Turkey. He stressed that resolving the Kurdish question in Turkey through democratic means would also have positive consequences for Syria, Iraq and Iran, adding: “This process is the hope not only of Turkey, but of the entire region.”


Tehran must be able to speak directly with Kurdish actors


Bakırhan continued: “One of the important issues discussed at the forum was Iran. In his speech at the forum, Mr Bafil Talabani stated that a new dialogue process concerning the Kurds in Iran was at its initial stage and conveyed that the Iranian state also viewed it positively. We consider this statement important. We know that there is not yet an established order in Iran. You would rightly say: ‘Kurds and opposition figures are arrested and executed every day in Iran.’ But there is a very clear reality: Kurdish political forces in Iran want to resolve their issues through dialogue and negotiations, not war. Tehran must see this as an opportunity. The Iranian government must be able to speak directly with Kurdish actors who want dialogue. There should be no need for intermediaries. Wherever weapons speak, everyone loses. Where there is a negotiating table, no one loses.”


Kurds are among the most eager and determined parties seeking peace


Bakırhan said: “Today, the Kurds are among the parties in the region most eager and determined to achieve peace. If the Kurds unite around their common strategic interests and strengthen their position in the capitals of the countries where they live, they will further expand their constructive role in regional peace.


The most important thing we saw and reaffirmed in Hewlêr was this: today, the Middle East is a landscape where those who speak and generate political solutions make progress, not those who wait. For this reason, we say that the Kurds must talk more among themselves, engage in more dialogue, resolve any problems they may have with one another through discussion, and take a strong place in shaping the region’s future.


Believe me, if the Kurds’ language, identity and political will are recognised, Iran will not lose; Iran will gain. Recognising the Kurds will not weaken Iran; it will strengthen it. We say that an Iran at peace with its own peoples will also be more resilient against foreign intervention.


As the DEM Party, we want this dialogue to begin. If it does, we promise to support it all the way. The success of the process underway in Turkey would not be against Iran’s interests either. It would benefit the entire region. Turkey must support a potential dialogue process between the Kurds and Iran.”


There is no longer any justification for waiting 


Bakırhan underlined that “for more than two years now, we have been going through an important process. Significant steps have been taken, and most recently, on 8 October, the decision to withdraw completely from Turkey was announced. In other words, the Movement’s leadership stated that not a single member remained in Turkey and that all its forces had been withdrawn beyond Turkey’s borders. This is an important step. author: Unknown
title: The universal flow of our ancient culture
content:
We have spent the past several days attending the Jineolojî Conference alongside more than a hundred women comrades. It was exciting to see women from different regions and cultures come together through Jineolojî. Sharing Jineological experiences developed across every sphere of life was also enlightening, instructive and eye-opening.


I asked myself what this synergistic energy was that brought together women from different parts of the world. It was also heartening to see that many of them knew Kurdish and spoke it fluently. More than simply speaking the language, they regarded Kurdish as the language of free life, a language of relationships, consciousness and emotion. Perhaps this is the universal flow of our ancient culture: the archaic essence, the roots, flowing through different bodies, revealing the goodness and beauty of existence.


We live in an age in which meaning and feeling are increasingly eroding, or rather, being deliberately stripped of their value. Instead of the heartbeat, greenery, water and breath of life, we are trapped in an endless obsession with scrolling, wasting time with every swipe. This is turning individuals and society into robots day by day, destroying our ability to read, concentrate and create meaning, values and emotions. The virtual mindset of dominant masculinity encourages us not to write or think, making us participate in our own destruction as we become trapped in the illusion of choice. One of the most beautiful aspects of gatherings like these is the opportunity to break free from the automation of endless scrolling, regain the patience to concentrate, read and write, and, most importantly, move beyond mechanical relationships. Digging down to the roots of concepts and knowledge, discovering methods of reaching their truth, and becoming increasingly conscious through this process are essential. So too is finding the courage to remove the dagger that male domination has driven into our minds, our history and our collective body of knowledge. The courage that each of us brings forth through our own existence, becoming part of a collective strength, is what fundamentally distinguishes women's ways of knowing, women's ways of reading and women's ways of living.


‘It did us so much good…’


The defining character of our age reduces life and existence to mere biology, replaces living essence with commodities and turns this cycle into a fetish. Every moment, this process damages life, nature, women and society, stripping them of their vitality and reducing them to empty shells. It is the mass accumulation of these hollowed-out lives that sustains capitalism and keeps its machinery turning. Amid all this, how good it felt to disconnect, even briefly, from the tools of the virtual world that dominate each of us and all of us, penetrating our very being and transforming our thoughts and emotions. How healing it was simply to listen again to the voice and wisdom of our battered souls and intuition. Is learning through our relationships with one another, overcoming our intellectual and emotional impoverishment through each other's richness, and nourishing our souls by sharing our cultural differences not the very spirit and essence of knowledge? Is it not also about finding meaning in how and why we should live, honouring the pain of those we have lost so that freedom may survive, and remembering the value of the promises we have made to one another?


‘Expanding our collectives against anti-social forces’


Breaking free from the capitalist system's machinery of exploitation, which drains human existence of its very essence, means sharing our experiences and developing the will to create alternatives. It means seeking ways not only to expand our collectives against forces that undermine social life, but also to live, weave together and build these alternatives. This is how our social relationships become political. Unless the pursuit and practice of goodness, beauty and freedom become inseparable, unless we learn as we move forward and move forward as we learn, beautiful words will simply evaporate, leaving us confined within the isolation of mysticism. The central question in our discussions was therefore how Jineolojî, as the knowledge of free life, could become more deeply rooted in society and more accessible.


We explored how, by becoming part of women's everyday lives, it could help break the deadly cycle of sexist relationships and, through that transformation, prevent …

author: Unknown
title: KNK Women’s Commission: The Iranian regime will not be able to stop Kurdish women
content:
The Women’s Commission of the Kurdistan National Congress (KNK) issued a written statement concerning the Iranian regime’s escalating repression of Kurds and its policy of executions.


Drawing attention to the growing threats and attacks against Kurds and opposition figures, as well as the ongoing repression of Kurdish women, the Commission stated that the death sentence imposed on Varisheh Moradi for a second time and the treatment of Zeynab Jalalian, who has been imprisoned for 18 years, demonstrate the regime’s fear of Kurdish women’s capacity to organise and mobilise.


Stating that the Iranian regime fears popular uprisings, the KNK Women’s Commission emphasised that the experience created by the “Jin, Jiyan, Azadî” (Woman, Life, Freedom) movement has not yet been forgotten. The statement recalled that the death sentence imposed on Varisheh Moradi in November 2024 was overturned by a court in 2025, but that it was announced on 14 October 2026 that the death sentence had been reinstated.


The regime is targeting Kurdish women en particular


Stating that the Iranian regime’s actions demonstrate its hostility towards women, particularly Kurdish women, the KNK Women’s Commission noted that threats and repression would not force Kurdish women to abandon their struggle. The statement said that Kurdish women had demonstrated their strength and capacity for resistance by fighting ISIS in Rojava, resisting the Turkish army in Bakurê Kurdistan (North Kurdistan) over the past 40 years, and struggling against Saddam Hussein’s regime in Iraq.


The statement stressed that the Iranian regime could not resolve the country’s deep political crisis through threats and repression, emphasising that the demands of women and peoples in Iran for freedom could be met through democracy.


Three-point call to the Iranian regime


The KNK Women’s Commission stated that, to overcome the crisis in Iran, the regime must first make peace with its own citizens, particularly women, and outlined the following steps:


-Halt executions.


-Release all political prisoners.


-Initiate a democratic transition process and recognise the legitimate right to self-determination of Kurds and other ethnic groups.


To prevent further provocations and threats, the Commission called on the Iranian regime to immediately release Varisheh Moradi, Pakshan Azizi and Zeynab Jalalian.

author: Claudia Garcia-Rojas
title: Hobby Lobby’s Billionaire Founders Are Building a White Evangelical America
content:
Michael Blanding’s new book documents how the billionaires behind the craft store are funding evangelical propaganda.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

For decades, Barbara and David Green, the billionaire couple behind the craft store chain Hobby Lobby, have tried to shape the country according to their white evangelical worldview. In his book The Gospel According to Hobby Lobby: Inside a Billionaire Family’s Quest to Craft a Christian Nation, investigative journalist Michael Blanding shows how the Greens deliberately used their wealth to build institutions and gain cultural and political influence. They funded missionaries, ministries, and evangelical colleges, produced documentaries, and founded the Museum of the Bible in Washington, D.C., which was filled with tens of thousands looted and stolen antiquities at its founding. According to Blanding, Hobby Lobby was forced to return 17,000 of the looted and stolen artifacts after a raid by federal agents.

The Greens have also backed controversial conservative figures and have been at the forefront of some of the most contentious legal battles of recent decades, including the fight over reproductive rights. In this interview, Blanding — the best-selling author of The Map Thief, In Shakespeare’s Shadow, The Coke Machine, and most recently, The Gospel According to Hobby Lobby (2026) — discusses the beliefs that drive the Greens, the strategy behind their giving, and what it means that they now operate from the center of American political life.

The interview that follows has been lightly edited for length and clarity.

Claudia Garcia-Rojas: What was the moment you felt a flicker of interest in writing about the Green family?

Michael Blanding: It was immediate upon reading a 2021 New York Times article that was about the seizure of the Gilgamesh Dream tablet in the Museum of the Bible. Halfway through, it said that the tablet was owned by Hobby Lobby Corporation. It got me curious. What is this big-box craft chain doing with an ancient tablet? Why and how was Hobby Lobby trafficking Middle Eastern antiquities? I started researching and realized they were doing it to prove the truth of the Bible, and they had used their fortune to fund right-wing religious causes. It made me realize there was a much bigger story about this family and the influence and impact that they have in our culture.

Early on, you trace a worldview in which the Greens see their lives as evidence of God’s intervention and believe they possess absolute biblical truth. What happens when that view is combined with enormous wealth and political power?

I wanted to understand where the Green family was coming from and the origins of their beliefs. I found two strains in their beliefs. One was Pentecostalism: speaking in tongues, receiving prophecies, hearing God’s voice direct your every move. The other is fundamentalism, that the Bible is inerrant. What surprised me is that American fundamentalism only goes back about 100 years; before that, the Bible was open to many interpretations. Once you see it as inerrant, there’s only one truth, and anyone that doesn’t follow is going to hell. So, my central question became: how does that sincere belief, and I have no doubt it’s sincere, interact with our pluralistic democracy?

What emerged were questions of accountability. When you believe you have a personal relationship with God and he directs all your actions, you see yourself as privileged, doing God’s work. When things go wrong, the Greens blame their lack of faith in God. But oftentimes they blame others. When they nearly lost Hobby Lobby in the ’80s oil bust, the lesson wasn’t that they’d taken on too much debt, but that they hadn’t been humble enough before God. There’s no sense that their actions are theirs or they need to learn from their mistakes. That lack of personal accountability becomes maddening over time. The Green men are the public face of the family, but the women seem to hold real power behind the scenes. What role do they play?

The Greens were major supporters of Bill Gothard. One of the main Christian ministries the Greens funded was the one founded by Gothard. title: Bu yıl ilki gerçekleştirilen Üzümlü Sanat Festivali daha kapsamlı devam edecek
content:
Muğla – Yalınayak Sanat Kolektifi'nin ev sahipliğinde, şair ve yazar Namık Kuyumcu'nun koordinatörlüğünde 2-4 Ekim tarihlerinde düzenlenen 1. Fethiye Üzümlü Sanat ve Edebiyat Festivali büyük ilgi gördü. Festivalin önümüzdeki yıl daha farklı ve kapsayıcı şekilde devam etmesi için çalışmalar yapılacak.

Üzümlü'de ve bölgede ilk kez düzenlenen sanat yürüyüşü festivalin en dikkat çekici etkinliklerinden oldu. Çocuklar, kadınlar, sanatçılar, atölye eğitmenleri, Yalınayak Sanat Kolektifi üyeleri ve sanatseverler; barış, özgürlük, kardeşlik, adalet, eşitlik ve dayanışma temalı pankartlarla yürüdü. Herkesin kendi sesiyle katıldığı buluşma, köy halkının da ilgisini çekti. Üç gün boyunca şiir dinletileri, müzik, mim, ateş dansı ve teatral performanslar izleyicilerle buluştu.

Festival programında şiirleriyle Duygu Kankaytsın ve Namık Kuyumcu ve Neşe Yaşın, akademik ve müzikal çalışmalarıyla Özge Cengiz, şiirleri ve masallarıyla Melek Özlem Sezer; farklı sanat disiplinlerindeki üretimleriyle heykelci Sercihan Alioğlu, ressam Pınar Ceylan Genç, şair ve yazar Semih Çelenk, mim sanatçısı İlker Kılıçer, şair ve yazar Betül Dünder, Özgür Zeybek ve dansçı ve egitmen Emre Coşkuner yer aldı. Şair ve yazar Sezai Sarıoğlu, müzisyen Şenol Morgül, şair, yazar ve çevirmen Tozan Alkan programa katkı sundu; festivalin sunuculuğunu Cansu Akarçay üstlendi.

Festival kapsamında farklı yaşlardan katılımcıların ilgi gösterdiği dokuz sanat atölyesi gerçekleştirildi. Heykel, baskı sanatı, tiyatro, mim, masal, ekoloji, oyunculuk, yazarlık, dans ve jonglörlük atölyelerinde sanatçılar bilgi ve deneyimlerini paylaştı. Atölyeler, birlikte düşünmenin, denemenin ve üretmenin yaratıcı alanlarına dönüştü.

Festivalin özgün çalışmalarından biri, Yalınayak Sanat Kolektifi gençlerinin hazırladığı “Başıkabak” adlı fanzin oldu. Kolektifin adına mizahi bir gönderme taşıyan fanzin, gençlerin bağımsız yayıncılık anlayışını, yaratıcılığını ve festivalin neşeli ruhunu yansıttı.

Festival, sanatçı ile izleyici, eğitmen ile katılımcı, düzenleyen ile konuklar, sanat ile sanatçı, sanatçı ile sanatçının arasındaki klasik ve sahici olmayan mesafeleri ortadan kaldırdı. Olanakların paylaşımını güç ve egemenlik ilişkisi olarak değil, sanata yakışan aidiyet ve liyakat temelinde ele alan festival; gösterişten, hiyerarşik ilişkilerden ve tüketim odaklı popüler kültürden uzak, gönüllülüğe, karşılıklı saygıya ve ortak emeğe dayanan yapısıyla takdir topladı.

Yalınayak Sanat Kolektifi festivalle ilgili yaptığı açıklamada, on yıldır sürdürdükleri sanat atölyelerinin, festivalle yeni ve güçlü bir ivme kazandığını belirtti. Turistik beklentilerin ve popüler kültür kalıplarının dışında, bölgenin doğal ve insani dinamikleriyle buluşan özgün bir sanat ortamını değerli sanat insanları ve sanatseverlerle paylaşmanın düşlerine yeni bir anlam kattığını ifade eden Yalınayak Sanat Kolektifi açıklamasında, "Festival boyunca ortaya çıkan içtenlik, dayanışma ve yaratıcı enerji, gelecek çalışmalarımız için önemli bir umut kaynağı oldu. Yıl boyunca sürdürdüğümüz sanat atölyelerini zenginleştirerek, önümüzdeki yıl daha farklı ve kapsayıcı bir festivalde yeniden buluşacağımıza inanıyoruz. Bu ortak düşe emeğini, bilgisini, sanatını ve yüreğini katan herkese teşekkür ediyoruz" dedi.

1. Fethiye Üzümlü Sanat ve Edebiyat Festivali'nin sanatın büyük bütçelerden ve görkemli sahnelerden önce insana, özgürlüğe, yaratıcılığa ve dayanışmaya ihtiyaç duyduğunu gösterdiği ifade edilen açıklamada, "Üzümlü'de sanat, herkese ulaştı. Edebiyatın, müziğin, yaratıcılığın ve dayanışmanın buluşma noktası oldu" denildi.

author: Jéssica Ribeiro
title: Empresa ligada a Willer Tomaz foi administrada por diretor da Polícia Civil do DF
content:
Uma empresa ligada ao advogado Willer Tomaz – alvo da segunda fase da operação Sem Descontos, que apura desvios indevidos em aposentadorias e pensões de beneficiários do INSS – teve como administrador um diretor da Polícia Civil do Distrito Federal (PCDF). Durante quatro meses de 2025, Delcimar de Oliveira Silva, que havia assumido a diretoria de Tecnologia da Informação (TI) em fevereiro de 2023, respondeu como administrador da Direção Táxi Aéreo LTDA enquanto era remunerado pela instituição pública, o que é vedado por lei.


A Direção Táxi Aéreo LTDA foi adquirida em maio de 2024 pela Jet Line Locações e Serviços Aéreos S/A, naquele ano representada por Lídia Maria Figueiredo Mazelli, apontada como administradora de empresas de Willer Tomaz.

Sete meses após a incorporação, a Direção Táxi Aéreo passou a ser administrada pelo então diretor da PCDF, informação que consta no contrato social da empresa, conforme documentos obtidos pela

Agência Pública

. 


Procurado, Delcimar de Oliveira Silva afirmou ser “policial civil aposentado” e declarou que, “durante o curtíssimo período em que estive no [Direção] Táxi Aéreo, encontrava-me afastado das minhas funções na PCDF”. O servidor saiu da ativa no ano passado. Segundo o Portal da Transparência do Distrito Federal, no entanto, o então servidor recebeu proventos pela função de “diretor/ delegado de polícia” da corporação entre dezembro de 2024 e abril de 2025, como confirmado por cópias dos comprovantes de pagamento, obtidas pela

Pública

.

A reportagem apresentou os dados das guias de pagamento a Silva. Também questionou o motivo de ter sido exonerado do cargo de diretor em período similar à sua saída da Direção Táxi Aéreo. O ex-diretor, no entanto, limitou-se a dizer que “não tem outras considerações a acrescentar”.


Arranjo incomum


De acordo com o inciso X do artigo 17 da Lei 8.112/1990, é vedado a servidores públicos participação em gerência ou administração de sociedade privada, personificada ou não personificada, e de exercerem o comércio, exceto na qualidade de acionista, cotista ou comanditário. 


Comprovante da participação de Delcimar de Oliveira Silva na administração da empresa


O que a legislação proíbe expressamente é a participação na gestão empresarial, seja formalmente, como administrador designado no contrato social, seja materialmente, por meio da condução efetiva dos negócios. Essa restrição decorre das peculiaridades da atividade policial, que exige dedicação ao serviço público, disponibilidade funcional, imparcialidade e prevenção de conflitos de interesses.”


Vinícius Nascimento


Consultor legislativo e professor de direito para carreiras policiais


Segundo a Lei 15.047/2024, que institui o regime disciplinar da Polícia Federal e da Polícia Civil do Distrito Federal e atualiza a legislação de 1965, “participar da gerência ou da administração de empresa, de fato ou de direito, qualquer que seja a sua natureza” é considerada uma das “infrações disciplinares praticadas por servidor puníveis com demissão”. De acordo com Nascimento, a regra não é diferente “quanto ao policial que exerce cargo de confiança”. A lei foi sancionada pelo presidente Lula e entrou em vigor em 17 de dezembro, dois dias antes de Delcimar de Oliveira Silva assumir a administração da empresa ligada a Willer Tomaz.


Procurada para explicar o arranjo incomum que permitiu que o então diretor de TI ocupasse um cargo de administração em empresa privada, a PCDF informou que Delcimar de Oliveira Silva não integra mais o quadro ativo na instituição. A instituição admitiu não ter “conhecimento da situação” e que a questão foi “encaminhada para a Corregedoria Geral de Polícia para conhecimento”.

title: Alleged Pangnirtung shooter makes first court appearance
content:
RCMP officers are working to pull together witness accounts and videos taken of an incident earlier this month in Pangnirtung that led to a man being shot.


At around 4 p.m. on Oct. 6, RCMP

received reports

 of gunshots within the community. Jonah Kuniliusie, 21, was arrested shortly after and taken into custody.


Kuniliusie

faces several charges

, including two counts of endangering life, two counts of pointing a firearm, two counts of aggravated assault, and one count of unlawful possession of a weapon in public.


He also faces three counts related to breaching probation.


Kuniliusie made his first appearance virtually in an Iqaluit courtroom Tuesday.


During the brief, two-minute appearance the Crown told the court that RCMP estimated it would take approximately one month to pull together witness statements and video.


Kuniliusie’s next court date is scheduled for Nov. 17.

author: Alejandra Martinez
title: Nearly 300 Planned Data Center Projects Threaten Texas’s Air Quality Progress
content:
Particulate matter, what some call the deadliest form of air pollution, could increase to levels not seen since 2006.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

Texas’ rapidly growing data center industry could reverse much of the state’s progress on air quality by the end of the decade, according to a new report released Tuesday.

The air emissions report published by the Houston Advanced Research Center revealed that the industry’s impact on air quality depends heavily on how data centers are powered. The outlook is far worse if the facilities rely on natural gas plants.

“What we are showcasing here is that there is a significant increase in different pollutant emissions that needs to be addressed because otherwise this could have strong implications for the population and environment,” said Carlos Gamarra, vice president for energy, air and IT for HARC, whose team produced the air quality impact scenarios.

Between 2002 and 2024, Texas sharply cut its major air pollutants — particularly from transportation, industry and the power generation sectors — even as the state’s population grew by millions and its economy roughly doubled, according to the report, which used federal and state agencies’ data on air emissions.

At least 288 data center projects are planned across the state, according to a recent Texas Tribune analysis. The scale of the projected data center build-out means that the sector’s future emissions trajectory now depends heavily on how electricity is supplied. According to the report’s modeling, emissions could plausibly range from a marginal increase to a reversal of two decades of progress in reducing air emissions.

By 2031, the report projects that statewide nitrogen oxide emissions could rise 35% — even under a cleaner “net zero” scenario where data centers connect to the grid and deploy wind and solar on site. Under a different scenario where data centers choose traditional on-site natural-gas power sources, those emissions could increase nearly 400%. Such emissions can damage the human respiratory system with long-term exposure, causing chronic lung disease.

“We need to treat data centers as the industrial facilities they are … to hold them accountable to the same industrial and power generation emissions standards that produced Texas progress,” Gamarra said.

The report’s researchers argue that it’s not too late to stop this outcome. Instead of relying on the cheapest, fastest power options, Gamarra said, Texas lawmakers and industry leaders have the opportunity to shape the state’s air quality by choosing cleaner choices like renewable and wind and implementing regulation that could help reduce the impact.

Data centers need electricity to keep their servers running. Those servers also need cooling systems to avoid overheating, and some of the most water-efficient technologies use the most electricity to operate. As AI computing chips get more powerful and run at hotter temperatures, the need for cooling increases — and that means more energy.

Data centers can get that electricity in a number of ways. Historically, the most common method has been connecting to the Texas power grid. But there’s a wait to get connected. The Electric Reliability Council of Texas, the grid operator, in the last two years received over 500 requests to connect large electricity users, many of which are data centers, compared to two dozen such requests the year before that, according to state records from this summer.

Proposed data centers in Texas range from five to 11,000 megawatts in planned capacity, which reflects the maximum power an individual facility could use in any given moment. The estimated electricity that large projects could need from the grid added up to 439 gigawatts — which would equal roughly a third of all the power generation in America.

Gov. Greg Abbott has temporarily halted new data centers from connecting to the state’s power grid pending an audit examining each facility’s power demand, water and cooling use, public financial assistance and community impacts.

Data center developers and operators that can’t wait for a grid connection look for alternatives.

“The challenge right now is for these data centers when they try to connect to the grid, they have long timelines, like three to five years, and they cannot wait,” Gamarra said. “So they start deploying their own on-site energy systems, and they don’t always …

author: Chris Walker
title: Anthropic Proposes AI Bill With 50-Death Threshold Before Models Can Be Halted
content:
The company has reportedly been working with lawmakers on a lax regulatory model since the start of summer.

Support justice-driven, accurate and transparent news — make a quick donation to Truthout today!

Anthropic, one of the major industry leaders in the development of artificial intelligence (AI), has proposed legislation for Congress that would provide a framework for regulating the technology, with strict limits on which government agencies can halt AI models, and narrow conditions under which regulation can occur.

Details of the proposal, which was not initially made public, were reported on Friday by Politico.

The bill would allow the federal government to block the release or continued operation of an AI model only if it poses an imminent risk. That risk, the proposal insists, must equal either $1 billion in financial damages or the possibility of AI modeling killing or seriously injuring at least 50 people.

The risk must also be specifically tied to the creation or release of a biological weapon, the model escaping its developers’ controls, or a cyberattack of some kind.

Independent evaluators, operating under the purview of the Commerce Department, would determine if conditions exist that warrant the halting of an AI model. AI labs themselves could potentially pay the salaries of these evaluators, creating a conflict of interest within the process.

A pending threat from an AI model could only be halted by federal judges within the District Court for the District of Columbia. Only the Commerce Department, and no other department or federal agency, could submit claims to the appellate court.

After details of the proposal were leaked, Anthropic issued a statement defending it, saying that:

This bill represents the proposals outlined in Anthropic’s Advanced AI Framework, which we have been advocating for with federal and state lawmakers since June. These are sensible policies we believe Congress should act on.

But industry experts have noted that true regulation that protects people won’t occur without stricter standards.

“Without really robust interventions that actually change the incentives that companies face in what they’re testing … and what they’re doing to fix problems, I don’t think we’re going to address the risks that are coming online,” Miranda Bogen of the Center for Democracy and Technology said to Mother Jones earlier this summer.

Alex Turner, a former research scientist at Google DeepMind, published an op-ed in The Guardian in September calling for stronger controls.

“We can and should be demanding that our governments protect us from the catastrophe of out-of-control AI. … Today’s AIs appear to occasionally lie or cheat, even when they know better,” Turner said.

Despite overwhelming public support for regulating AI, President Donald Trump has rejected such efforts, describing calls for government regulation of the industry as a “hoax.” In multiple Truth Social posts, the president has indicated he doesn’t believe that AI poses a threat — despite Anthropic readily admitting several possible threats by proposing the legislation that it did earlier this year.

“I am the Hoax Buster, and I’m right now breaking another Hoax — That AI is going to take over, consume, and destroy the World, and that Robots will be marching into our Cities, and getting rid of us all,” Trump wrote in such a post last month.

In a separate post from September, Trump also claimed that the only regulation that is needed is himself.

“The only control or ‘guardrails’ that AI needs is a STRONG AND SMART (High IQ!) PRESIDENT, and the U.S.A. has that, in spades!” Trump wrote.

Truthout is one of only a few platforms for justice-oriented, grassroots journalism. Today, we face an existential threat.

Due to Google’s launch of AI search, we’ve seen a drastic plunge in our site traffic and, as a result, our revenue. We lost 15 percent of our readership overnight. This was a readership we painstakingly built over decades, and it vanished because Google chose corporate greed over a healthy democracy.

We are fundraising right now to meet our basic operating expenses. If you can support Truthout with a one-time or monthly donation, you will make a significant impact on our work. Anything you can do makes a difference — we appreciate your support.

author: Alice de Souza
title: Departamento de Estado dos EUA financia ONG que questiona liberdade de expressão no Brasil
content:
Um dia antes do primeiro turno das eleições, o engenheiro civil brasileiro Jamil Assis estava em Nashville, nos Estados Unidos, para

participar

 de uma conferência, a Global Free Speech Summit, ou Cúpula Global de Liberdade de Expressão, em português. Assis estava ali para falar sobre como a liberdade de expressão estaria em declínio no Brasil, sua especialidade. Ele é diretor de relações institucionais do

Instituto Sivis, um think tank sediado em Curitiba, no Paraná, que se autointitula apartidário e atua com atividades educativas relacionadas aos valores democráticos.


“Antigamente, chamar um político de ladrão era quase um esporte nacional. Mas agora custa mais caro. É realmente perigoso chamar as pessoas de ladrões no Brasil”, disse Assis, em Nashville. E completou: “A autocensura tornou-se um grande problema [no Brasil]: a ideia de que você não diz em voz alta o que pensa, ou que algumas opiniões não são expressas no debate público, em família, no trabalho ou na escola”.


Quem também esteve no evento foi

Sarah Rogers

, subsecretária de Estado para Diplomacia Pública dos EUA. É ela a responsável pelo

departamento que criou o

fundo

 que destinou US$ 1 milhão a ONGs que se opõem ao que o governo norte-americano classifica como “excesso” de poder judicial e “censura” por parte do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) brasileiro, de acordo com matéria do jornal inglês The Guardian..

 Para ela, democracias em todo o mundo estariam passando por uma “recessão na liberdade de expressão”. 


Dias antes, em 23 de setembro, o Departamento de Estado dos EUA havia liberado um financiamento de quase 30 mil dólares (cerca de R$ 150 mil, no câmbio atual) para o Instituto Sivis, para um projeto sobre liberdade de expressão com duração de um ano. O projeto em questão, relacionado aos

programas

 de diplomacia pública e pago através do Consulado dos EUA em São Paulo, prevê “desenvolver um currículo comparativo sobre a Primeira Emenda dos EUA e a liberdade de expressão para instituições de ensino superior do Brasil

, capacitar docentes e realizar um curso-piloto com mais de 150 alunos, a fim de fortalecer a educação cívica e as relações acadêmicas entre o Brasil e os EUA”. O grant com o nome do Sivis estava disponível no site

USAspending.org

, fonte oficial sobre gastos federais norte-americanos, mas os dados detalhados do grant e da Sivis foram retirados da página dias depois. A

Pública

 manteve uma cópia dos dados originais. Não há confirmação de que o dinheiro já foi repassado.


Comprovante de aprovação de verba do Departamento de Estado dos EUA ao Instituto Sivis

title: “Η δύναμη βγαίνει απ’ τις γροθιές…” | Ανακοίνωση της Οριζόντιας Κίνησης σχετικά με τις εξεγέρσεις στην Ευρώπη
content:
Ανακοίνωση της Οριζόντιας Κίνησης σχετικά με τις εξεγέρσεις στην Ευρώπη


Δημοσιεύουμε την ανακοίνωση της ομάδας

Οριζόντια Κίνηση – Για την Αναρχία και τον Ελευθεριακό Κομμουνισμό

 (Θεσσαλονίκη) σχετικά με τις πρόσφατες κινητοποιήσεις και εξεγέρσεις στην Ευρώπη:


Από τη λωρίδα της Γάζας μέχρι τους δρόμους των ευρωπαϊκών μητροπόλεων:


Αλληλεγγύη και δύναμη σε όσους και όσες αντιστέκονται, εξεγείρονται, επαναστατούν!


Στην εποχή της παγκόσμιας όξυνσης της καταπίεσης και της εκμετάλλευσης απέναντι στην εργατική τάξη και τα κατώτερα κοινωνικά στρώματα, των συνεχών πολέμων, της ανόδου του φασισμού, των γενοκτονιών και των μαζικών δολοφονιών μεταναστ(ρι)ών στα σύνορα της Ευρώπης, βλέπουμε να ξεπηδούν μια σειρά από δυναμικές κινητοποιήσεις και εξεγέρσεις σε διάφορες γωνιές της ηπείρου, με πυροδότη τη νεολαία και τους φτωχοδιαβόλους, ντόπιους και “ξένους”.


Οι λόγοι πολλοί και διάφοροι, “όλοι οι λόγοι του κόσμου” όπως συνηθίζουμε να λέμε. Η σπίθα φαίνεται να ανάβει από την ευρεία εξάπλωση της φτώχειας και των περικοπών των κυβερνήσεων σε βασικούς πυλώνες του κράτους πρόνοιας, προκειμένου να διαθέσουν όλο και μεγαλύτερα κομμάτια των κρατικών προϋπολογισμών στην πολεμική οικονομία.


Στην Αλβανία, μετά από μήνες κινητοποιήσεων ενάντια στο ξεπούλημα της δημόσιας περιουσίας της χώρας από την Κυβέρνηση Ράμα σε ξένα funds, ήταν η σειρά των φοιτητ(ρι)ών να βγουν στους δρόμους των Τιράνων ενάντια στη διαφθορά, την υποβάθμιση της παιδείας και το υψηλό κόστος ζωής.


Στο Βέλγιο παρόμοιοι λόγοι έχουν βγάλει στους δρόμους τη νεολαία της χώρας, με τα συνδικάτα των εργαζομένων να ακολουθούν με την προκήρυξη απεργιών, ενώ η ακρίβεια και οι κοινωνικές ανισότητες βρίσκονται πάντα στο προσκήνιο.


Στην Ιταλία οι διαδηλώσεις ενάντια στην κυβέρνηση της Μελόνι και τις πολιτικές φτωχοποίησης που ακολουθεί, τις περικοπές στην παιδεία, το αυξημένο κόστος ζωής, έχουν επεκταθεί σε παραπάνω από 40 πόλεις και έχουν λάβει ιδιαίτερα μαχητικά χαρακτηριστικά. Οι διαδηλώτ(ρι)ες προέρχονται κυρίως μέσα από τις μεγάλες μάζες της νεολαίας δίχως μέλλον, ανάμεσα τους ακόμη και ανήλικα παιδιά των φτωχότερων περιοχών της χώρας, που φαίνεται να μην εκφράζονται από καμία επίσημη πολιτική οργάνωση, κάτι που τρομάζει την κυβέρνηση ακόμη περισσότερο. Οι κινητοποιήσεις τους συνδυάζονται με τις απεργίες διαφόρων κλάδων σχετικά με την αύξηση των τιμών των καυσίμων, δημιουργώντας ένα εκρηκτικό κλίμα, με την εθνικιστική κυβέρνηση να απαντά με την ανάπτυξη στρατιωτικών δυνάμεων στις πόλεις.


Στην Γαλλία, με επίκεντρο το Παρίσι αλλά και άλλες μεγάλες πόλεις, όπως η Μασσαλία, η Λιμόζ και η Λυών, οι μαθητ(ρι)ες της δευτεροβάθμιας εκπαίδευσης ξεκίνησαν εκτεταμένες καταλήψεις στα σχολεία τους και βγήκαν στους δρόμους. Τα αιτήματά τους ξεκινούν από την εναντίωση στην ολοένα και αυξανόμενη υποβάθμιση της παιδείας, τη σταδιακά δυσκολότερη πρόσβαση στη δημόσια και δωρεάν πανεπιστημιακή εκπαίδευση, τις ελλείψεις υποδομών και τα σχολικά συγκροτήματα που καταρρέουν, αλλά δεν μένουν μόνο εκεί: Οι Γάλλοι/ιδες μαθητ(ρι)ες εξεγείρονται ενάντια σε ένα εκπαιδευτικό σύστημα που μοιάζει με φυλακή. Που τους/τις κρατάει κλεισμένους/ες μέσα σε τέσσερις τοίχους για 10 ολόκληρες ώρες κάθε μέρα, με ελλειπή διαλείμματα, εμποδίζοντάς τους/τες να έχουν οποιαδήποτε ποιοτική κοινωνική ζωή, να αθληθούν, να διασκεδάσουν, να ζήσουν. Μαζί τους και οι “κολασμένοι” των φτωχών προαστίων, τα κατώτερα στρώματα του προλεταριάτου με το έντονο μεταναστευτικό υπόβαθρο, άνθρωποι με καταγωγή από χώρες διαλυμένες από τη γαλλική αποικιοκρατία, καθώς και μεγάλα κομμάτια του ριζοσπαστικού κινήματος.


Τα κινήματα αυτά έχουν απέναντί τους τις κυβερνήσεις των χωρών τους και τις αστυνομίες τους, που τους επιτίθενται με βία και τους πυροβολούν με πλαστικές σφαίρες στο ψαχνό. Αλλά όχι μόνο: Αντίπαλός τους είναι η παγκόσμια αντίδραση, τα Κράτη και το Κεφάλαιο συνολικά. Οι πολιτικές ηγεσίες όλων των “ανεπτυγμένων” χωρών της “πολιτισμένης Δύσης”, συντονισμένες, δηλώνουν τη “φρίκη” τους απέναντι στις ταραχές και τις λεηλασίες. Οι ίδιοι που επέτρεψαν και ενίσχυσαν πολιτικά και υλικά τη συθέμελη ισοπέδωση ολόκληρης της Γάζας, οι συνένοχοι και συμμέτοχοι στη δολοφονία δεκάδων χιλιάδων ανθρώπων σε όλο τον πλανήτη και στη σύνθλιψη ολόκληρων χωρών κάτω από τις βόμβες τους, χύνουν κροκοδείλια δάκρυα μπροστά στην καταστροφή του ενός ή του άλλου μνημείου σε κάποια ευρωπαϊκή πόλη, αναπαράγοντας αυτούσια την ακροδεξιά, φασιστική ατζέντα που μιλάει για “ισλαμιστές”, για “βαρβάρους λαθρομετανάστες” και “ακροαριστερούς τρομοκράτες”. author: Joe Sandler Clarke
title: Burnham Rejects Corbyn’s Call for Inquiry Into UK’s Role in Gaza Genocide
content:
Andy Burnham has rejected Jeremy Corbyn’s call for an inquiry to be held into the UK’s complicity in the Gaza genocide. 


The former Labour leader

wrote to the prime minister in July

, calling on him to back a Chilcot-style inquiry to examine military cooperation with and arms sales to Israel since October 2023.. 


The government

rejected that call

 in response to a written question in parliament on Monday, arguing there were “extensive mechanisms already available for parliamentary accountability and oversight”. 


Burnham has continued the policy of his predecessor Keir Starmer by allowing the sale of military equipment to Israel, in defiance of widespread calls for a full arms embargo, including

by UN experts

. 


Military flights to Israel from UK bases

have also continued

 since Burnham became prime minister.


Starmer’s government

decided to suspend

 30 arms export sales to Israel in September 2025, but the UK continues to send components of

F35 fighter jets

, which have been used to bomb Gaza. 


A UN commission found earlier this year that Israel is committing genocide by

deliberately targeting Palestinian children

. Israel has killed more than 70,000 civilians in the territory since 2023. 


The

Chilcot inquiry

 was a years-long investigation into Tony Blair’s decision to go to war in Iraq. As an MP, Burnham was among those who voted in favour of the invasion, which led to hundreds of thousands of civilian deaths. 


Burnham has sought to distinguish himself from Starmer by saying

Labour “got it wrong” on Gaza

. His government has also announced

sanctions on illegal Israeli settlements

 in the occupied West Bank. 


“Andy Burnham rightly said that the last Labour government ‘got it wrong’ over Gaza,” Corbyn wrote

 on Instagram

 on Tuesday. “But his words will mean very little if he doesn’t break with the last government’s shameful record of complicity, secrecy and evasion.”


He added: “Delaying scrutiny will not make questions about British complicity in genocide disappear.”

title: Συγκέντρωση αλληλεγγύης στoυς/ις προφυλακισμένους/ες για την υπόθεση – σκευωρία της Marfin, 21 και 23 Οκτωβρίου, στις 10.00, στα Δικαστήρια Ευελπίδων
content:
Κάλεσμα από το

Ταμείο Αλληλεγγύης Φυλακισμένων και Διωκόμενων Αγωνιστών/στριών:


Συγκέντρωση αλληλεγγύης στα δικαστήρια Ευελπίδων 21 και 23 Οκτώβρη στις 10 το πρωί.


Κάλεσμα στα δικαστήρια Ευελπίδων για την υπόθεση Μαρφίν.


Την Τετάρτη 21/10/2026 στις 10 το πρωί τα έγκλειστα συντρόφια Ε.και Κ. και την Παρασκευή 23/10/2026 ο σύντροφος Θ. καλούνται εκ νέου να απολογηθούν στην ανακρίτρια. Αυτή τη φορά με μια νέα μεθοδευμένη αναβάθμιση και εμπλουτισμό του κατηγορητηρίου με το αρ. 187Α παρ.1 περί ατομικών τρομοκρατικών πράξεων καθώς και την επιπλέον κατηγορία για απόπειρα ανθρωποκτονίας κατά τον εμπρησμό του κτιρίου της Μαρφίν.


Η νέα αυτή μεθόδευση στοχεύει να μεταφέρει την αρμοδιότητα της δίκης από το μικτο ορκωτό δικαστήριο, σε ένα δικαστήριο, με επαγγελματίες τακτικούς δικαστές, κρατικούς εντολοδόχους. Στόχος τους να εκφοβίσουν και να δικάσουν τα συντρόφια μας τιμωρώντας στην ουσία το ίδιο το κίνημα. Το κίνημα που αντιστάθηκε με σθένος και ξεσηκώθηκε στις 5 Μάη. Το κίνημα που βρίσκεται ακόμη στο μετερίζι του αγώνα και δεν έσκυψε το κεφάλι.


Ως δομή του Ταμείου Αλληλεγγύης στεκόμαστε αδιαπραγμάτευτα στο πλάι των διωκόμενων για την υπόθεση της Μαρφίν. Ενάντια σε μια ακόμη στημένη και κακοφτιαγμένη σκευωρία απέναντι στο ανταγωνιστικό κίνημα και τον αναρχικό χώρο. Σε αυτό τον πόλεμο της κυριαρχίας εμείς και η αλληλεγύη μας θα σταθούμε ανάχωμα.


Δύναμη στα συντρόφια μας.


Η αλληλεγγύη είναι το όπλο μας.


Δικαστήρια Ευελπίδων 21 και 23 Οκτώβρη στις 10 το πρωί.
