author: Julius Gavroche
title: One, two … a thousand insurrections in France
content:
An echo of “One, two… a thousand Vietnams”, which we used to shout at some Parisian demonstrations back in ’68


Tomás Ibáñez (18th of October 2026)


from

Redes Libertarias

 20/10/2026


The intense events of 17 October, with their long list of violent clashes in many French cities, show that France could not be an exception. Just as has happened in recent years in many regions of the world – from the Americas to South-East Asia, via several European countries – we have witnessed on this occasion an outburst of discontent that had been slowly building up, with hundreds of thousands of people taking to the streets and showing a determination capable of withstanding even the most forceful police crackdowns. As in so many other countries, the people who fuelled the demonstrations on this 17th of October did not do so by obeying slogans issued by large organisations, but primarily through social media, through everyday conversations circulating within the social fabric of neighbourhoods and workplaces, and also in response to calls from small organisations, without any centralising body acting as an intermediary between them.


It turns out that the absence of structures to organise and direct the demonstrations lends them a certain air of self-organisation, leaving decisions to those directly involved in the protests, spurring their creativity, and making them the protagonists of the actions undertaken. It is clear that they are not fighting to advance some supposed revolutionary project. However, they are engaging in practices that are revolutionary in the here and now because, by confronting the tremendous force of the system that their mobilisation is challenging, they are creating a climate of dissent whose short- and medium-term consequences are difficult to predict.


The international proliferation of events such as those of the 17th of October in France bears witness to the validity of those viewpoints which maintain that wherever domination tightens its grip, resistance inevitably emerges and revolt breaks out. Such views therefore predict that large-scale mobilisations will erupt sporadically, and with an apparently spontaneous character, in places where local circumstances of oppression ignite the sparks of insurrection, in some cases leading to a ripple effect in other places, but without these outbursts being the product of grand emancipatory narratives.


As is customary when the roar of discontent takes to the streets, the media prioritise the most spectacular images, which are usually those of pitched battles, fires and attacks on objects that in some way symbolise the instruments of oppression. This, combined with the comments of those in power and defenders of the established order, provokes fear and rejection amongst a large section of the population. And, as is also customary, the political parties and groups that more or less explicitly support the uprisings are quick to express their condemnation of actions labelled “violent”, when they do not go so far as to attribute them to deliberate provocations. This is what Mélenchon, for example, the leader of the party situated to the left of the Socialist Party and aligned with the Frente Amplio operating on this side of the Pyrenees, has done. If such actions occur during the protests taking place ahead of the 29 November elections, we will need to keep a close eye on how the leadership of the Frente Amplio reacts, as well as the organisations backing these strikes and protests.


It has been several years now since the peak of the “Yellow Vests” movement came to an end, but that symbol has made its mark – without quite turning them yellow – on demonstrations in various cities, and this highlights one of the most valuable outcomes of intense collective struggles: they act as a catalyst for raising awareness and, in a matter of days, forge activists who will remain so until their dying breath. Creating long-lasting, defiant and subversive subjectivities is the precious outcome of radical collective struggles, whatever their outcome may be; not to rejoice in the ferocity of the clashes and the brilliance of the flames, but to denounce them, is to do a disservice to the creation of that flow of forces of resistance to the established system that is born of the struggle.

Любопытно – или, скорее, симптоматично, – что, хотя мы непрестанно проповедуем необходимость готовиться, не только психологически, но и технически, чтобы суметь совершить то победоносное восстание, без которого невозможно свергнуть буржуазный режим и начать революцию, любопытно, что всегда находятся среди социалистов (диктаторских коммунистов), казалось бы наиболее расположенных к вооружённому действию, те, кто обвиняет нас в желании восставать вот так, спустя рукава, разрозненно, без общего согласия и без действенной подготовки.

Это предлог, чтобы сорвать любую нашу попытку сближения, чтобы избежать любого обязывающего соглашения с нами?

Можно было бы так думать, когда видишь тех, кто к заботам о восстании примешивает интерес к… административным выборам, или тех, кто, говоря, что хочет экспроприировать буржуазию и установить коммунизм завтра же, приглашает затем рабочих подчиняться правительственным декретам о страховании по инвалидности и старости.

Но есть, несомненно, и такие, чьей революционной воле можно верить, и среди них, по-видимому, Андреа Вильонго, который теперь полемизирует с нами по поводу уроков, какие можно извлечь из событий в Анконе. Но тогда почему же он берётся искажать и фальсифицировать нашу мысль?

Он поехал в Анкону… и мало понял то, что произошло. Восстание в Анконе не стало тем, чем могло бы стать, из-за внезапности, недостаточной или едва начавшейся подготовки, случайного отсутствия некоторых людей, пользующихся большим доверием среди масс и лучше сумевших бы связать и использовать доступные пролетарские силы, – но вовсе не потому, что анархисты «отказались присоединиться к созданию Комитета агитации и революционной подготовки». Комитет, к которому отказались присоединиться анархисты, не должен был быть Комитетом восстания, а комиссией, которая предполагала пойти к префекту и начать переговоры с властями.

Точно так же Вильонго ничего не понял в публичном выступлении, которую провел Малатеста в Турине, и которую он софистически пытается представить в противоречии с Симпличио. Противоречие ничего бы не значило, поскольку Umanità Nova – свободная арена для выражения любого разнообразия анархической мысли; но дело в том, что между тем, что написал Симпличио, и тем, что Малатеста сказал в Турине, – полное согласие.

Может быть, Малатеста плохо выразился?

Возможно, хотя вообще признано, что Малатеста пишет без изящества и говорит без красноречия, но всегда выражает свою мысль понятно для всех и не допускающим двусмысленностей образом.

Когда Малатеста говорил в Турине, что революцию в Италии можно будет сделать, только полагаясь на массы, поддерживая их, оставляя их свободными и так далее, речь шла не о подготовке восстания: о некоторых вещах лучше меньше говорить на выступлениях и в газетах и больше делать. Речь шла, напротив, о взятии в свои руки богатства в день победы и о реорганизации производства и общественной жизни вообще. Это было, словом, прямое действие в среде масс, использование всех способностей, всех инициатив, свободная реорганизация, осуществляемая под давлением потребностей и под толчком пропаганды и примера, – в противоположность диктатуре, которая, по мнению анархистов, не могла бы сделать ничего иного, как организовать полицию и задушить революцию.

Восстание – это другое дело. Разумеется, его делают массы, но массы не могут подготовить его технически. Нужны люди, группы, партии, связанные свободными договорами, обязанные хранить тайну, снабжённые необходимыми средствами, которые могут создать ту сеть быстрой коммуникации, необходимую для того, чтобы своевременно знать о всех событиях, способных вызвать народное движение, и для его быстрого распространения.

И когда мы говорим, что революционная организация должна …

author: Dominique Gené - Local Journalism Initiative Reporter
title: Families seek answers after Nunavik elders home residents relocated to Montreal
content:
Alaku Kululaa says she was shocked to learn her 90-year-old mother would be relocated south after building issues forced the closure of Kuujjuaq’s Tusaajiapik elders home this fall.


Originally from Quaqtaq, Louisa Inuluk Kululaa had been living at the home for approximately three years.


Alaku Kululaa said she received no written notice about the decision and that the head nurse instead verbally informed her in mid-September, about two weeks before the move was scheduled to take place.


On Sept. 30, Louisa Inuluk Kululaa was checked into the Argyle care home, located in the Montreal suburb of Point-Claire, about 1,500 kilometres away from Kuujjuaq.


“I feel so far away from her,” Alaku Kululaa said. “It is stressful not knowing how she is. Without communication, how could I know?”


Problems at the Tusaajiapik elders home have been persistent since April, when Nunavik health officials 

announced

 there were technical issues with the building’s heating system. With cold weather setting in this fall, the facility is closed and officials are

working

 to assess the cost and feasibility of fixing the problem.


Now, families are calling for better communication and assurances there will be culturally appropriate care and support for their loved ones in the south.


Alec Gordon is on FaceTime with his brother, Mark Gordon, who was relocated to Montreal.  (Photo courtesy of Alec Gordon)


Alaku Kululaa said she is concerned about language barriers because her mother is not fluent in English, as well as access to country food.


Alec Gordon shares those sentiments.


His 33-year-old brother Mark Gordon has lived with a physical disability since birth. He spent several years at the elder’s home in Kuujjuaq because there was no other suitable facility for him in the community. Mark Gordon moved into the Argyle care home on Oct. 6.


Alec Gordon travelled to Montreal to help him settle in. He said he noticed during his visit that some staff members were unfamiliar with where the residents came from, leaving relatives to explain their background and needs.


There were also problems with the travel portion itself, Alec Gordon said.


Flights and accommodations were covered for up to two support people per patient, for a maximum of seven days.


Alec Gordon said he paid for meals and transportation and expected to file his receipts for reimbursement. However, when he submitted them, he said, nobody could say which department was responsible for paying him back.


Now, he’s calling for clear procedures to allow relatives living in Nunavik to visit their loved ones.


“It’s not really our fault that we were moved south,” he said. “They should really iron out the administration part for visitors.”


Gilles Cloutier, the Ungava health centre’s community services director, said in an interview that the reimbursement issues, such as the ones flagged by Alec Gordon, would be resolved but did not specify when or whether all expenses would be covered.


“We don’t wish to transfer our clients outside of the region. It’s really heartbreaking. But, be sure that we will do everything that we can to facilitate those things,” he said.


Cloutier acknowledged that families were verbally notified about the impending move, and staff only had access to family listed on residents’ files and those who visited most often, which meant it’s possible information did not reach all family members.


“If the person doesn’t share the information, we’re a bit trapped,” he said.


Cloutier added that he believes all families were notified of the problem in April, when the heating malfunction first occurred.


To improve communication, Cloutier said a social worker will be hired to share updates about residents’ care, well-being and adjustment to the facility. He added families can contact the Argyle home or cultural safety staff at Ungava Tulattavik Health Centre for information about residents.


Three cultural worker positions have been created for Argyle’s Nunavik unit, and one had their first day last week, the health board said in an unsigned email to Nunatsiaq News.


These hires will speak both Inuktitut and English and will help interpret between residents and healthcare staff.


Residents also have access to electronic tablets to facilitate video calls.


Food safety regulations restrict facilities from serving traditionally harvested meat unless it comes from approved suppliers, the email said. The facility serves bannock and tea daily …

author: Mada Masr
title: The future of rule: More questions than answers
content:
It took four days of successive presidential reiterations before the various parties began to grasp that, this time, it is different.


And no wonder. Never in Egypt’s modern history has the head of state chosen to hand power over voluntarily. President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi himself

promised

, time and again, during his first term that he would not move to amend the constitution and extend his rule. That changed at the start of his second term, when the constitution was in fact amended, and he secured two further terms, keeping him in office until 2030.


That’s why when the president opened his speech at the Armed Forces’ educational seminar on Wednesday by announcing he would not extend his rule, the confusion was plain on all sides, state institutions included.


At the seminar, Sisi said he had no intention of amending the Constitution. The audience hesitated for a few seconds before applauding. And many people

noticed

.


The next day, he stated the announcement in clearer terms. But the statement, issued by the presidential spokesperson, was edited, changing “until 2030” into “until the last day of his rule.” There is a big difference between the two formulations. The latter preserves a measure of vagueness, which some apparently felt was needed until things became clearer.


Sisi alluded to this confusion on Saturday, at the Egyptian Military Academy’s first cohort graduation ceremony, when he spoke of wishes relayed by pro-government media figures to delay announcing his decision for the sake of “the state.” But according to Sisi’s speech, broadcast on live television, what “the state” actually needs is an early announcement that opens the door to a continuing journey to prepare “a replacement.”


And so, without any equivocation, Sisi announced his decision to leave office in 2030. And at the same time, he sketched the contours of a roadmap for the transfer of power and of the role he expects to play during this period and, perhaps, even after power passes to a new president.


Mada Masr spoke to sources who all point to the widespread state of confusion brought about by the president’s announcement, but they also say that what he is proposing amounts to a radical change in the form and nature of rule in Egypt, one the country may have never seen before.


Three informed sources agree that the president is managing the details of his exit from power with a “very narrow circle that sits outside the [state] agencies.”


A political source close to one of the sovereign agencies says the vagueness created by Sisi’s first two announcements led some people affiliated with state entities or institutions to volunteer initiatives expressing their rejection of the president leaving power, as a precaution, “for fear of appearing to go along with the matter of his departure,” in the absence of security guidance. Those attempts stopped completely after the latest announcement, he adds.


The lack of guidance, according to the source, stemmed from the fact that Sisi’s announcement caught the leaders of the various sovereign agencies off guard. They were hearing the details of his roadmap for the first time, he says.


That surprise pushed the different agencies to hold emergency meetings that same evening to discuss the announcement, the source adds.


A second politician close to one of the sovereign agencies points to a state of confusion and worry within the security apparatus, which now faces a new reality with no plan on how to deal with it, given the absence of any coordination between the presidency and the agencies before the announcement.


One reason for that worry, according to the first source, is the fear that society would take these statements as a sign of greater political openness and more room for opposition. The agencies would then be left with resolving that situation, either on their own or after receiving orders from above, the source says.


As a senior government official speaking to Mada Masr puts it, “the heads of the agencies can’t figure [Sisi] out or know what he wants.”


But confusion aside, all parties now face a new reality of which only sparse details are clear: how Sisi envisions managing this transitional phase and guaranteeing the handover.


In his Saturday speech, Sisi pointed to Article 200 of the

Constitution

, which sets out the Armed Forces’ duties. Since the 2019 amendments, those duties include “uphold[ing] the Constitution and democracy” and “preserv[ing] the key tenets …

content:
Κάλεσμα/αφίσα από

Ανοιχτή συνέλευση για την κρατική δολοφονία του Κώστα Μανιουδάκη

:


Καμία δίωξη στον κόσμο του αγώνα


Τετάρτη 14 Οκτωβρίου & Τετάρτη 21 Οκτωβρίου | 09:00 | Δικαστήρια Χανίων


Από το καλοκαίρι του 2024, οι 4 μπάτσοι δολοφόνοι του Κώστα Μανιουδάκη έχουν κατηγορηθεί για ανθρωποκτονία με ενδεχόμενο δόλο σε ήρεμη ψυχική κατάσταση από κοινού. Μόλις τους τελευταίους 10 μήνες, η υπόθεση ξυλοδαρμού μέχρι θανάτου του Κωστή προχώρησε στην κύρια ανάκριση και ολοκληρώθηκε, επιβάλλοντας στους δολοφόνους απαγόρευση εξόδου από τη χώρα και εγγυήσεις 20.000€ για τους 2 μπάτσους και 5.000€ για τους άλλους 2. Οι μπάτσοι δολοφόνοι παραμένουν στις θέσεις τους, ένοπλοι, ενεργώντας μέχρι και σήμερα «τυχαίους» ελέγχους.


Η ανοχή και η επιβράβευση του κράτους στα δολοφονικά εγκλήματα των ένστολων φονιάδων του, έρχεται (και) μέσω του δικαστικού συστήματος: μέχρι και σήμερα, τους έχει δώσει το ελεύθερο να μηνύουν με κάθε τρόπο τον κόσμο που αγωνίζεται, από τους συγγενείς του Κωστή μέχρι τα μέλη της ανοιχτής συνέλευσης. Αντί, λοιπόν, να προχωράει ο προγραμματισμός της δίκης για ανθρωποκτονία από πρόθεση, προχωράνε οι μηνύσεις που κάνουν οι ίδιοι οι δολοφόνοι. Περιττό να πούμε πως στην περίπτωση που στη θέση των μπάτσων, κατηγορούνταν κάποιος «φτωχοδιάβολος», οι διαδικασίες θα κινούνταν με γρήγορους ρυθμούς.


Καλούμε σε συγκεντρώσεις αλληλεγγύης στα δικαστήρια: στις 14/10 για τον αδερφό του Κωστή, τον οποίο μήνυσε η Κ. Μόσχου επειδή «την προσέβαλε στο διαδίκτυο», και στις 21/10, για τα 4 μέλη της ανοιχτής συνέλευσης που μήνυσε ο Μ. Γεωργιάδης το 2024, επειδή όταν τον είδαν να σκίζει τις αφίσες μας και, χωρίς να γνωρίζουν ποιος είναι, τις υπερασπίστηκαν. Για την τελευταία μάλιστα μήνυση, έχουν οριστεί τους προηγούμενους μήνες 3 δικάσιμοι στις οποίες ο Γεωργιάδης δεν εμφανίστηκε.


Να τεθούν άμεσα σε διαθεσιμότητα οι τέσσερις μπάτσοι δολοφόνοι


Στέλιος Λιανιδάκης, Μανώλης Γεωργιάδης, Κωνσταντίνα Μόσχου και Σήφης Τσιχλάκης

title: Эррико Малатеста - «Чем хуже, тем лучше»
content:

Det Anarkistiska Biblioteket (sv)

В полемике очень удобно – и потому очень распространено – когда хотят создать видимость правоты, приписать противнику нелепость, а затем триумфально её опровергнуть.

Разумеется, если это и удобно, то от этого оно не становится честным; но скрупулезность не беспокоит некоторых журналистов и некоторых ораторов.

Так со мной не раз случалось: мне приписывали теорию чем хуже, тем лучше, и вот теперь мне попадается на глаза газета Lavoro из Генуи (20.06.1920), где, воспроизводя мою статью, урезанную с умыслом, чтобы извлечь из неё выводы, противоположные моим намерениям, утверждается, что чем хуже, тем лучше – теория «определенно анархическая».

А истина в том, что эта теория, если уж на то пошло, марксистского происхождения, и если некоторые анархисты могли её когда-то утверждать, то лишь потому, что поддались влиянию марксистских идей, а вовсе не потому, чтобы она имела какое-либо отношение к анархизму как таковому.

Марксисты, которые понимают – или по крайней мере понимали – общественную эволюцию как управляемую фатальными и неотвратимыми законами, те, кто ждал социальных преобразований от предполагаемой автоматической концентрации капитала в руках всё меньшего числа капиталистов, те, кто провозгласил как всеобщую и неизбежную истину растущую нищету, – могли вполне радоваться, если положение пролетариата ухудшалось.

Мы – нет; потому что для нас главный фактор, определяющий направление общественной эволюции, – это человеческая воля; и поэтому мы поддерживаем всё, что развивает и укрепляет волю, и отвергаем всё, что её подавляет.

Если бы мы захотели – а это опасно – свести в одну формулу наши взгляды на вопрос о влиянии материальных условий на нравственное развитие индивидов и, следовательно, на их волю, мы вместо чем хуже, тем лучше сказали бы скорее аппетит приходит во время еды.

Нищета подавляет и отупляет, и из-за нищеты революций не делают; в лучшем случае устраивают бунты, короткие, что не доживают до следующего дня. И именно поэтому мы побуждаем рабочих требовать и навязывать все возможные и невозможные улучшения, и не хотели бы, чтобы они смирились с плохим сегодняшним днём в ожидании будущего рая. И если мы против реформизма, то вовсе не потому, что нам безразличны частичные улучшения, а потому, что мы считаем: реформизм – препятствие не только революции, но и самим реформам.

Кто смиряется со злом, тот в конце концов привыкает к нему и перестаёт чувствовать его тяжесть. В доказательство – тот факт, что обычно самые бедные области и самые нищие категории пролетариата являются и наименее революционными.

Обострение нищеты, большой промышленный и торговый кризис может вызвать восстание и стать отправной точкой социальных преобразований, потому что он ударяет по людям, привыкшим к относительному благополучию и плохо переносящим ухудшение. Ибо если движение не произойдёт сразу и будет упущено время, необходимое для того, чтобы народ постепенно привык к более низкому уровню жизни, то наступившая нищета утратит своё революционное значение и останется лишь причиной подавленности и отупения.

И положение в Италии сегодня столь явно революционно именно потому, что условия пролетариата улучшились, его притязания соответственно выросли, а между тем нынешнее состояние национальной экономики таково, что при сохранении существующего государственного и капиталистического порядка крупное, близкое ухудшение неизбежно.

Сегодня – либо революция и вместе с ней переустройство производства в пользу всех, либо унизительная нищета. А пролетариат находит, что нищеты и так уже слишком много.

author: unoffensiveadmin
title: TWO HENS LIBERATED FROM A BARN.
content:
Summer, Utah USA.


received anonymously via email:


“On a hot summer morning at a Utah cage free farm, after some surveillance, we were able to identify entrances into the massive death prisons, but quickly realized numerous humans were nearby and entering our building of choice. We pivoted and moved to the furthest shed away and quickly entered. Upon entering, we found hundreds of chickens crammed together, some of them dead stuck underneath metal beams.


When grabbing these chickens, we expected to be met with fear and resistance. Instead we met 2 gentle birds who had seemingly given up on their lives, knowing nothing but suffering and pain. We like to imagine they both willingly got into my arms, knowing we were there to help bring them into a better world, but we think its far more likely that they felt they had nothing to struggle or fight for. They were docile and quiet towards us while being transported despite knowing nothing from humans but cruelty.


We say to those watching and listening, are you not horrified when you see the countless images of animal cruelty? Does your heart, when faced with the images of their torment, not also feel total repulsion and an obligation to act? Now is the time. All you need is an address, a vehicle, and the will to act. Right now there is an animal – whether that be a cow, pig, chicken, mink etc. that could be spared of these human evils and live lives of freedom and safety. They are counting on simple every day people like you and me to go outside of our comfort zones and to save their lives. We are not heroes. If it takes a hero to simply do the right thing when it is needed, then what is a hero? Our animal brothers and sisters needed us yesterday. Hear their cries, see their anguish, and let it guide you to their freedom. Do not let fear of capture guide your heart. Now is the time to liberate in whatever way you can. Now is the time.”

author: Joe Sandler Clarke
title: UCL Urged to Lower Fees for Students Trapped in Gaza
content:
Five Palestinian students who won places at University College London (UCL) could miss out on their studies and remain stuck in Gaza because their scholarships don’t cover the cost of their fees. 


The students have been offered Global Masters Scholarships from UCL worth £15,000 but still can’t afford the remainder as they are being charged international fees, which can be over £40,000.


The UK government has agreed to help Gazan students offered places at UK universities leave the territory and get visas. But this support is limited to those with fully funded scholarships covering both fees and living costs.


That means students with offers who lack full scholarships will have to get out of the territory without UK government help. 


As Gaza has no airport and its coastline is blockaded by the Israeli military, anyone looking to leave the territory has to do so via a third country, creating administrative hurdles for the students. 


Last year, advocacy

groups who assisted Gazan students coming to the UK with the immigration process described the process as “chaos”

. Some students ended up not arriving until December, months into their course. 


The campaign group UCL Action for Palestine has set up a fundraiser for the students that has

so far raised £50,000

. 


They are

calling on UCL to waive international fees for Gazan students and charge them home fees

 instead. Typically, home fees are reserved for UK residents and Irish citizens but there are exemptions. Students from Ukraine, for example,

are eligible

. 


“This is not a radical ask,” UCL Action for Palestine told Novara Media. “If UCL cared about Palestinian students, they would be trying to remove the barriers that stand in the way of them having a real opportunity to study at our university, not kicking the can down the road and promising to do better next year.”


A spokesperson for UCL said the university does not comment on individual student circumstances, but noted that over the last two years, it “has worked extensively to support students from Gaza through a combination of scholarships, philanthropic funding, accommodation, immigration support and specialist wellbeing services.” 


They added: “We continue to work closely with offer holders to understand their circumstances and explore what support may be available to them.


“We are currently reviewing our humanitarian scholarship provision to consider whether, and how, support could be expanded in future years. As part of that work, we are carefully considering how best to support students affected by conflict and humanitarian crises.” =


The five students are Mais, Reem, Amjad, Reham and Farah. They are due to start master’s degrees in public health nutrition, civil engineering, sustainable education, urban planning and project management, respectively.

author: Daron Letts
title: Iqaluit RCMP investigate elders’ van vandalism
content:
RCMP are investigating after vandals targeted the Iqaluit Elders Home Sunday.


Officers responded to a report Sunday shortly after 6:30 p.m. about rocks being thrown at the elder’s facility and the van. The incident resulted in a broken window in the van used by the home to transport residents.


The van’s broken window had been temporarily repaired with tape on Monday.


If no suspects are identified, the investigation will be concluded, RCMP spokesperson Sgt. George Henrie said in an email to Nunatsiaq News.


The file can be reopened if police receive new information, he added.


The Nunavut government-run elders home is located on Queen Elizabeth II Way and has eight beds for seniors who require lower levels of assisted care.


Staff at the home declined to comment.

author: Charlotte Reck
title: Wife of UK National Security Advisor Slams Palestine Action Ban
content:
The wife of the government’s national security advisor has called for the ban on Palestine Action to be lifted, days after police said they would take no action over a social media post she wrote that was seen by some as an expression of support for the group. 


Last week Sarah Helm, a journalist and author,

wrote

 on X: “God help us authors who support Palestine and Palestine Action.” The post was a reference to the fact Irish novelist Sally Rooney can no longer sell her books in the UK due to her support for the group. 


On Monday, after the police’s announcement about her post, Helm

wrote

 that she was “free… and found not guilty of posting a terrorist tweet, whereas others guilty of holding terrorist banners? So where do I sign the letter calling for such absurdity to halt and for Palestine Action to be unbanned under the Terrorism Act?”


Helm was referring to an

open letter signed by over 400

literary figures in support of Rooney and calling for the ban to be lifted. 


The Metropolitan Police on Saturday said specialist officers had assessed Helm’s earlier X post and “determined that it did not meet the criminal threshold”.


Helm’s husband, Jonathan Powell, has served in his senior Cabinet Office role since 2024.


After its proscription under the Terrorism Act 2000 in July last year, expressing support for Palestine Action is a criminal offence punishable by up to 14 years in prison. 


Thousands, including many elderly and disabled people, have been arrested while holding signs reading: “I oppose genocide. I support Palestine Action.”


Following the Met’s decision to take no action against Helm, George Sheldon Grün, a Green councillor in Hackney, published a post on Instagram reading: “God help us councillors who support Palestine and Palestine Action.” 


Last year, retired head teacher

Jon Farley

 was arrested in Leeds under the Terrorism Act for holding a printout of a cartoon from Private Eye that mocked the Palestine Action ban. He was held for six hours before being told no further action would be taken. 


“I couldn’t quite believe it was happening,” he told the BBC at the time. “They carried me to the van and all the way I’m saying, ‘It’s a cartoon from Private Eye. This is daft'”.


In July 2025, armed police in Kent threatened to arrest peaceful protester

Laura Murton

 for holding a Palestine flag and having signs that read “Free Gaza” and “Israel is committing genocide”. 


Police told Murton that her protest expressed views supportive of Palestine Action, even though her signs

did not mention the group

. They made her give her name and address in order to avoid arrest. 


Earlier this year, campaigners said police arrested people

who had not broken the law

 by showing or stating support for the group during a demonstration outside Westminster magistrates’ court.


“I clapped. That was it,”

one woman,

title: Kobanê Museum becomes shelter for displaced residents
content:
Following the historic resistance in Kobanê, 70 percent of the city was completely destroyed. Part of Kobanê was left as it was, preserved as a museum for future generations: houses reduced to rubble and rooms without doors or windows.


Today, those ruins have become a shelter for many families. Displaced residents have been forced to move to Kobanê and settle there. Many of them come from Girê Spî, Raqqa and other areas from which people have been displaced. For years, these residents have been living among the ruins, holding on to the hope that one day they will return to their homes.


 


They have no choice but to live among the rubble in order to survive. Displaced residents living in the Kobanê Museum spoke to ANF about their hopes and desire to return.


A woman named Emîne Casim Qadir explained that they had been forced to leave Girê Spî eight years ago. She recounted their experience in the following words:


“When we left Girê Spî, we had to move to schools in the Xerabhişkê area. Later, we were told that there was a camp in the Til El Semin area, near Eyn Îsa, for people coming from Girê Spî, so we stayed in those tents. In summer, we lived in the scorching heat inside the tents; in winter, we endured the cold and rain.


“More recently, my husband, my children and I had to set out on the road once again, and we came to Kobanê. At first, we stayed in schools, but we have now been living in the museum for more than five months. Although all the houses are destroyed, we have no choice but to stay here. Our financial situation does not allow us to go and buy a house. That is why the museum has become a shelter for us.”


Speaking about her family of six, Emîne Casim Qadir said:


“Our rooms are very cold, and my children are very young. It will rain every day in winter. A few days ago, when it rained, water flooded our homes. We also need a stove to get through the winter, but fuel prices are so high that many families cannot afford it. We just want to return to our homes. That is our only wish.”


Zêno Mûsê, a resident of Raqqa, said that they had been forced to leave the places where they lived several times. She said:


“We want to return to our homes now. My family and I came from Raqqa. Now we are living among ruined houses. The hardships we are facing are immense.”


Describing their difficult circumstances, Zêno Mûsê explained that the family had no choice but to live among the rubble. She said:


“We want to go back. We must be enabled to return to our homes safely. Our children are very young. A solution must be found to this situation.”

title: YPJ remains an autonomous force in integration talks
content:
The Command of the Women’s Protection Units (YPJ) issued a statement on recent developments and the new process, declaring that “in discussions and assessments regarding the integration process, the YPJ has secured its place as an autonomous and distinct force.”


The YPJ’s statement reads as follows:


“Having a significant history and a strong stance in the fight against terrorism and the protection of humanitarian values, the Women’s Protection Units (YPJ) are informing the public, particularly our people, about recent developments and the new process. As part of efforts to establish regional stability and build a secure future, discussions and assessments regarding the integration process are ongoing. In this process, the YPJ is maintaining its place as an autonomous and distinct force.


The YPJ is not merely a military force; it is also a symbol of women’s will and labor. Therefore, comprehensive discussions are continuing regarding the details of participation and the YPJ’s role in the new structure, with the fundamental aim of preserving women’s identity, experience, and achievements. As the YPJ, we emphasize that our guiding principle at every step is to protect the achievements of our people and the legitimate rights of women. The outcomes of these discussions will be publicly announced in the coming period.”

title: Genç: The government tries to avoid the issue of Mr. Öcalan
content:
Two years after the launch of the Peace and Democratic Society Process and two months after the Framework Law was passed by parliament, the government's failure to take the necessary steps has caused discontent within the Kurdish Freedom Movement. In successive statements, the Co-Presidency of the Executive Council of the Kurdistan Communities Union (KCK) and the Movement's leadership once again emphasised that recognition of Kurdish People's Leader Abdullah Öcalan's political status as the chief negotiator in the process, and the establishment of conditions in which he can live and work freely, are their red lines. However, shortly after these statements, Mehmet Uçum, Chief Adviser to the President and Deputy Chair of the Presidential Legal Policies Board, told the press: “His status as a convicted prisoner will not change, nor will the serving of his sentence be suspended. Let us say Öcalan is appointed as a coordinator in the Subcommittee on Disarmament and Political Participation. Such an appointment would be nothing more than a working arrangement enabling him to fulfil his role in eliminating terrorism, in line with the perspective of integration with the state and society.” His remarks once again exposed the contradiction in the government's approach to the issue.


Journalist Yüksel Genç, coordinator of the Centre for Political and Social Research (SAMER) and a member of the 1999 Peace Group, spoke to ANF about Uçum's remarks. Genç said, “Uçum's statements once again demonstrate just how wide the gap remains between the Kurdish movement and the government. The tendency of certain figures who speak on behalf of the government, such as Uçum, to evade responsibility and adopt a condescending tone on this issue is effectively leading to an abuse of the goodwill Kurdish political representatives have demonstrated throughout this process.”


‘The government is trying to make Mr. Öcalan’s status invisible’


Yüksel Genç recalled that since the beginning of the Peace and Democratic Society Process, the Kurdish Political Movement has maintained that Kurdish People’s Leader Abdullah Öcalan must be recognised as the principal figure responsible for carrying out the process and provided with conditions in which he can live and work freely, in order to realise the declared paradigm of transitioning from armed struggle to democratic politics. Genç pointed out that the Kurdish movement formalised this position through its congress decisions on 12 May 2025, meaning that the demand for Abdullah Öcalan to be able to live and work freely also represents a decision taken by the organisation itself. Genç recalled that both the leaders of the People's Alliance, comprising the Justice and Development Party (AKP) and the Nationalist Movement Party (MHP), and representatives of the state had emphasised the importance they attached to the congress. Genç said: “Devlet Bahçeli even said at the time that one wing of the bird had been completed and that it was now time for the second wing. He also expressed his expectations regarding the reforms the government needed to undertake and the legal and political will it needed to demonstrate. However, while the Kurdish Political Movement has, from the very beginning, presented the recognition of Mr. Öcalan's status as chief negotiator and his ability to work under free conditions as a fundamental position and a requirement for conflict resolution, the government has continued to make this issue invisible and to keep Mr. Öcalan's status close to that of an ordinary convicted prisoner throughout the process. We have even witnessed periods of isolation despite the ongoing process. For example, there were no meetings with Mr. Öcalan for two months before the law was passed. Now the Imrali Delegation can visit him only once a month. Family visits cannot take place freely. Visits by friends and other people from outside are not permitted in the way they are for other prisoners. This demonstrates that, despite some minor relaxation of the conditions on Imrali, the state remains determined to maintain the special regime there in practice. Mr. Öcalan's status is being kept somewhere between the special regime on Imrali and the status of an ordinary convicted prisoner. The fundamental decisions concerning his conditions remain dependent on the political will of the government and the state. There has been a very significant gap between the two sides on this issue since the beginning of the process, and …

Über 500 Verletzte beim 5. Bundesuniversitätsmarsch am 15. Oktober in Argentinien: Milei lässt Unis ausbluten und Proteste brutalst niederknüppeln 


Proteste in Argentinien gegen Mileis Sparpolitik an Unis


„

Zehntausende Menschen haben am vergangenen Mittwoch in Buenos Aires erneut gegen die Sparpolitik des ultrarechten Staatspräsidenten Javier Milei an den öffentlichen Hochschulen protestiert. Zu dem fünften Bundesuniversitätsmarsch (quinta Marcha Universitaria Federal) hatten Universitäten und Gewerkschaften gemeinsam aufgerufen. Ihre Hauptforderung ist, die im Universitätsfinanzierungsgesetz vorgeschriebenen Lohn- und Budgeterhöhungen umzusetzen. Einige Losungen waren: „Hör Milei, befolge das Gesetz“ und „die öffentliche Universität ist nicht das Problem, sondern ein Teil der Lösung“. (…) Laut der Zeitung Tiempo Argentino reagierten die Ordnungskräfte kurz nach Beginn der zentralen Kundgebung mit „brutaler und unverhältnismäßiger“ Repression. Sie versuchten, die Menschenketten mittels Tränengas und Gummigeschossen „aufzubrechen“. Nach Zählung der Comisión Provincial por la Memoria wurden mindestens 550 Personen, darunter 16 Mitglieder der Organisation und Pressevertretende, von Tränengasgranaten, Gummigeschossen und chemischer Munition getroffen. Laut der Tageszeitung Página/12 hatten sich auch Provokateure unter die Demonstrierenden gemischt, die den „Sicherheitskräften“ in die Hände spielten, aber meist gut erkennbar waren. (…)


Die Demonstrierenden beharrten auch auf den „historischen Säulen des argentinischen Universitätsmodells“: Gebührenfreiheit, Autonomie, Mitbestimmung und flächendeckende Präsenz der Universitäten als Orte für sozialen Aufstieg. Sie kritisierten, dass der von der Regierung Mileis vorgelegte Haushaltsentwurf für 2027 für die öffentlichen Universitäten der niedrigste in der Geschichte sei – er umfasst weniger als ein Prozent des BIP und sieht weiter keine Mittel zur Umsetzung des Universitätsfinanzierungsgesetzes vor. Demgegenüber fordert der Nationale Interuniversitäre Rat (CIN) eine Erhöhung des offiziellen Entwurfs um 33,4 Prozent

…“

content:
İstanbul Büyükşehir Belediyesi (İBB) Şehir Tiyatroları, sezonun dikkat çeken yapımlarından "Yenilmez" oyunuyla 11. Adana Şehir Tiyatroları Festivali'ne konuk oldu. Adana seyircisinden yoğun ilgi gören festivalin açılış oyunu, sanatseverlere unutulmaz bir gece yaşattı.

Torben Betts’in yazdığı, Nazlı Gözde Yolcu’nun çevirdiği ve Nihat Alpteki’nin yönettiği oyun, 19 Ekim 2026 tarihinde Adana Şehir Tiyatroları Sahnesi'nde sahnelendi. Gösterime Adana Büyükşehir Belediyesi Tiyatro Şube Müdürü Ozan Aksu, Adana Şehir Tiyatrosu Genel Sanat Yönetmeni Seyfettin Süha Erol, İBB Şehir Tiyatroları Müdürü Oytun Askeroğlu, Genel Sanat Yönetmeni Yardımcısı Emrah Özertem, Müdür Yardımcısı Berna Beyazkılınç Tezcan ve Yönetmen Nihat Alpteki ile çok sayıda sanatsever katıldı.

Güçlü oyuncu kadrosu, etkileyici dekoru ve kostümleriyle dikkat çeken oyun, gösterimin ardından dakikalarca ayakta alkışlandı. Programın sonunda Adana Büyükşehir Belediyesi Tiyatro Şube Müdürü Ozan Aksu, sanata ve festivale katkılarından ötürü İBB Şehir Tiyatroları Müdürü Oytun Askeroğlu’na plaket takdim etti. Aksu, İstanbul'dan gelen ekibi ağırlamaktan duydukları memnuniyeti dile getirdi.

Ekonomik kriz nedeniyle Londra'dan İngiltere'nin kuzeyindeki küçük bir kasabaya taşınan Oliver ve Emily çiftinin, taşralı komşuları Alan ve Dawn'ı evlerine davet etmesiyle başlayan trajikomik ve sarsıcı olayları konu alan "Yenilmez"de Gizem Akkuş, Gökçer Genç, Nurdan Kalınağa ve Tankut Yıldız rol alıyor.

title: Albania: “non ci fermiamo”. Cronache dalla rivolta.
content:
Domenica 18 ottobre 2026.

 Quinta giornata di rivolta a Tirana. Oggi, lungo il boulevard principale, è stata letteralmente una battaglia durata oltre cinque ore. Il corteo parte a metà mattinata con l’obiettivo di raggiungere l’edificio del primo ministro. Oggi la polizia inizia la giornata sparando proiettili di gomma ad altezza d’uomo, con i fucili, o appostata su palazzi. E poi i soliti idranti, le cariche, il liquido urticante e i gas. Il corteo resiste, avanza.


Ore e ore di avanzamenti e arretramenti. Finché la polizia non comincia ad arretrare. E arretra, e arretra, e arretra. Ricorda la storica cronaca degli scontri seguiti allo sgombero del Leoncavallo a Milano. Solo che qui sono riot che vanno avanti da cinque giorni, tutto il giorno, per l’autonomia di un popolo. Un idrante viene dato alle fiamme con le molotov. La folla, oggi oceanica, esulta da cima a fondo: l’edificio del primo ministro è raggiunto, tra fuochi d’artificio celebrativi… sparati sull’antisommossa. Dopo ore e ore di battaglia, nel tardo pomeriggio il corteo comincia lentamente a sciogliersi. Ma gruppi sparsi (e nutriti) di manifestanti continuano i riot. Banche assaltate, sedi di compagnie e multinazionali devastate. I commercianti e le attività locali non vengono toccati: nel mirino le compagnie riconducibili agli oligarchi locali e ai milionari stranieri. Le guardie, ormai fuori controllo, fanno caroselli con i mezzi pesanti e ronde armate per le strade; i manifestanti contrattaccano. In queste ore è ancora guerriglia. E lo Stato ha appena schierato il corpo speciale antiterrorismo e antisommossa, tra i più preparati e violenti d’Europa nella repressione.


Ma da Tirana, racconta sia chi è in strada e che chi sostiene la rivolta, oggi è il giorno più bello dell’anno. Prime linee di ragazze e Ultras, militanti e popolo “comune”. E le giornate migliori devono ancora arrivare. La Gen Z e la Gen Alpha nelle strade, dice chi è al fianco della protesta, rappresentano l’ultima speranza per strappare il Paese agli sfruttatori e agli oppressori. L’ultima speranza di salvezza. Diciannovenni diventati virali, con i passamontagna e le maschere antigas, raccontano che lo fanno per sé sì per sè, ma anche e soprattutto per la propria famiglia, per il proprio Paese. “Io lavoro 12 ore al giorno, ho 19 anni, lavoro da quando ne avevo 15”. “Io sono in strada perché le mie sorelle, i miei cugini, i miei genitori sono all’estero, costretti all’emigrazione. Ora basta”. Un ragazzo con la leucemia dice:” non so quanto avrò da vivere ma sarò qui fino alla fine”. Ci si gioca tutto nelle strade, dopo decenni di privazione e negazione, e la promessa è una sola: “non ci fermiamo”

title: Altın Portakal Film Festivali: Antalya Film Forum’da seçki tartışması
content:
Antalya Altın Portakal Film Festivali kapsamında düzenlenen Antalya Film Forum'a başvuran 18 sinemacı, projelerin eşit koşullarda değerlendirilmediği iddiasıyla ortak bir

bildiri

 yayımladı.


Bu yıl 63'üncüsü düzenlenecek Uluslararası Antalya Altın Portakal Film Festivali, 24-31 Ekim tarihleri arasında gerçekleştirilecek. Festival kapsamında düzenlenen Antalya Film Forum, sinema projelerinin değerlendirildiği ve desteklendiği bir etkinlik. Forum bünyesindeki Pitching Platformu ise henüz çekim aşamasına geçmemiş uzun metraj kurmaca film projelerine destek sağlamayı amaçlıyor.


Sinemacılar, Vimeo ve YouTube üzerinden paylaştıkları bazı başvuru videolarının izlenme sayılarının sıfır göründüğünü, ön jüri üyelerinin değerlendirme yöntemlerinin açıklanmadığını ve yönetmeliğe uygun olmayan bir projenin finalistler arasına alındığını belirtti. Bildiride, seçki değişikliklerine ilişkin açıklamalar ve festivalin sosyal medya hesaplarındaki eleştirel yorumların silindiği iddiaları da gündeme getirildi. 


Değerlendirme sürecinin şeffaflaştırılmasını isteyen sinemacılar, başvuruların hangi ölçütlerle incelendiğinin açıklanması çağrısında bulundu. 


Bildirinin imzacılarından yapımcı Aslıhan Örün, yönetmen Okan Erünsal, Pitching Platformu ön jüri üyeleri Hüseyin Kuzu ve Ertan Tunç ile Antalya Altın Portakal Film Festivali Direktörü ve Antalya Film Forum Koordinatörü Deniz Yavuz'la görüştük.


Konuya ilişkin sorularımızı ilettiğimiz Sinema TV Sendikası’ndan ise haber yayıma hazırlanırken henüz yanıt alamadık. 


Sinemacılar: Üç dakikalık videolarımız bile izlenmedi


Bildirinin imzacılarından Aslıhan Örün ve Okan Erünsal, Antalya Film Forum'un Türkiye'de film geliştirme alanında önemli platformlardan biri olduğunu, özellikle ilk uzun metraj filmini çekmeye hazırlanan sinemacılar için finansman ve sektör bağlantılarına erişim olanağı sunduğunu anlattı. 


Erünsal, başvuru sürecindeki hazırlıkları şöyle anlattı:


Başvuru için sinopsis, logline, tretman ve mood video gibi kapsamlı materyaller hazırladık. Bunların hazırlanması ciddi bir zaman, emek ve maddi kaynak gerektiriyor. Biz mood video çekimi için Kars'a gittik. Bu videolar, yönetmenin filmi nasıl çekeceğini ve görsel yaklaşımını ortaya koyması açısından önemli. Ancak finalistler açıklandıktan sonra Vimeo istatistiklerine baktığımızda üç dakikalık videolarımızın bile izlenmediğini gördük. Diğer başvuru sahipleriyle konuştuğumuzda onların da benzer durumlarla karşılaştığını öğrendik.


İzlenme istatistiklerinin teknik nedenlerle eksik görünebileceğini kabul eden Erünsal, başvuru materyallerinin hangi ölçütlerle değerlendirildiğinin açıklanması gerektiğini vurguladı. 


Sinemacılar ayrıca çok sayıda başvurunun iki ön jüri üyesi tarafından incelenmesini sorgulayarak değerlendirmelerin ortak bir toplantıyla yapılıp yapılmadığının açıklanmasını istedi. 


Festivalin resmi internet sitesinde yer alan açıklamaya göre, Antalya Film Forum’a toplam 269 proje başvurdu. Uzun Metraj Kurmaca Film Pitching Platformu Sümer Tilmaç Adayı kategorisine 10, Uzun Metraj Kurmaca Film Work In Progress Platformu’na 16, İlk Uzun Metraj Film Geliştirme Platformu’na 167, Belgesel Film Work In Progress Platformu’na 35 ve Uzun Metraj Kurmaca Film Pitching Platformu’na 41 proje başvuru yaptı.


Hüseyin Kuzu: "210 tane projeyi niye izleyeyim?"


bianet'in telefonla ulaştığı Pitching Platformu ön jüri üyesi senarist ve yazar Hüseyin Kuzu, değerlendirmelerde sinopsisleri esas aldığını belirterek başvuru dosyalarının tamamını incelemenin gerekli olmadığını savundu.


Kuzu “210 tane projeyi niye izleyeyim? Ben sinopsisleri okurum. Dünyada böyledir zaten” dedi.


Başvuruların yaklaşık yüzde 30'unda sinopsislerin yetersiz hazırlandığını öne süren Kuzu, sinemacıların proje dosyası hazırlama konusunda eksikleri bulunduğunu öne sürdü.


Ertan Tunç: "Başlıca kriterim senaryoydu"


bianet'in sorularını yazılı olarak yanıtlayan ön jüri üyesi sinema yazarı ve eleştirmen Ertan Tunç, değerlendirmelerde senaryoları esas aldığını ve bazı başvuru videolarını izlemediğini belirtti. 


Tunç, değerlendirme sürecini şöyle anlattı: 


‘Antalya Film Forum’, çekilmesi planlanan hikâyeler için logline, sinopsis ve tretman ilave edilmiş proje dosyalarıyla başvurulan bir yarışmadır, adayın önceden çektiği filmler (uzun metraj, kısa metraj, mood videosu) ‘ek materyal’ kapsamındadır, yüklenmesi zorunlu değildir, çoğu aday da yüklememiş. author: Unknown
title: Google Cloud'daki kesinti dijital bankacılığı vurdu: Revolut'ta işlemler aksadı
content:
ABD merkezli teknoloji şirketi Google’ın bulut bilişim hizmeti Google Cloud’da 20 Ekim Salı günü geniş çaplı erişim sorunları yaşandı. Londra’daki veri merkezini etkileyen arıza, başta dijital bankacılık olmak üzere farklı sektörlerdeki şirketlerin hizmetlerinde aksamalara yol açtı.

Reuters’ın aktardığına göre kesinti, Google Cloud’un Avrupa’daki “europe-west2” bölgesinde başladı. Google’ın durum sayfasında yer alan bilgilere göre teknik sorun, Türkiye saatiyle 09.08’de ortaya çıktı. Bölgede birden fazla bulut hizmetinde yüksek hata oranları ve aralıklı ağ bağlantısı sorunları tespit edildi.

Google, mühendislik ekiplerinin arızanın kaynağını araştırdığını bildirdi. Şirket, kesintiden etkilenen müşterilerinden özür dilerken hizmetlerin tamamen ne zaman normale döneceğine ilişkin kesin bir zaman vermedi.

Google Cloud’daki arızadan etkilenen şirketlerin başında İngiltere merkezli dijital banka Revolut geldi. Bankanın hizmet durumuna ilişkin açıklamalarında, birden fazla bankacılık işleminin tamamen veya kısmen kullanılamadığı belirtildi.

Kesinti nedeniyle kartlı ödemeler, ATM’lerden nakit çekme, para transferleri ve mobil uygulamaya giriş işlemlerinde aksaklıklar yaşandı.

Revolut, X üzerinden yaptığı açıklamada müşterilerinin paralarının ve verilerinin güvende olduğunu bildirdi. Şirket, teknik sorunun giderilmesi için çalışmaların sürdüğünü belirterek müşterilerinden özür diledi.

Reuters’a konuşan konuya yakın bir kaynak, Revolut’taki kesintinin Google Cloud’daki teknik arızayla bağlantılı olduğunu söyledi.

İnternet kesintilerini izleyen Downdetector’da İngiltere’de çok sayıda banka ve dijital platforma ilişkin kullanıcı şikâyetleri görüldü. Lloyds Bank, HSBC ve Halifax’ın yanı sıra emlak platformu Rightmove, posta hizmeti Royal Mail ve kargo şirketi DPD’de de erişim sorunları bildirildi.

Lloyds Bank, bazı çevrim içi hizmetlerinde aksaklık yaşandığını doğrularken mobil uygulamaya girişin sürdüğünü açıkladı. Ancak kullanıcıların bildirdiği tüm sorunların Google Cloud’daki kesintiden kaynaklandığı henüz doğrulanmadı.

Almanya merkezli ING de dijital bankacılık hizmetlerinde teknik sorun yaşandığını, müşterilerin internet bankacılığına ve mobil uygulamaya girişte güçlük çektiğini duyurdu. ING’deki aksaklığın Google Cloud arızasıyla bağlantısı konusunda ise resmi bir açıklama yapılmadı.

Google Cloud, Londra’daki veri merkezinde yaşanan teknik sorunun birden fazla hizmeti etkilediğini ve mühendislik ekiplerinin arızaya müdahale ettiğini bildirdi. Kesintinin kesin nedeni henüz açıklanmadı.

Dijital bankacılık, ödeme sistemleri ve farklı çevrim içi hizmetlerin aynı bulut altyapısına bağımlılığı, tek bir teknik arızanın çok sayıda şirketin faaliyetlerini eş zamanlı etkileyebildiğini gösterdi. Google Cloud’daki kesintinin tüm etkilerinin ne zaman giderileceği ise belirsizliğini koruyor.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: anred
title: «Los zorros no bucean»: entrevista a Carlos Robles, perito de parte en la causa Santiago Maldonado
content:
Foto: Nacho Yuchark.


A nueve años de la aparición del cuerpo de Santiago en el río Chubut, hablamos con el veterinario, patólogo y epidemiólogo de campo Carlos Robles, que actuó como perito por la familia Maldonado. Su análisis de la autopsia, del río, del polen y de una serie de peritajes que constan en la causa permiten -dice- “dar vuelta la historia oficial de que Santiago, perseguido por la Gendarmería, se tiró al río y se ahogó”.

Por Gioia Claro y Martín Vallejos, para Sur Arriba (periodismo cooperativo desde La Patagonia).


Este año, a horas de cumplirse nueve años de la desaparición forzada seguida de muerte de Santiago Maldonado, la cátedra libre que su hermano Sergio y un grupo de militantes crearon en la Universidad Nacional de La Plata visitó El Bolsón y compartió un conversatorio en el Instituto de Formación Docente Continua que reseñamos para Sur Arriba. En esa oportunidad, las palabras del perito Carlos Robles quedaron resonando en nuestros pensamientos e intuiciones:

¿qué mensajes trae el río donde aparecieron tu cuerpo, Brujo? ¿Qué dice la mapu de lo que hicieron con vos?

 El trabajo de Robles funciona como una mediación, un pormenorizado trabajo de traducción para que el poder judicial -engranaje fundamental de la maquinaria desaparecedora- preste atención a estas preguntas.


“Los propios

peritos oficiales de la Corte Suprema dijeron que Santiago tenía una lesión compatible con una mordedura de un carroñero terrestre

. Eso lo escribieron en noviembre del año 2017. Nosotros pedimos en ese momento que se ampliara y se explicara de qué se trataba esa información. El juez Lleral nunca hizo nada. Recién ahora, en febrero del año 2025, logramos ver toda la autopsia,

analizar junto con nuestro perito estas lesiones

 que se encontraron a Santiago”, señaló la abogada Verónica Heredia en el conversatorio del viernes 31 de julio de este año.

Para que en esté país al revés los cuerpos no floten río arriba

, compartimos esta entrevista como gesto de memoria rebelde.


Reclamos de aparición con vida en la Comarca Andina. Año 2017. Fotografía: Gioia Claro


¿Cómo y cuándo te sumaste a la causa?


En 2024, cuando la causa se reabrió y pasó al juez Calvete, en Ushuaia, la Dra Verónica Heredia, la abogada de la familia, pidió una pericia sobre las lesiones, porque le llamó la atención que casi no hubiera lesiones en el cuerpo de Santiago. A través de un amigo en común que nos presentó, acordamos con Sergio (Maldonado) mi participación como perito en la causa. La pericia se realizó a principios de 2025, en Olavarría.


¿Por qué tu experiencia con animales es relevante en un caso sobre un cuerpo humano?


Tengo más de 40 años de experiencia como patólogo y epidemiólogo de campo en el INTA. He realizado cientos de autopsias de animales, en el campo, a la intemperie, y ahí una constante que vemos es el efecto de carroñeros y predadores sobre los cadáveres: apenas un animal muere, empiezan a actuar. En el ser humano eso casi no se ve, porque la gente muere en una clínica, un hospital, su casa, o en un accidente donde se la atiende rápido. Son muy pocos los cuerpos que quedan a la intemperie, así que los médicos patólogos, en general, no tienen tanta experiencia.


Además conozco la zona, la fauna y la vegetación porque he realizado una serie de trabajos en la zona de Leleque y Cushamen.


¿Cómo fue la pericia?


Una pericia es una herramienta que tiene la justicia para informar a un juez sobre temas técnicos que él no maneja. En este caso la pericia consistió en unas doce preguntas sobre las lesiones presentes en el cuerpo de Santiago y preguntas sobre presencia y tipo de fauna. Nos juntamos en Olavarría, en la Universidad del Centro de la Provincia de Buenos Aires, sede de los peritos oficiales. Había tres peritos antropólogos de la Universidad del Centro (Tandil), un perito odontólogo de Gendarmería y yo, perito veterinario por la familia Maldondo. Durante 2 jornadas, vimos las fotos, los videos y varios informes técnicos, entre ellos el de la autopsia que constan en la causa.


Finalmente no llegamos a un consenso por lo que los peritos oficiales y el de Gendarmería presentaron un informe y yo presenté otro. Las cuatro primeras preguntas las respondimos en común y el resto por separado. Los dos informes no se contradicen: los oficiales describían las lesiones, pero no se expedían sobre cómo se habían producido. Yo esbocé una serie de hipótesis sobre qué fue lo que pasó con el cuerpo.


¿Qué concluiste …

author: Mag
title: Kahlschlag bei VW ab 2024? Autobauer plant Kürzungen in Milliardenhöhe, um »Effizienz« zu steigern
content:
Dossier


„…

Seit Anfang Oktober verhandelt das VW-Management mit dem Betriebsrat hinter verschlossenen Türen über ein »Effizienzprogramm«, das die Kosten in den kommenden drei Jahren um zehn Milliarden Euro senken soll. Nun zeichnet sich ab, welche Formen der Kahlschlag namens »Accelerate forward« (Forwärtsbeschleunigung) annehmen könnte. Wie am Montag das Handelsblatt berichtete, plant Schäfer, allein in der Verwaltung der VW AG zwischen 4.000 und 6.000 Stellen zu streichen. Die betroffenen Angestellten sollen bevorzugt über Alterszeitregelungen entsorgt werden, den Rest könnten Abfindungsprogramme erledigen. Ziel sei es, die Zahl der Beschäftigten dauerhaft zu reduzieren, Neueinstellungen sollen auf ein Minimum reduziert werden. Passend dazu wurde schon Anfang November ein Einstellungsstopp für die wichtigsten deutschen Standorte Wolfsburg, Hannover, Braunschweig, Salzgitter, Emden und Kassel verhängt. Selbst bei den höchstbezahlten Tarifbeschäftigten der Gruppe »Tarif-Plus«, die aktuell rund 9.000 Mitarbeiter umfasst, will der Autobauer den Rotstift ansetzen

…“

Artikel von Ralf Wurzbacher in der jungen Welt vom 14.11.2023

 

 und mehr dazu und den Alternativen (für alle Auto/Metall-Belegschaften):


VW-Konzernvorstand will jahrelange Nullrunden für Belegschaften weltweit durchdrücken – wird Volkswagen (in Deutschland) jetzt abgewickelt?


Absurder Plan der Unternehmensspitze: VW-Konzernvorstand will jahrelange Nullrunden für Belegschaften weltweit durchdrücken


„

Spürbare Reallohnverluste wären die Folge – Weltkonzernbetriebsrat rechnet mit heftigem Widerstand


Der VW-Konzernvorstand will die Vergütung seiner weltweit 660.000 Beschäftigten jahrelang einfrieren. Dem Plan zufolge sollen die Entgelte konzernweit bis 2030 auf dem aktuellen Stand aus 2026 verharren. Das würde mehrere sogenannte Nullrunden komplett ohne Tariferhöhungen bedeuten. Im Zuge der Inflation, mit der sich die Lebenshaltungskosten in der Regel überall von Jahr zu Jahr verteuern, wären demnach spürbare Reallohnverluste für die Beschäftigten die Folge. Über das Vorhaben des Vorstandes berichtet die „Süddeutsche Zeitung“ in ihrer heutigen Montagsausgabe.


Der Europäische- und Weltkonzernbetriebsrat (E/WKBR) informierte heute im Intranet die Belegschaften über das Vorhaben des Konzernvorstandes und bestätigte die Informationen der „Süddeutschen“. Der E/WKBR sprach von einem Vorhaben mit enormer Sprengkraft. Die internationale Arbeitnehmervertretung hält eine Umsetzung des Plans für wenig realistisch, rechnet mit heftigem Widerstand und fordert den Konzernvorstand auf, sich rasch gegenüber der Belegschaft zu erklären.


Im Detail schaut der Plan den Informationen zufolge so aus, wie der E/WKBR mitteilte: Der Konzernvorstand hat die Personalverantwortlichen weltweit zu „Nullrunden bis 2030“ angewiesen, also dazu, das aktuelle Tarifniveau einzufrieren und jegliche Entgelterhöhungen auszusetzen. Diese neue Vorgabe ist bereits gültig, sie greift seit Anfang Oktober. Damit bricht der VW-Konzern mit der bisherigen Praxis, die in den weltweiten Personalkostenbudgets stets einen Inflationsausgleich vorsah und darüber hinaus laufend tarifliche Entgelterhöhungen einkalkulierte, über die dezentral verhandelt wurde. Dieser in den Budgets eingepreiste, planerische Spielraum für Entgeltsteigerungen soll nun abgeschafft und der aktuelle Status vier Jahre in Folge eingefroren werden.


Zwar werden Entgeltsteigerungen dezentral verhandelt, in der Regel zwischen den jeweiligen lokalen Tarifvertragsparteien – in Deutschland sind das die Arbeitgeberseite und die Gewerkschaft IG Metall. Sollte sich der Vorstand aber mit seiner weltweiten Leitlinie durchsetzen, wären empfindliche Einbußen in der Kaufkraft der Belegschaften die Folge. (…)


E/WKBR-Präsidentin Daniela Cavallo hat den Konzernvorstand noch am Sonntagabend, als sich der „Süddeutsche“-Artikel ankündigte, aufgefordert, sich der Belegschaft gegenüber zum Nullrunden-Plan zu erklären. Bisher fehlt eine solche Stellungnahme von der Unternehmensspitze. Der Mitbestimmung ist das Vorhaben seit Ende vergangener Woche bekannt, als der Vorstand es in einer gemeinsamen, internationalen Gremiensitzung vorstellte

.“

author: Unknown
title: Violences policières et trauma psychique
content:
Suite aux violences policières, nous sommes beaucoup à ressentir un état de stress aigu envahissant. C'est une réaction psychologique adaptée et normale.


Il est important de ne pas l'ignorer et de prendre soin les un.es des autres.


Il peut s'agir par exemple de :


 Garder sentiment de peur intense, d'impuissance, de danger sans pouvoir être rassuré.e.

 Revivre le moment : voir les images des violences, sentir des odeurs ou entendre les bruits de la scène violente.

 Ne pas pouvoir parler, ne plus arriver à penser, être figé physiquement. Pleurer sans pouvoir s'arrêter.

 Ne pas pouvoir manger, ne pas réussir à faire les choses qu'on aime, s'isoler de ses proches.

 Faire des cauchemars de l'évènement, insomnies, réveils anxieux.


Tous les états de stress aigus ne se transforment pas en état de stress post-traumatique

,


et quand c'est le cas une aide est possible dans des structures de soins hospitalières, associatives ou communautaires.


En essayant de dépasser au plus tôt cet état on réduit les risques de syndrome de stress post-traumatique.


Quelques idées pour traverser ce moment :


Rester avec des ami.es, reparler des évènements avec des personnes les ayant vécu, rester au calme où l'on se sent en sécurité, s'éloigner un temps des images de violences policières, reprendre au plus tôt ses activités habituelles ...


Contacts d'urgence :


Ligne nationale de prévention du suicide 3114.


En cas d'urgence contacter le 15.


Une brochure à ce sujet :


https://www.activist-trauma.net/fr/mental-health-matters/ptsd.html

title: İran'dan bölgesel güvenlik çağrısı: “Dış baskılardan uzak mekanizma kurulmalı”
content:
İran Dışişleri Bakanlığı Sözcüsü İsmail Bekayi, bölge ülkelerinin dış baskılardan uzak, ortak bir güvenlik mekanizması oluşturması gerektiğini söyledi. Tahran’da düzenlediği haftalık basın toplantısında konuşan Bekayi, Rusya’nın Hürmüz Boğazı ve Basra Körfezi’nde kolektif güvenliği güçlendirmeye yönelik önerilerini değerlendirdi.

Bölgenin güvenliğinin dış aktörlere değil, bölge ülkelerine dayanması gerektiğini savunan Bekayi, dış güçlerin önceliğinin bölge halklarının güvenliği olmadığını öne sürdü.

İran Dışişleri Bakanı Abbas Erakçi ile Rusya Dışişleri Bakanı Sergey Lavrov arasındaki görüşmede nükleer meselelerin gündeme gelmediğini belirten Bekayi, ABD ile de nükleer konuda müzakere yürütmediklerini açıkladı.

ABD ile İran arasındaki görüşmelerin neden ilerlemediğine ilişkin soruya yanıt veren Bekayi, “Müzakerelerin ilerlemesinin önündeki engel ABD’nin aşırı talepleri” dedi.

İran’ın yer altındaki nükleer tesislerine yönelik olası bir saldırı iddiasını da değerlendiren Bekayi, Tahran’ın böyle bir saldırıya karşılık vermekten kaçınmayacağını söyledi.

Bekayi, “Uygulamada, hiçbir darbeyi cevapsız bırakmayacağımızı gösterdik.” ifadelerini kullandı.

Bekayi, Azerbaycan’da başörtüsüne yönelik kısıtlamalar hakkında da açıklama yaptı. İran ile Azerbaycan arasındaki ilişkilerin iyi olduğunu belirten sözcü, meselenin ortak değerler ve temel haklara saygı çerçevesinde çözülmesini umduklarını söyledi.

İran ile Pakistan arasındaki sınırın kapatıldığı iddialarını da reddeden Bekayi, Pakistan tarafında bazı teknik sorunlar yaşandığını, ancak İran’ın Pakistan’a ihracatının sürdüğünü bildirdi.

Avrupa’daki, özellikle Fransa’daki gösterilere ilişkin değerlendirmesinde ise Bekayi, ABD ve İsrail’in İran’a yönelik saldırıları ile deniz ablukasının bölgedeki krizin temel nedenleri olduğunu ileri sürdü.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: dev
title: De Mai 68 à Octobre 6-7 ?
content:
Si vous avez ricané en regardant les vidéos d'adolescents s'adonnant à des « Battle d'aura », qu'il vous a fallu demander à plus jeune ce que pouvait bien signifier « farmer » ou que par principe vous tenez pour superficielles et dérisoires les modes de cours de récré, alors cet article est pour vous.


Ses propres gestes ne sont plus à lui, mais à un autre qui les lui représente.

 [

1

]


Guy Debord place en exergue du premier chapitre de

La Société du spectacle

 une réflexion de Ludwig Feuerbach, selon laquelle « notre temps

 [

2

]

… préfère l'image à la chose, la copie à l'original, la représentation à la réalité, l'apparence à l'être… Ce qui est

sacré

 pour lui, ce n'est que l'

illusion

, mais ce qui est profane, c'est la

vérité

. Mieux, le sacré grandit à ses yeux à mesure que décroît la vérité et que l'illusion croît, si bien que

le comble de l'illusion

 est aussi pour lui

le comble du sacré

 »

 [

3

]

. Cinquante-neuf ans après la publication de

La Société du spectacle

, il serait tentant de voir dans les smartphones brandis devant les lycées, les vidéos TikTok, les mèmes et les « battles d'aura » – ces brefs duels de présence où deux personnes entrent successivement dans un cercle jusqu'à ce que le bruit du public désigne qui l'emporte – l'accomplissement presque littéral de ce diagnostic. La première génération entièrement socialisée à travers le monde numérique et ses images aurait fini par ne plus pouvoir manifester sans immédiatement se représenter en train de manifester, transformant le conflit en contenu et le blocage en décor. Il y aurait pourtant quelque chose de paradoxalement peu debordien à réduire ainsi le « spectacle » à une simple prolifération d'images. Guy Debord lui-même récuse explicitement cette réduction lorsqu'il affirme que « le spectacle n'est pas un ensemble d'images, mais un rapport social entre des personnes, médiatisé par des images »

 [

4

]

. Inutile, donc, d'opposer une expérience supposément authentique à sa représentation dégradée, et encore moins de croire que les corps seraient politiques tant qu'ils agissent, et aliénés dès lors que leur action fait l'objet d'une représentation filmique.


Le ou la spectatrice « aussi agit », elle « observe, [...] sélectionne, [...] compare, [...] interprète » écrit Jacques Rancière

 [

5

]

, retournant le soupçon qui pèse sur celui ou celle qui regarde et prenant, sur ce point, explicitement ses distances avec la critique debordienne du spectacle. Voir n'est pas l'antithèse de l'action : l'émancipation commence, au contraire, lorsque cesse d'aller de soi la division entre les personnes auxquelles on reconnaît la capacité de comprendre ce qu'elles font et celles que leur position de spectatrice condamnerait à recevoir passivement un sens qui serait fabriqué par autrui.

 Le mépris générationnel suscité par le nouveau phénomène socioculturel des « battles d'aura » reproduit finalement assez bien cette vieille méfiance – que Jacques Rancière associe à une matrice platonicienne – à l'égard des images et de la position de spectateur

·

ices. Celles et ceux qui prétendent savoir ce qu'est une véritable manifestation expliquent aux personnes qui entrent aujourd'hui dans la lutte qu'elles ne savent pas ce qu'elles font ; celles et ceux qui se réclament de leur connaissance de l'histoire révolutionnaire disposent déjà d'une sorte de police esthétique de ce qu'une lutte doit montrer, jusque dans les affects qu'elle autorise. À cela s'ajoute une suspicion plus récente en apparence, mais remarquablement compatible avec la précédente : chaque téléphone brandi serait la preuve qu'une jeunesse entière est désormais incapable d'habiter le monde autrement qu'à travers un écran, autrement qu'à travers sa

représentation

.


Tout ce petit monde se tient, bien entendu, du bon côté du partage : celui où l'on sait. La situation actuelle ne nous invite-t-elle pas, au contraire, à renverser la question ? « Tout ce qui était directement vécu s'est éloigné dans une représentation »

 [

6

]

, écrit Guy Debord dès la première thèse de

La Société du spectacle

. Les battles d'aura ne font pourtant pas simplement le chemin inverse, comme si des images supposément confinées aux écrans venaient soudain se réincarner dans des corps. L'irruption de nouvelles icônes insurrectionnelles brouille ce partage : elles se forment à même les corps au moment où elles deviennent images, sans cesser d'agir sur les gestes dont elles procèdent.
