author: Unknown
title: Malbata ku di Merîçê de du zarokên wan mirin û yek jî winda bû: “gef li me xwarin û em bi darêzorê xistin belemê”
content:
Malbateke 5 kesî ya Kurd ji Silêmaniyê, bajarê Herêma Kurdistanê  ji bo ku biçe Almanyayê bi rê ketibûn û çûbûn Edîrneyê da ku bi rêya avê derbas bibin. Ji sê zarokên malbata kurd jê du di Çemê Merîçê de li ser sînorê Tirkiye û Yewnanistanê mirin û yek jî winda bû.


Daxwaza ji bo wergêrê kurdî qebûl nekirin: Penaberê îraqî yê Kurd wekî hemwelatiyê Efxanistanê tomarkirin


8 Cotmeh 2026


Heşt kes xistin belema çar kesî


Bûyer di êvara Çarşema 14ê Cotmehê de li herêma Pira NATOyê ya nêzîkî gundê Bosnakoya Edirneyê pêk hat. Dayîka zarokan Hozan Rustem, bav Herêm Mihemed, sê zarokên wan û sê kesên din hewl didan ku bi belema plastîk derbasî Yewnanistanê bibin.


Piştî ku bot bin av bû, dê û bav bi saxî rizgarkirî bûn. Hevjînan diyar kir ku piştî bûyer pêk hatiye çûne qereqola sînor û ji hêzên ewlehiyê alîkarî xwestine. Bi beşdarîya tîmên AFAD, cenderme û tenduristiyê xebatên lêgerîn û rizgarkirinê hatin destpêkirin.


Heryadê ku ji avê hat derxistin û birin Nexweşxaneya Fakulteya Tibê ya Zanîngeha Trakyayê, li wir can da. Ji bo herdu zarokên din ên ku li ber herikîna avê ketin û winda bûn, xebatên lêgerînê hatin destpêkirin.


Di 17ê Cotmehê de bedena bêcan a Mêlaya pênc salî hat dîtin. Ji bo dîtina zarokê sêyem ê bi navê Hestiyar, di çem de xebatên lêgerînê berdewam dikin.


Hozan Rustem û Herêm Mihemed li Rêveberiya Koçê ya Bajarê Edirneyê tên girtin.


Herêm Mihemed: “Gotin av heta çongê ye”


Hozan Rustema ji bianetê re behsa tîştên ku rûbirû bûne kir û anî ziman ku qaçaxçiyên koçberan ji wan re gotine derbasbûn bi ewle ye, lêbelê gava ew gihîştine ber çem rastî rewşeke cuda hatine.


Rustemê diyar kir ku belem piştî ku nêzîkî du metreyan çû ser avê li darê ket û serobino bû. Her weha Rustemê da zanîn ku wê di tariyê de zarokên xwe winda kirine û hevjînê wê tenê karibûye wê rizgarkirî bike.


Rustemê tiştên ku jiyaye wiha anî ziman:


“Qaçaxçiyan ji me re got ku av heta çongê ye û derbasbûn dê nêzîkî 20 xulekan bikişîne. Paşê em hatin ber çem. Em heşt kes bûn. Tevlî çantayan em hemû xistin belema plastîk ya çar kesî. Tevî hemû nerazîbûnên me jî, gef li me xwarin û em bi darêzorê xistin belemê û ber bi çem ve tehn dan.”


Rustemê diyar kir ku heta zarokê wê yê winda Hestiyar neyê dîtin, ew naxwaze ji Tirkiyeyê biçe.


Nasnameya sê gumanbaran diyar bûn


Hat hînbûn ku gumanbarek welatiyê Herêma Kurdistanê ye û du kesên din jî welatiyên Tirkiyeyê ne. Xebatên ji bo girtina gumanbaran berdewam dikin.


Di rêyên koçberiyê de mirina zarokan


Welatiyên Herêma Kurdistanê ji ber sedemên weke aborî û siyasî berê xwe didin Ewropayê. Li gorî lêkolîna Navenda Geşepêdana Polîtîkayên Koçê ya Navneteweyî (ICMPD) ku InfoMigrantsê ragihandiye, sînordariya derfetên aborî, bêkarîya ciwanan, gendelî, pirsgirêkên rêveberiyê û nediyariya siyasî, di nav sedemên biryardana derketina ji herêmê de derdikevin pêş.


Komîseriya Bilind a Penaberan a Neteweyên Yekbûyî (UNHCR), Fona Alîkariyê ya Zarokan a Neteweyên Yekbûyî (UNICEF) û Rêxistina Navneteweyî ya Koçberiyê (IOM) di 2ê Cotmehê de raporeke hevpar weşandin. Li gorî raporê di sala 2025an de 9 hezar û 978 zarok bi rêya deryayî û bejahiyê gihîştine Yewnanistanê. Ji wan 6 hezar û 971 zarok bi dêûbav an jî bi mezineke ku ji wan berpirsiyar in re ketine rê.


Li gorî daxuyaniya IOMê ya di 13ê Cotmehê de, di navbera salên 2014-2025an de li seranserê cîhanê di rêyên koçberiyê de herî kêm 4 hezar û 414 zarokan jiyana xwe ji dest dane. Di heman serdemê de 81 hezar bûyerên mirin û wendabûnê hatin tomarkirin. Agahiyê temen yên ji sedî 55,5ê wan nîne. Ji ber vê yekê tê diyar kirin ku dibe ku hejmara rastîn a zarokên jiyana xwe ji dest dane zêdetir bin.


(FY/AY)

author: anred
title: Represión a la 5° Marcha Universitaria: denuncian la decisión política de desplegar la violencia ilegítima del estado contra la protesta
content:
La Comisión Provincial por la Memoria (CPM) presentó, este sábado, una denuncia penal contra funcionarios del gobierno nacional, tras el operativo de represión desplegado durante la quinta marcha federal universitaria. Reproducimos el comunicado de la CPM.

Por Red Eco Alternativo.


Por primera vez en una marcha convocada en defensa de la Universidad pública, las fuerzas de seguridad federales (Policía Federal, Gendarmería Nacional, Prefectura Naval y Policía de Seguridad Aeroportuaria) junto a la Policía de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires desplegaron, de manera planificada, ilegítima e indiscriminada, un brutal operativo represivo en la zona del Congreso de la Nación. La represión se extendió durante más de 3 horas y dejó al menos 550 personas afectadas y heridas por mas de 120 granadas de gases lacrimógenos, químicos, disparos con postas de goma y agua a presión lanzada por los camiones hidrantes. Una vez más se registró el ataque dirigido contra trabajadores/as de prensa, equipos sanitarios que atendían a las víctimas y organismos de derechos humanos que monitoreaban el despliegue de las fuerzas de seguridad, entre ellos, integrantes la Comisión Provincial por la Memoria. Al menos seis personas fueron detenidas arbitrariamente, entre ellas dos adolescentes. El organismo de derechos humanos, en su calidad de Mecanismo Local de Presión de la Tortura, pidió que se investigue a los responsables políticos y quienes ejecutaron la represión por los delitos de abuso de autoridad, estrago, detención ilegal, torturas o malos tratos, entre otros.


Los registros de la represión ocurrida el pasado jueves en el Congreso de la Nación y alrededores, evidencian una vez más el uso ilegal y desproporcionado de la fuerza pública y la utilización irregular de armas menos letales: lanzamiento de granadas de gas lacrimógeno y gases químicos de manera indiscriminada, ataques dirigidos contra personas que deben ser particularmente protegidas por las tareas que cumplen, disparos con postas de goma o químicas en dirección horizontal o apuntando al cuerpo de las personas.


“Las conductas de las fuerzas de seguridad en comando conjunto excedieron los límites de la normativa vigente en el uso de la fuerza. Tales conductas ostentan una coordinación que permite establecer que sus acciones fueron ordenadas y ejecutadas por superiores jerárquicos con conocimiento y voluntad del ejercicio de la coerción por fuera del marco normativo e incumpliendo con los compromisos internacionales suscriptos por la República Argentina de rango constitucional, y que fuera ya denunciada por organismos internacionales de forma reciente”, resumió la Comisión Provincial por la Memoria en la denuncia penal presentada en las últimas horas del viernes.


En su calidad de Mecanismo Local de Prevención de la Tortura, y en el marco del monitoreo de la represión a la protesta social que el organismo viene realizando desde la aplicación del protocolo antipiquetes junto al Comité Nacional de Prevención de la Tortura y el Mecanismo local de CABA, la CPM solicitó que se investigue a los responsables directos y funcionales por los hechos represivos ocurridos el pasado jueves por los delitos de estrago, torturas y apremios, detención funcional ilegal, incumplimiento de deberes y abuso de autoridad.


Como ya denunció el organismo ante otros hechos represivos, el despliegue ilegitimo de la violencia, los movimientos coordinados de las fuerzas y la reiteración de las acciones, evidencian que la represión fue planificada y programada por los máximos funcionarios responsables de las fuerzas de seguridad y del Ministerio de Seguridad de Nación.


Además, la denuncia señala que el operativo represivo no sólo ocasionó lesiones y daños a quienes participaban de la movilización sino que generó un peligro para el resto de las personas que, en horario y día hábil, transitaban por la vía pública. Cabe recordar que, una vez que los efectivos de seguridad sobrepasaron el vallado del Congreso, el operativo se desplegó por distintas calles de la ciudad en dirección hacia la avenida 9 de julio y hasta la Plaza de Mayo.


De acuerdo a lo relevado por los equipos de monitoreo de la CPM, los episodios represivos comenzaron alrededor de las 15:20 frente al Congreso, que se encontraba completamente vallado; en ese momento, sobre la intersección de las avenidas Callao y Rivadavia y cuando algunos manifestantes intentaron empujar las vallas, efectivos de la Policía Federal arrojaron gas pimienta, primero …

author: Clara Saliba
title: No próximo dia 25 de outubro, lembre-se que a economia também é política
content:
Começo a nossa conversa desta quinzena pedindo licença para tomar um caminho um pouco mais informal que o habitual. Essa coluna se torna em parte um pedido, em parte um desabafo de uma economista cansada, mas ainda em pé.


Desde os resultados do 1º turno das eleições, no início do mês, está difícil pensar, falar ou postar sobre qualquer outra coisa. Em meio a tentativas de vira-voto, vídeos caseiros, ligações para familiares distantes e algumas conversas nas ruas, vi um post no Instagram de um apoiador de Flávio Bolsonaro que dizia algo na linha de

“essa semana, alguém virá conversar com você sobre política. Pergunte para ele se ele sabe o que é taxa Selic, inflação, curva de juros e como isso impacta a economia e o bolso dela.”


A ironia é que existem várias e vários economistas que sabem bastante sobre tudo isso e, ao contrário da sugestão do Instagram, continuam defendendo uma agenda progressista. Inclusive, fica a dica para você ler

minha coluna

: (Quase) tudo o que você precisa saber sobre o Copom e a Taxa Selic, divulgada aqui na

Agência Pública

 em 11 de agosto.


Além da ironia, a verdade é que essa mensagem implica que, quem entende de verdade de economia não vota na esquerda — ou em Lula. Como se as pautas progressistas fossem inerentemente prejudiciais ao desempenho econômico do país.


Existe um mito bastante difundido de que uma gestão econômica responsável imediatamente se traduz em escolhas amargas: ajustes fiscais, arrochos e escalas de trabalho ultrapassadas — superadas por propostas como a de Rick Azevedo, Erika Hilton e dos movimentos de trabalhadores que conquistaram semana passada o

fim da Escala 6×1 no Brasil

 (longa vida!) Em síntese, a ideia é de que quem estudou Ciências Econômicas, que são “inquestionáveis, técnicas e objetivas”, sabe que o verdadeiro preço das políticas sociais é o afundo econômico do país.


O que eles não contam é que toda história tem um lado. E que quem normalmente assume o personagem técnico, isento e portador das más notícias tem um. E não é o nosso.


Sob a gestão econômica de Paulo Guedes, o grande guru dos economistas “sem lado”, o Brasil cresceu uma média de 1,5% ao ano, excluindo os anos atípicos da pandemia da conta. Nos três primeiros anos do terceiro mandato de Lula, o crescimento foi de 2,98%. O cálculo é feito a partir da série de variação real do Produto Interno Bruto, do IpeaData.


O mesmo discurso tecnocrata foi utilizado para atacar quem propunha a viabilidade da redução da jornada de trabalho. Fazendo cálculos, alguns economistas afirmaram que a redução da jornada custaria até 11% do PIB brasileiro. Usando o mesmo método, mas premissas diferentes, a

professora Marilane Teixeira

, do CESIT Unicamp, chegou num crescimento de produtividade em 4%, na manutenção do PIB e em 3,62 milhões de novos empregos.


Isso não quer dizer que uma conta esteja mais certa do que a outra, mas que conta nenhuma, como raciocínio econômico nenhum, é imparcial ou apolítica.


Quando se veste de técnica e isenta, a economia ganha autoridade para defender argumentos às vezes classistas, às vezes racistas, misóginos ou xenofóbicos. Em geral, impopulares, no sentido mais cru da palavra: antipovo.


Quem se lembra da frase famosa do economista Delfim Netto, ministro da Fazenda durante a Ditadura Militar, que dizia em fazer o bolo crescer, para depois dividi-lo? A defesa era pelo crescimento econômico primeiro, e a distribuição depois, às custas de um arrocho salarial forte e de intensa concentração da renda nas mãos de poucos.  


Para citar a ilustre professora Maria da Conceição Tavares,

no programa Roda Viva de 1995

:


“Uma economia que diz que precisa primeiro estabilizar, depois crescer, depois distribuir é uma falácia. E tem sido uma falácia. Nem estabiliza, cresce aos solavancos e não distribui.

”


É por isso que peço, leitoras e leitores, que não se deixem enganar por esse discurso dos “tecnocratas alucinados”, como dizia a professora. 


Um economista que quer te vender um plano econômico que promete crescimento às custas da sua qualidade de vida, na definição da jornada de trabalho, ou na condução do Ministério da Fazenda, não o faz porque é isento e não enxerga alternativas. Faz porque sabe que é difícil argumentar contra um conhecimento elitizado.


A economia é política tanto quanto é técnica, e toda técnica, vale lembrar, é também um instrumento político potente.


Finalizo citando mais uma vez a professora, que foi capaz de reunir Dilma Rousseff e …

author: Unknown
title: Milano: chi si è perso la festa di sabato ci va domenica
content:
Il fumo cresce e s’addensa, la fiamma si ridesta, con essa le grida sorgon più forti. “Viva l’abbondanza! Muoiano gli affamatori! Muoia la carestia! Crepi la Provvisione! Crepi la giunta! Viva il pane!”


I Promessi Sposi – Alessandro Manzoni


La borghesia di tutto il mondo che assiste con compiacimento al massacro dopo la battaglia, rabbrividisce d’orrore a veder profanati la calce e i mattoni. 


Marx, La guerra civile in Francia cap. 4


Il mondo al contrario, finalmente. Le merci non sono lì da vedere. Sono lì da prendere. Qualcuno che dice che tutto costa troppo. Qualcuno che ci pone un rimedio. Il rimedio è prendersi quel tutto. Senza pagarlo. Che se tutto costa troppo e gli stipendi sono gli stessi da vent’anni vuoi mai che sia perché per vent’anni si sono fatte manifestazioni pacifiche e nulla è cambiato? E non importa se neanche hai lo stipendio. Lo fai per qualcun altro. Per tuo padre che lo stipendio lo ha. Ma quello stipendio serve solo per pagare un buco dove dormire, in mezzo al nulla, una gabbia. Kilometri a piedi, poi un treno, poi una metro e sei lì, davanti alle luci, dove c’è tutto. Quella cosa che non potrai mai avere perché costa due settimane del lavoro di tuo padre. Ma se me le mettono davanti, perché non volerle? Perché non volere tutto? Perché non prendersi tutto?


Sentirsi dire di fare come in Francia. Ma farlo, per davvero. Perché lo fanno loro e noi no? Facciamoglielo vedere su tiktok pure noi. Anche in Italia.


Finalmente il potere. Il potere di potere. La gioia di potere. L’adrenalina. Il fiatone.

Dicono dei maranza. Ma poi lo sai cosa c’è dietro quella maschera? C’è la mamma che prepara il baba ganoush o la parmigiana di melanzane? Perché banco a banco, gomito a gomito, stesse tute, stesse scarpe, stessa lingua. I sabati pomeriggio in Duomo. Un giro al Mac e poi a guardare le vetrine. Gli sbirri che ti fermano e chiedono i documenti. Sempre agli stessi. E questo sabato è sempre lì. Sempre insieme. Ma questo sabato è diverso. Questo sabato le vetrine lucide non riflettono più i ricchi di tutto il mondo che vengono a specchiarsi nella città che hanno creato. Questo sabato quelle vetrine vanno in frantumi. Questo sabato Milano non assomiglia più a loro. Questo sabato Milano è nostra. Niente turisti in Duomo. Un bel falò.


Chi si è perso la festa di sabato ci va domenica.


Sabato

Fin dal puntello in piazza la composizione del corteo è abbastanza chiara; si tratta di giovani e giovanissimi, in larga parte studenti medi ma anche lavoratori. Bandiere italiane, palestinesi, albanesi e cartelli con vari slogan contro il governo, il caro-vita, l’economia di guerra ed il (neo)fascismo.

La rabbia di alcuni inizia a montare già da subito con scritte, petardi, un piccolo attacco ad una banca; già in via Broletto, appena la testa del corteo gira, la polizia carica e riesce a dividerlo.


Questa pratica verrà utilizzata ripetute volte durante la manifestazione con un successo variabile, nonostante l’assenza di cordoni o simili: al secondo tentativo l’unità di celere che ha tagliato all’angolo è stata controcaricata su due fronti e messa in fuga.

Il corteo dimostra una certa compattezza resistendo a cariche multiple fino a via Dante, nonostante diversi fermi, dopodiché c’è una prima battuta di arresto al Castello; da qui riparte un corteo più piccolo, mentre in piazza Duomo si riuniscono altri giovani.


Qui, dove intanto sono confluiti ingenti rinforzi delle FdO, per ore ci sono cariche e controcariche, fino al momento in cui le FdO. decidono di tirare lacrimogeni in quantità tale da svuotare completamente la piazza e le adiacenze

I giovani rimasti si riversano nelle vie collegate alla piazza dove accadono i primi espropri e, complici i fermi che hanno iniziato ad aumentare, si disperdono gradualmente in prima serata.


Domenica


Anche la domenica fin dal mattino, gruppi di ragazzi si trovano in piazza Duomo a decine. Parlano, si muovono, qualcuno si fa intervistare dai giornalisti. Sono giovani, alcuni giovanissimi, in gran parte di seconda generazione e provenienti dalla grande periferia della metropoli da cui sono sistematicamente espulsi. La polizia inizia a identificare, e anche fermare, giovani in tuta, principalmente a partire dal colore della pelle; qualcuno addirittura viene prelevato in piena piazza e portato nelle volanti. La quantità di FdO aumenta esponenzialmente durante la giornata fino al tardo pomeriggio, quando la situazione si riaccende. I ragazzi si raggruppano, volano i …

content:

Необходимость момента – это восстание, вооруженное восстание.

Это говорим мы, и это говорят также социалисты… А потом мы упрекаем друг друга в том, что не делаем ничего, кроме слов.

И до сих пор это, к сожалению, правда – как для одних, так и для других.

Но важно не прошлое, пусть даже и недавнее: важно завтрашнее.

Неужели мы продолжим заниматься пустой болтовней?

Нужно готовиться. Это несомненно; и мы не утверждаем, что наши сделали всё, что должны были сделать.

Но мы призываем товарищей и трудящихся быть наготове – и лучший призыв – это показать им, что единственное средство избавиться от нынешнего угнетения и от еще более сильной реакции, которая нам угрожает, – это насильственно свергнуть [господствующие] учреждения.

Мы не отрицаем огромнейших проявленных ими во время войны заслуг; но нам кажется преувеличением желание использовать то, что они сделали против националистического угара, как оправдание за всё то, что они делают и будут делать.

Поскольку подрывные партии – это не Государство, и они не обладают ни арсеналами, ни банками, ни свободой военной мобилизации, и, следовательно, не могут действовать так, как поступили бы для вооружения и мобилизации регулярной армии, им приходится рассчитывать на то, что делают сами по себе отдельные группы и отдельные личности.

А группы и личности действуют по мере того, как в них развивается необходимое для действия состояние души, по мере того, как развивается дух инициативы и исчезает та склонность ждать приказов и работы вождей, которую обычно ошибочно называют духом дисциплины.

Сегодня среди итальянских трудящихся, несомненно, существует желание глубокой, радикальной, экспроприирующей революции.

Это настроение масс, помимо фактов, которые, естественно, всегда являются главным фактором, объясняется также тем, что социалисты говорили и делали во время войны и сразу после нее. Но что потом?

Наступили выборы, и социалисты поняли, что единственным способом привлечь пролетарских избирателей на избирательные участки было заставить их поверить, что они воспользуются парламентским мандатом как средством немедленной революции; в итоге у нас появились предвыборные речи, которые звучали как призывы к оружию.

Их избрали в огромном количестве… и они поняли, что никто не был готов! Или они не знали этого раньше? И почему они обещали то, что, как они знали, не смогут выполнить?

Но оставим это. Никогда не поздно делать добро.

Они заклинают избегать любого несвоевременного движения, сдерживают любой порыв народного возмущения, требуют оставаться дисциплинированными и ждать команды… храпеть, и всё это потому, что нужно готовиться.

И чтобы подготовиться, чтобы побудить трудящихся вооружаться, Парламентская группа стремится приукрасить работу Парламента, заставляя народ поверить, что если он не платит дорого за хлеб, то это благодаря самому Парламенту.

Чтобы побудить трудящихся вооружаться, они рекомендуют избирателям готовиться... к предстоящим предвыборным битвам за завоевание Коммун [муниципалитетов].

Но тем из социалистов, кто действительно хочет революции (а таких много), кажется странным: неужели человек, надеющийся получить неизвестно что, отправив социалистов в коммунальный совет, всерьёз может подумывать о вооружении? И главное: может ли проповедовать и готовить вооружение тот, кто суетится, чтобы стать депутатом совета?

Немного психологии не помешало бы.

Вот в чем дело: мы не упрекаем социалистов в том, что они ничего не делают; мы просим их не мешать другим делать.

Если их руководители, их организаторы боятся безрассудных бунтов, если они боятся ответственности, пусть позволят действовать безответственным, дезорганизованным, анонимной толпе, «сброду», которая, если победит, станет «святым отребьем» …

author: Andrés
title: A las y los atrapabombas: proteger como acto ético
content:
15.10.2026. 5ta marcha universitaria. Foto: Sol Erazo


El pasado 15 de octubre, entre las 14.30 y las 19.00, durante cinco horas hubo quienes se dedicaron a atrapar las bombas de humo que disparó la policía del otro lado de las vallas. Ellos y ellas entraron en el cuerpo de las blancas orugas de humo diseñadas para quemar ojos y bocas, y las neutralizaron. Estas líneas son una forma de agradecer y reivindicar a quienes se ocuparon de mitigar el efecto que provocan las bombas de gas lacrimógeno, compuestas de un polvo químico irritante que te enceguece y ahoga. Que aturde y cierra la garganta. Para todos y todas aquellas que, aun quemándose las manos y poniéndose en riesgo, ahogaron los efectos de las bombas y granadas que lanzó sin parar la policía. Para quienes hicieron posible ejercer

nuestro derecho a quedarnos.

Por Sol Erazo y Andrés Manrique, para Huella del Sur y ANRed.


En las manifestaciones, luego de las represiones en Chile, se formaron

postas de salud

 con profesionales que se especializaron en contextos de represión, profundizando el cuidado en primeros auxilios, evacuación y rescatismo. Este modelo de cuidado colectivo se replicó en la Argentina. Y es el que

nos asiste en los momentos represivos más críticos, garantizando nuestra integridad.

 La Posta de Salud, que conocemos por su distintivo color verde, es un ejemplo. Además de ellxs, en cada marcha, hay cuadrillas del CEPA, que es el cuerpo de evacuación y primeros auxilios; de ACVI, que es la asociación civil contra la violencia institucional; de la CPM, que es la comisión provincial por la memoria; así como grupos autoconvocados que organizan meriendas gratuitas todos los miércoles de jubilados. Las personas que participan reconocen la importancia del

derecho a la protesta

, a tal punto que ponen su cuerpo y recursos para sostener cada marcha, además de ser testigos de lo que allí ocurre.


15.10.2026. 5ta marcha universitaria. 16.55 hs. Fotos: Andrés Manrique.


El pasado 15 de octubre se realizó la

5ta. marcha nacional en reclamo por la ley de financiamiento

 universitario, dos veces vetada por el poder Ejecutivo; y

en contra del decreto 70/23 que pretende desregular más de 300 leyes

 que nos protegían. Tales como la ley de alquileres, la ley de góndolas, la ley de prepagas y obras sociales, la de medicamentos. Además, suprime la prohibición de privatizar empresas estatales, modifica la ley de deportes y la ley de tierras. Y por si fuera corta la lista de afectadas y afectados que se encuentran movilizadxs en las calles, se suman las personas con discapacidad, los movimientos piqueteros, los movimientos de barrios populares, las familias endeudadas, las luchas por la salud, los trabajadores informales, y quienes padecen la pérdida de sus ingresos debido al

desfinanciamiento de programas y políticas públicas del Gobierno Nacional.


15.10.2026. 5ta marcha universitaria. Foto: Sol Erazo


Los discursos que señalan la piedra y la gomera como violencia legitiman las decisiones que el gobierno viene tomando y que el Congreso le aprueba al pie de la letra.

Las decisiones del gobierno

 afectan nuestro cotidiano. Y son

a tal punto regresivas, que violan todos los acuerdos alcanzados.

 Son decisiones que devastan.


El ataque del gobierno a las manifestaciones es sistemático, asimétrico, desproporcionado.


¿Ejercer nuestro derecho a permanecer en la calle es violento?


Resistir en legítima defensa no es violencia.

 La defensa hoy es una agresión necesaria para sostener la vida.

 Y respondemos.

 Con una foto, con un cartel, compartiendo una causa, firmando un petitorio, comprando una rifa, colaborando en una olla, untando los ojos inflamados por el gas pimienta con una gasa rebosante de óleo calcáreo, con una camilla, con un limón, con alguien que acompaña.


Oponerse a la entrega y al saqueo

 es parte de nuestra responsabilidad.


15.10.2026. 5ta marcha universitaria. 16:35. Foto: Andrés Manrique


Desactivar una bomba es cuidar, es mantener a salvo.

Proteger es una respuesta ética.

Cuando alguien desactiva una bomba con un balde de agua improvisado para la ocasión, nos está protegiendo. Cuando otro revolea lejos el arma que nos está atacando, está cuidándonos.

Impedir que las armas intoxiquen en mayores proporciones es una forma del amor.

 Disuadir el peligro con agua y un pasamontañas es legítimo.


En un contexto como este,

preservar la identidad de quienes realizan esta tarea

 es necesario. Es una

condición para  su …

content:
Dossier


„

Nun soll also der Kultursender 3sat womöglich eingestellt werden. Die Sendeinhalte sollen „teilweise oder vollständig“ – so der Entwurf, der den Gremien zur Abstimmung vorliegt – ins Arte-Programm überführt werden. Und die Frage stellt sich: Warum fällt den Öffentlich-Rechtlichen immer die Kultur ein, wenn es ans Sparen geht? Am dabei erzielbaren Einsparpotenzial kann es eher nicht liegen. Für die Honorare, die im Fernsehen für die Fußballexperten ausgegeben werden, die in der Halbzeit von Länderspielen die Sendezeit überbrücken, ließe sich ein halbes Dutzend gut recherchierter Kultursendungen finanzieren. (…) Und noch etwas würde Kulturberichterstattung – zumal neben einem ernsthaften politischen Magazinjournalismus – für das öffentlich-rechtliche System bieten: Legitimation. (…) Als rein unterhaltungsorientierte Quotenmaschinen hätten die öffentlich-rechtlichen Sender sowieso keine Berechtigung

Kommentar von Dirk Knipphals vom 4.10.2024 in der taz online

author: Andrés
title: El lugar sin límites
content:
Bajista, cantante y compositor argentino, Maxi Vazquez inicia su camino como solista tras veinte años de escenarios con Hombres Bien y junto a Walter Domínguez. Con una propuesta autogestiva e independiente su música retoma las raíces del rock argentino, entre otras influencias. En conversación con Anred, nos cuenta sus orígenes y el lanzamiento de sus dos primeros cortes «Digan Basta» y «Mirando atrás», que conformarán su primer EP, próximo a presentarse el viernes 13 de noviembre a las 20:00 hs en Stummer Bar. Por Hernan Bayón para Anred.   


H: Maxi, para empezar a conocerte un poco, me gustaría que nos cuentes, cómo empezaste en la música, cómo la descubriste, qué te incentivó a volverte músico.


M: Bueno, no vengo de un hogar de músicos; muchas veces sucede que alguien podía, al menos en forma amateur, tocar algún instrumento. Bueno, en mi casa no sucedió eso. Pero mi mamá ponía mucha música, ponía mucha radio durante todo el día, rock y pop internacional; lo que sería como una radio Aspen de hoy en día, pero que en ese momento estaba pasando música nueva. Y yo prestaba mucha atención, de grande me di cuenta que yo ya de chico prestaba mucha atención a detalles de la música que por ahí otros chicos no lo hacían.


Y crecí escuchando mucho de ese rock y ese pop, de INXS, Duran Duran, las baladas de Chicago y Peter Cetera, toda la música que sonaba en ese momento. Además mi hermano empezó a traer algunas cosas, como Soda Estéreo, que me empezó a llamar mucho la atención. Me acuerdo que en el año 88, yo ya tenía 6 años y sale doble vida. A partir de ahí, ya a mis diez años, nueve, once, empiezo a buscar músicas que empiezo a tomar como propias y descubro a Queen, que es la primera banda que me empieza a llevar a un montón de universos.


Justo había muerto Freddy y Queen empieza a sonar por todos lados y empiezo a absorber y me empieza a llamar la atención la diferencia de estilos que hacía Queen, la presencia escénica de Freddy, la voz inigualable de Freddy y ahí empieza todo mi interés en la música y después me lleva mucho al rock nacional, al rock argentino, nuestra música, la que habla mi idioma y lo que pasa en mi lugar. Por medio de amigos empiezo a conocer, bueno, Soda Estéreo por mi hermana, empiezo a conocer a Virus, a Los Abuelos de la Nada, a Serú Girán, que me vuela, me explota el cerebro cuando escucho el bajo de Pedro Aznar y empiezo a jugar y a soñar con que yo era un músico que tenía una banda y cantaba mis canciones. El primer momento que yo fui músico fue ese.


H: ¿Pero hubo un momento en el cual dijiste, bueno, me voy a jugar por la música o la música es el lugar en el cual yo me encuentro? ¿Hubo un disco, un tema, un momento en tu vida que fuera trascendental con la música?


M: El primer momento tal vez fue el momento que elijo tocar el bajo, porque yo fui directamente a ese instrumento. A veces hay muchos bajistas que pasan por otros instrumentos, mismo Jaco Pastorius empezó tocando la batería. Yo me acuerdo que compraba cassettes en esa época, tenía los grandes éxitos de Queen, el uno y el dos,  y después me iba comprando los demás. Entonces me compro The Game, The Queen, el cassette The Game, que todavía lo tengo. Y ese cassette tiene muchos éxitos, pero tiene un tema que se llama Dragon Attack, que tiene el bajo muy adelante. Todo ese disco tiene el bajo muy adelante, pero ese tema tiene el bajo muy adelante, un grupo de bajo muy adelante, y tiene un solo de bajo. Es el único tema de Queen que tiene un solo de bajo. Pegado a ese tema después viene  Another One Bites the Dust, y en ese momento a mí me hace el click y descubro, me doy cuenta, que ese también era el bajo. Ese es un momento en el que yo empiezo a escuchar el bajo en las canciones, que lo descubro, y ahí quedo como fascinado con ese sonido. Y da la casualidad, que mi hermana estaba de novia y después se casa y se divorcia con alguien que es hoy un gran amigo mío, que era bajista, y que me ayuda y me da una mano para exteriorizar y lograr decir: yo quiero tocar este instrumento, yo quiero hacer música, y que mi familia lo acepte, y llegar a mi primer instrumento, llegar a mi primer bajo.


Ese fue el primer click a nivel instrumento. Después empiezo a tocar a los diecisiete años, estaba en la mitad de mi adolescencia, y por ahí no me sentaba con el instrumento tanto, porque llegaban los fines de semana, y mi iba al boliche terminaba de joda. Cuando empiezo a estudiar más a conciencia, y a trabajar mucho, y a sentarme mucho …

author: Ekaterina Netchitailova, PhD
title: I Refuse to Die; I Am Not Leaving
content:
P

sychosis is treated like a crime, and the sentence is social death.


There is no place in society for people like me. I’ve known it deep down for a long time, but I was ashamed to say it out loud. Having had a psychosis is treated as worse than having committed a crime. Few experiences carry as much stigma, and the shame doesn’t fade when the psychosis does.


For more than twenty years after my first psychosis, I was barking up the wrong tree. I believed the main problem was that psychosis was misunderstood. I thought that, at least sometimes, it should be seen as a spiritual or religious experience that goes beyond medicine, and not simply as a mental illness. I spent years trying to prove that nothing was wrong with me, and that I could do not only as well as those we call ‘normal’, but even better.


On the surface, between my ‘psychoses’, I look like a successful, capable person. I have lived in four countries, speak four languages fluently, have a PhD, am raising my son on my own, and have a job I love. In reality, every day is a battle, and the weight of performing ‘normal’ threatens to pull me under. What I really need is a break, something like a stay in a Soteria house, where people can go through a crisis in a calm, homelike place instead of a hospital. But instead of resting, I always chose to carry on. I felt I had to show everyone that I am capable, smart, hardworking and valuable. That I am ‘normal’. That I am enough.


But can I ever really prove it? Time and again, under extreme stress, I have experienced psychoses. They are short, and I have learned to find my way out of them at home, without a hospital. Shortly afterwards, against all odds, I am back in society as if nothing happened.


Yet coming back is not always welcomed. ‘How come she’s back, after posting online that she’s Jesus?’ ‘How dare she just carry on?’ I have seen the smears, the eyes that avoid mine, the whispering, and the hints that perhaps I should do what so many people with a serious mental illness are quietly expected to do: disappear onto benefits and never be heard from again.


Made with Grok Imagine


To be honest, for a long time I didn’t see any of this. I was too busy trying medication after medication, looking for one without crushing side effects, and working hard to keep my livelihood, wherever I lived. I refused to be put in the box of forgotten people, labelled with a mental illness our society cannot tolerate.


Now I see it. Some people don’t just misunderstand us; they resent us. You can hear it in remarks like ‘just wait until she’s ill again’, and in the disbelief that someone like me dares not only to exist, but to do well.


I am not alone in this. Look at Britney Spears. The world cheered when she won back her freedom, yet now many people mock her. She isn’t doing anything outrageous. She dances, she shows her body, she expresses herself, and somehow that is enough to invite ridicule. What I see is a 44-year-old woman who looks amazing and is finally living on her own terms. Her diagnosis seems to follow her everywhere, and so does the permission to laugh at her.


The worst part of having had a psychosis is not bad medication, or even being sectioned. It is the stigma. I didn’t expect it to be this strong today, after so many charities told us that mental illness is ‘just like any other illness’. Who still remembers Time to Change, the campaign run by Mind and Rethink Mental Illness? It closed in 2021. Heads Together, backed by the royals, faded from view too. And many of the celebrities who once opened up have gone quiet.


Did these campaigns change anything? For psychosis, they may even have made things worse. Telling people it is ‘like any other illness’ promised an understanding that never came. Nobody really knows what psychosis is or how to live alongside it, so the gap between the friendly slogan and the frightening reality was filled with shame.


Until recently, I was naïve. I thought stigma had eased, that people like me had paved the way, that there was finally a place for us. For me, my psychoses had become a closed chapter. It happened, I recovered, what’s next?


But many people can’t forget, and they can’t forgive. I have seen partners walk away from the parents of their children, friends disappear, families go cold, all because someone became psychotic. The shame is so strong that it turns into a moral judgement. I feel judged not for my illness but for my character, as if I wear a …

title: Iranian regime bombs Mêrîwan region
content:
The YRK (Rojhilatê Kurdistan Defense Units, Yekîneyên Parastina Rojhilatê Kurdistanê) Press Center issued a statement regarding attacks by Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC).


The statement read: “On 18 October 2026, an attack was carried out in the Mêrîwan region using suicide drones and mortars. The attack was conducted by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps of the Iranian regime. The area was first bombed with two suicide drones, followed by more than 30 mortar shells and heavy weapons. The attack damaged our people’s agricultural land and orchards, but our forces suffered no harm.”

title: Bakırhan: The framework law must now be implemented!
content:
Co-Chairs of the Peoples’ Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party), Tülay Hatimoğulları and Tuncer Bakırhan, visited New Party Chair Özgür Özel. The delegation held a joint press statement at New Party headquarters following the meeting.


The visit reportedly focused on the Peace and Democratic Society Process, the 2027 budget and other current political developments.


Bakırhan said they had been visiting labour and professional organisations and trade unions for approximately a week. He said, “Today, we also began our visits to political parties, starting with New Party. New Party was the first to host us on this tour.”


Bakırhan added, “I recently attended a conference in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq. Representatives of virtually all the different forces in the Middle East were there. I shared their views on the process underway in Turkey with the party chair and his delegation.”


The framework law must now be implemented


Bakırhan continued: “The framework law has been passed. It was one of the important stages of the process. This law has brought us into a new period. Society's expectations in this new period are now clear. Throughout the visits we have made and the meetings we have held with the people, everyone has expressed the same expectation: the framework law must now begin to be implemented. Society is waiting for the necessary legal arrangements. This was also one of the issues we discussed just now. The value of a law can only be understood through its implementation. Whether a law is being implemented must be measured by its practical effects. Therefore, society, labour and professional organisations, trade unions, political parties and Parliament all have major duties and responsibilities in ensuring that this law is implemented. The Speaker of Parliament must also take responsibility for this issue and pave the way for the law to be implemented and the necessary steps to be taken without delay. A Parliamentary Monitoring Committee was supposed to be established, but it has not yet been formed. This monitoring committee in Parliament must now be established as soon as possible. A way must also be found to ensure that all political parties represented in Parliament are included in the committee. I believe the Speaker of Parliament will also visit the political parties to discuss this matter.”


Peace must not become a matter of political competition


Bakırhan added: “Peace must not become a matter of competition between the government and the opposition. During our meeting with Özgür Özel, he and his delegation made this very clear. Peace is a process through which Turkey must ensure social peace and take democratic steps for all 86 million people. Therefore, it should not be seen as a matter of competition between political parties, but rather as common ground on which they must come together. Political parties must assume a shared responsibility. This is not a process being conducted between just two parties. The law itself does not concern only the region, the Kurds or the DEM Party. Political parties must take significant responsibility because this is a process that concerns our peace and our democracy. New Party has always played a constructive and positive role in this regard. I would therefore like to express my gratitude to Mr. Özel and the New Party leadership. Despite facing enormous pressure and external resistance on this issue, they stood on the right side and maintained the right position. Because peace is a good thing. It is a good thing that people are not losing their lives. It is extremely valuable and precious that we have experienced a period in which our young people have not lost their lives for two years. This process transcends party politics.”


Pressure on the opposition, the press and freedom of expression must end


Bakırhan said: “Of course, there are also certain problems in this process. The DEM Party has always spoken openly and sincerely about them. We are also deeply troubled when a peace process is underway on the one hand, while injustices and unlawful practices continue on the other. We have made our position on this very clear on every platform. Interference targeting the opposition, opposition-run municipalities, freedom of the press and freedom of expression must now end. If we are conducting a peace process, we must put an end to practices targeting the opposition, the press and freedom of expression. Lasting peace and the success of the Peace and …

author: Unknown
title: Nihat Bertan released after 31 years in jail
content:
Nihat Bertan, who had been held for 31 years at Tekirdağ No. 1 Prison, was released. He was welcomed outside the prison by his family, members of the Association for Assistance and Solidarity with Families of Prisoners and Convicts in Marmara (MATUHAYDER), and representatives of political parties and civil society organizations. Those gathered chanted, “Bijî berxwêdana zindanan” (“Long live resistance in prisons”).


Speaking at the welcome, Cahit Direk, MATUHAYDER’s Tekirdağ provincial co-chair, referred to the Peace and Democratic Society Process and stated that all prisoners who had been held in prisons for more than 30 years must be freed.


Nihat Bertan said that he had left 12 doors behind him as he walked out of prison and conveyed greetings from his fellow prisoners. Noting that the prisoners’ greatest wish was to reunite with their people and continue the struggle, Bertan said: “Our happiness is incomplete, because half of our hearts are still in prison.”


Reminding those gathered that Leader Apo remains imprisoned on İmralı Island, Bertan stated that true happiness could not be spoken of until all prisoners, foremost among them Leader Apo, had regained their freedom.


Bertan said that public support was needed to ensure that the ongoing process was embraced by society, adding that the morale prisoners had today stemmed from the people’s struggle.


Following Bertan’s speech, white doves were released. The crowd then travelled in a convoy to Çorlu, where a large-scale welcome was set to continue. Bertan was greeted there with chants as well.


Release postponed twice


Bertan was detained and arrested in Izmir in 1995 and sentenced to life imprisonment following his trial. His release, expected in September 2025, was postponed first by seven months and then by a further six months.

title: Karayılan: Every martyr made history through heroic sacrifice
content:
Murat Karayılan, a member of the Command Council of the People's Defense Center (HSM), said that the names of another 157 guerrillas who had fallen as martyrs at different times would be announced.


Recalling that the names of 749 martyrs from North Kurdistan had previously been made public, Karayılan explained that identities had been announced late in previous years because of security conditions and delays in receiving information. He said: “I believe our esteemed families and our people will understand this, because the conditions at that time were truly difficult. Much of the information arrived late.”


Emphasizing that the struggle waged by Abdullah Öcalan and the martyrs had fostered a spirit of Kurdish national unity in all four parts of Kurdistan, Karayılan said that participation in the Apoist movement from every region had played a major role in developing national consciousness. He noted that no one could now deny that the Kurds are a nation and stated that the Kurdish people would liberate themselves under any circumstances.


This is the first part of the remarks made by HSM Command Council member Murat Karayılan concerning the martyrs:


“As is well known, very large-scale attacks have been carried out against us in recent years. Particularly over the last ten years, the Turkish state has conducted extensive attacks against us using every available method, the technology of the modern age and advanced weaponry. In many places, it has even used prohibited weapons and chemical weapons.


Their aim was to eliminate the Kurdistan Freedom Guerrilla forces and then eradicate the gains made by the Kurdish people in Rojava Kurdistan and Şengal, while also suppressing the Kurdish people's achievements in Southern Kurdistan. In other words, this was an attack on our people's achievements, carried out through attacks on the guerrillas themselves.


They intensified the isolation imposed on Leader Apo [Abdullah Öcalan] in Imralı and expanded and escalated their attacks in the mountains of Kurdistan. In the face of these attacks by the Turkish state, Leader Apo did not retreat in İmralı but resisted. The guerrillas, too, mounted a historic resistance in the mountains. For the first time in the history of the Kurdish people, resistance was sustained in the same positions for five consecutive years. In other words, despite deploying all its weapons and its full military strength, the state could not wrest those positions from the guerrillas.


Young Kurdish women and men demonstrated such historic resistance. Metîna is an example of this. Look, a short time ago, we withdrew our forces from Metîna through dialogue. Yet the Turkish state had launched an attack on April 17, 2021, to occupy Metîna. But the self-sacrificing fighters of this land, these brave heroes, did not allow the occupation to succeed.


Resistance on such a grand and historic scale had never before taken place in the history of our people. As a result, the Turkish state became bogged down in Metîna, Zap and many other places. That is why the current process began. Otherwise, why would they have felt the need to appeal to Leader Apo and engage in dialogue with the Kurds? They had wanted to eliminate us. But these brave heroes did not allow that to happen. Our martyrs did not allow it.”


The names of 157 martyrs to be disclosed


Karayılan added: “Dear comrades, respected families, as you know, we previously announced memorial commemorations for 749 of our comrades from Northern Kurdistan. Condolence gatherings were held in the north, and our people commemorated these heroes.


These comrades fell at different times during active warfare. We announced the names of many of our martyrs promptly, but we could not announce all of them. Communications had been suspended for the safety of our comrades, and information arrived late. The war was also continuing, and new martyrs were constantly being lost. As a result, the announcement of some of our martyrs' names was postponed. They were not announced at the time for these reasons: security concerns, delays in receiving information and the accumulation of cases. We are now announcing the names of those martyrs whose identities could not be made public in a timely manner.

title: Kongra Star calls for action against Varisheh Moradi's death sentence
content:
Kongra Star Coordination issued a statement concerning the death sentence handed down for a second time to Kurdish women's activist Varisheh Moradi by the Iranian judiciary.


The statement said that the decision to sentence Varisheh Moradi to death for a second time demonstrated Iran's determination to continue its policies of repression, intimidation and silencing of women. It stressed that a woman who had devoted her entire life to the Kurdish people's and women's struggle for freedom must not be left alone in the face of Iran's threats.


Kongra Star said that Moradi had resisted physical and psychological violence and the harsh conditions of the prison where she had been held for years.


The statement said, “Despite all this severe repression and these harsh conditions, Varisheh Moradi continues to resist, refusing to surrender her will for freedom. They want to silence Varisheh through the death sentence. However, no policy targeting a woman's life and struggle will succeed.”


The statement stressed that Iran's punishment of the Kurdish people, women and opposition groups within society went beyond security measures and penal policies. It said that the democratic demands of the people were treated as a threat, while the use of death sentences against women struggling for freedom exposed the political repression they faced.


The statement continued: “It is also striking and significant that the Iranian regime launched attacks on various parts of Eastern Kurdistan (Rojhilatê Kurdistan) after Varisheh Moradi was sentenced to death for a second time. On the one hand, Kurdish women activists are being threatened with execution, while on the other, military operations and bombardments continue in Kurdish-populated areas. This exposes the Iranian regime's approach to the Kurdish question and its position on political rights.”


Kongra Star concluded its statement with the following appeal: “We call on all women's organisations, feminist movements, human rights organisations, legal organisations, democratic institutions and international solidarity networks: Raising your voices to stop the execution of Varisheh Moradi and secure the overturning of her death sentence is a historic responsibility. Effective and sustained public pressure must be built against the Iranian regime's policies of repression and intimidation. An independent commission of inquiry must also be demanded to expose all violations of Varisheh Moradi's rights, and the struggle on this issue must be intensified.”

title: Bermal Çem: Jineolojî united women in the pursuit of freedom
content:
Artist Bermal Çem, who attended the European Jineolojî Conference as a representative of the cultural and artistic community, spoke to ANF about the discussions and workshops held during the conference and the impact of bringing together women from different peoples.


Bermal Çem said there was a profound sense of excitement at the conference, noting that numerous problems and possible solutions had been discussed over the three days. She said that the message Abdullah Öcalan sent to the conference had provided a powerful boost to the morale of both Kurdish women and the internationalist women in attendance.


‘Women's pursuit of freedom is shared’


Bermal Çem said the conference had discussed how Jineolojî could respond to the problems faced by Kurdish women living in all four parts of Kurdistan and abroad, as well as women from different peoples.


Çem said, “At a certain point, all women share common problems and a common pursuit of freedom. The oppression they experience in working life and within the family is the same, whether in the East or in Europe.


Jineolojî brings these women together. Discussions were held among women from different cultures and with different perspectives, centred on women's freedom and guided by women's philosophy and perspectives.”


Bermal Çem stressed that Jineolojî needed to reach wider sections of society. She highlighted the importance of addressing the problems faced by all women, from mothers to academics, and developing solutions that take account of their social circumstances.


Bermal Çem said, “Our mothers were at the conference, as were educated women. There were women working in diplomacy and bureaucracy, as well as artists. Women from different sections of society participated. Jineolojî embraced everyone like an umbrella. I consider it extremely important that the voices of all women came together at this conference and that everyone embraced one another with the same sense of solidarity.”


‘What matters is putting the decisions into practice’


Bermal Çem said that the conference had brought women together emotionally and intellectually, stressing that the main task now was to implement the decisions taken.


Çem noted that culture and art had been one of the seven themes addressed in the workshops. She said the discussions in this workshop had focused on issues including oral culture and the importance of accurately documenting the history of different peoples.


Bermal Çem continued: “What matters most? Putting all this into practice. Many decisions were taken and workshops were held. Discussions covered seven themes encompassing society as a whole. One of these was culture and art.


The culture and art workshop addressed many issues, including oral culture. It is not only Kurdish society that faces these problems; many peoples experience the same difficulties. The history of peoples must be written accurately. Stateless peoples, in particular, are confronted with this reality more intensely.


The decisions taken in the workshops set out tasks for women in line with Jineolojî's objectives. In the coming period, everyone must work in their own field to put these decisions into practice.”


Bermal Çem said that every contribution to the conference reflected the realities of a different culture and country. She stressed that the discussions went beyond routine proceedings, with a strong sense of enthusiasm, morale, commitment and determination to work.


‘Jineolojî can address the problems of society as a whole’


Bermal Çem said that Jineolojî brought women together around their own knowledge, feelings and ideas, emphasising that this approach was not limited to a scientific discipline.


Çem noted that the family had also been discussed at the conference, with particular attention given to how a women's perspective could embrace society as a whole.


Bermal Çem said: “I believe Jineolojî can be a source of enlightenment in every sphere of society. In this process of construction, it can provide answers not only to women's problems but also to those of society as a whole.


One of the topics discussed at the conference was family. Families include men, children, elderly people and young people. Very important discussions were held about how society as a whole could be embraced through a women-centred approach and a women's perspective.”

We understood one another even without speaking the same language’

title: Pourquoi des lycées brûlent-ils ?
content:
Incarcéré dans le quartier d'isolement de Fleury-Mérogis, Ritchy Thibault poursuit néanmoins sont travail journalistique pour

lundmatin

. Il s'interroge ici sur le triste sort que certains lycéens ont réservé à leur établissement.


« La grande nuit dans laquelle nous fûmes plongés, il nous faut la secouer et en sortir. Le jour nouveau déjà se lève, il doit nous trouver fermes, avisés et résolus. »


Franz Fanon,

Les damnés de la terre


D'où est-ce que le surgissement lycéen a-t-il débuté ? Sur quelles terres la gestation de cette insurrection a-t-elle eu lieu ? Cette enthousiasmante irruption populaire a d'abord pris forme dans les territoires prolétariens qui sont sous le joug d'une gestion coloniale. Que ce soit dans les pays colonisés comme la Guyane et Mayotte ou bien dans les quartiers où sont ghettoïsées racialement les personnes issues de l'immigration coloniale et postcoloniale, tel qu'à Créteil et Saint-Denis.


Pour la jeunesse de manière générale, mais plus encore pour celle de condition subalterne, il nous faut analyser ce qu'incarne et représente le lycée. Sans cette étape préalable, il est impossible d'avoir la moindre compréhension de la mobilisation en cours.


Que représente le lycée et pourquoi l'abattre ?


Le lycée est la dernière étape de domestication avant l'âge adulte. C'est une institution disciplinaire. Un rythme infernal et nocif nous y est imposé. Les journées s'étalent souvent de 6h à 21h, entre le réveil et la fin des devoirs. C'est une véritable torture infligée à des corps et des esprits qui ne sont même pas encore arrivés au terme de leur développement biologique. Une certaine posture du corps est imposée, ainsi que le silence. Il faut lever la main avant de parler. En somme, se soumettre aux codes de bienséance attendus par la société et celui ou celle qui s'en écarte termine puni et sanctionné. Les diverses sonneries vous mettent au pas, en vous imposant un rythme. L'architecture de ces établissements n'est ni plus ni moins que carcérale : grillages, murs, etc. En leur sein les dispositifs sécuritaires sont de plus en plus nombreux : portique de détection, vidéosurveillance, etc.


C'est aussi donc cet espace que l'État-nation intensifie son processus d'assimilation et d'uniformisation des gens pris entre ses griffent en particulier des groupes vivants dans les marges. Notre cerveau est dans leur viseur. Ils tentent d'y ingurgiter une langue, une culture, un récit national, un modèle de « réussite ». Il s'agit d'un réel formatage, d'une machine à fabriquer des clones. C'est pour reprendre la rhétorique clastrienne, la loi de l'Un. L'État tente d'inventer de toute pièce un peuple en réduisant à néant une myriade d'inscriptions singulières dans le monde. Ce fait ethnocidaire est d'une violence accrue pour les populations traitées avec le logiciel colonial et sur les étrangers de l'intérieur que sont les Roms et les Voyageurs par exemple. Là-bas, dans leurs lieux « d'éducation » - le terme est particulièrement signifiant, nos langues maternelles, nos manières d'être, nos croyances (au nom de leur laïcité) doivent être laissées à la porte. On nous impose une double attitude, le moi à l'école et celui en dehors. Si bien qu'à la fin il devient difficile de se situer, la personnalité s'en trouve troublée. Une véritable aliénation.


Nous sommes également avec le lycée face à une fabrique, une industrie visant à préparer en série d'individus qui tels des machines se limiteraient à produire et consommer. On nous inculque comment bien se vendre sur le marché du travail. Nous sommes dans l'antichambre de la sélection. Nos vies doivent être définies, déterminées, il nous est instamment enjoint de faire des choix, de trancher. Il faut que l'on se prépare à une morne existence, pouvant être résumée par le triptyque suivant : métro, boulot, caveau.


Tout cela rend la jeunesse malade, malheureuse, ça l'a fait souffrir. Il n'y a qu'à voir l'explosion juste colossale de la consommation d'anxiolytiques dans ma génération. Mais encore à se pencher sur l'accablante et macabre explosion du nombre de suicides dans cette catégorie d'âge. Au sein de cette institution, en particulier pour certains milieux comme nous l'avons évoqué, il règne pour reprendre un vocable fanonien une véritable atmosphère de mort. Nous pouvons donc dire sans trembler que brûler un lycée comme ça a été le cas à Nantes récemment, c'est faire disparaître un lieu d'oppression et de domination. C'est par l'action dire avec …

title: Deliberately forgotten: internet shutdowns with no end
content:
Content note: The following post contains references to war crimes, sexual assault, murder, and death

.


There is a complete lack of transparency.


Cutting the internet means cutting us off from the outside world.


I can say that the internet and communications blackout were as impactful as the bombings, destruction, and killings.


These are the words of people who have experienced years-long

internet shutdowns with no end in sight

. Alarmingly, the number of such prolonged shutdowns has steadily risen each year, as perpetrators around the world quietly decide to

keep people cut off from the internet indefinitely

.


For more information about ongoing shutdowns, explore our new dashboard

below

.


As we write, people in parts of Myanmar continue facing repeated and prolonged internet shutdowns

amid deadly violence

, as the junta’s

control and surveillance of communications networks

 creates an “

internet dead zone

” where few dare to speak openly against the regime. In Tigray, Ethiopia, meanwhile,

new internet shutdowns

 are raising fears that the same population that was

cut off from the internet for over two years during a bloody civil war

 will once again be disconnected and in even greater danger. And

the list goes on

.


Authorities that use prolonged or repeated shutdowns to

control the flow of information

, quell

protests

, manipulate

electoral processes

, or assert political power

during

 or

after conflict

 are collectively

punishing

 and isolating entire populations. The impact is deep and enduring; even when authorities claim to have

ended a shutdown

, connectivity often does not return in any meaningful way. While every shutdown is a

disaster for human rights

, these indefinite shutdowns

erode trust that a usable, open, secure, and inclusive internet will ever return

. As new research from Vodafone confirms, this has

profoundly negative consequences

 for people’s lives and livelihoods.


Following are direct testimonies from people living in a state of perpetual digital darkness, from Annobón and Gaza to Myanmar and Sudan. Read on to learn

how prolonged shutdowns impact people’s lives

, and

what the international community can do

 to stop them.


The human impacts of indefinite shutdowns


These testimonies were collected through Access Now’s


Shutdown Impact Stories


project and our partners in the


#KeepItOn coalition

, and span from 2024-2026. Testimonies from Myanmar are courtesy of the Bridging Voices Project led by Border Voices and


Friends without Borders Foundation

. All stories have been anonymized for security reasons.


What we can do to end indefinite shutdowns


With such clear and devastating harms,

the international community can no longer allow internet shutdowns to linger on indefinitely without transparency or accountability

. We must increase the pressure on states perpetrating prolonged shutdowns, deepen investment in alternative connectivity solutions, and create new mechanisms and processes to keep people connected during crises and conflicts. As a start, we recommend that:


States and international organizations significantly ramp up their efforts to develop and strengthen norms to prevent, mitigate, and end internet shutdowns

, especially given the severity of the impact prolonged shutdowns have had on some of the world’s most vulnerable populations, as civil society has documented over many years.


The Freedom Online Coalition (

FOC

) should deepen its commitment to condemn internet shutdowns and shape global norms to prevent, mitigate, and combat internet shutdowns

, pursue accountability, and expand its reach to speak out against under-reported and prolonged shutdowns.


Governments, funders, regulators, satellite internet providers, and international institutions should invest in


alternative connectivity solutions

 to provide secure, high-quality, affordable internet access in areas with low to no connectivity or indefinite platform blocks. This also requires exploring

innovative and rights-based forms of governance in establishing emergency connectivity mechanisms

 inclusive of emerging technologies, as called for by the

Direct2Cell

 campaign.


State parties to conflict, peace mediators, and other stakeholders should continue to work toward considering the


digital dimension of ceasefires

 in recent and active conflicts around the world, and include adequate funding and support for digital systems in …

author: Shannia Cabuello
title: Remembering a driver’s activist route
content:
Elmer Cordero tribute. Photo by Shannia Cabuello/Bulatlat.

This was his kind of honk during protests as he shakes his hand with everyone he encounters. He would happily swing the Piston flag while marching to Mendiola. There, he would gracefully dance to Awit ng Kalayaan (Song of Freedom).

This is also how the jeepney driver and activist Elmer Cordero became a familiar face in the streets. Youth and activists refer to him as “Tatay Elmer.”

Until his last breath, Tatay Elmer devoted himself to the cause despite his limitations.

According to Piston president Mody Floranda, Tatay Elmer had difficulty breathing while he was at the nationwide transport strike on September 29. He was then confined at the Caloocan City Medical Center.

On October 7, he passed away at the age of 78.

For nearly five decades, he has been navigating the routes of Metro Manila as a jeepney driver. Considering his health, he was scheduled to operate at 5:00 pm onwards on the Monumento-Baclaran route.

He became publicly known as one of the Piston 6 who were arrested during the pandemic while staging the “Balik Pasada Protest.” His wife Elvira shared in an interview with Bulatlat that she thought Tatay Elmer would just give some food to his fellow jeepney drivers who had nothing to eat.

“During that time, we are getting by somehow because of some food assistance. His fellow driver in Monumento has no food left. So, he took two kilos of rice to give to his friend,” Elvira said.

At first, she did not believe that Tatay Elmer was arrested. She did not know that he and the other jeepney drivers who lost livelihood had no choice but to collectively beg for financial and food assistance on the streets.

Six of them were detained for at least a week for opposing the ban on the operations of all public transportation. She said that the protocols during the lockdown made it hard to visit him, as Elvira also takes care of Jamjam.

Tatay Elmer and Elvira did not have children of their own. But they took care of their relatives Joshua, 27, and Jamjam, 9. They have been living under their roof since they were born, prompting Tatay Elmer to continue working.

“It was painful when he was detained because it didn’t matter if we had nothing to eat. It just so happened that he went there,” she added.

Jamjam also shared that Tatay treated every youth who knows him as his own apo (grandchild).

It was one of their memories that proved Tatay Elmer as a kind, giving, and welcoming person.

As a husband, he was patient and loving, always making sure to patch things up before leaving for work. But, Elvira admitted that he cannot stop Tatay Elmer from joining protests regardless of his age and health.

His arrest made him follow the route of activism.

“If there’s a mobilization and we forgot to invite him, he would feel slighted,” recalled Piston treasurer Puring Campos. Tatay Elmer does not just join protests during his free schedule but really makes time for it.

Since 2020, he has been consistent in joining Piston meetings, strikes, and rallies.

“He was always the first to come. In his short time in the movement, this is where he arrived. It has been six years of ceaseless deed,” Campos said in Filipino.

Cultural performances were Tatay Elmer’s favorite. His colleagues also said that he was the happiest during protests.

Last September 11, Campos said that Tatay Elmer commuted alone to Tarlac to participate in a protest and caravan against Pax Silica even if he was already suffering from lower back pain.

When asked as to why he still came despite his health, he answered, “I am here because I want to. If I were to die, at least I would die fighting.”

Piston National Deputy Secretary-General Bong Baylon said that Tatay Elmer always had that spirit of persistence. Even with jeepney mechanical problems, he would not give up until he found the issue and resolved it.

Aside from being a veteran driver, Tatay Elmer was an electrician. He had a car repair and a vulcanizing shop before becoming a full-time jeepney driver. Baylon was one of his first customers.

“He was so friendly that the shop somehow went bankrupt. Every time we cannot pay, he would just let it slide. He would still repair our jeepneys next time,” he said, stressing that Tatay Elmer was an expert at lights and wirings.

Baylon said that it was his kindness that made people honor him. His courage to fight even in his weak days also became an inspiration to never stop until the system changed …

author: dev
title: Le 19 octobre 2026, depuis le quartier d'isolement de Fleury-Mérogis
content:
Le 1

er

 octobre dernier, l'écrivain, voyageur et étudiant Ritchy Thibault a été interpelé en pleine rue pour avoir invité une foule de lycéens à mettre le feu à l'Élysée. Pour ces quelques paroles, il a été incarcéré dans l'attente d'un procès qui se tiendra le 9 décembre. Depuis le quartier d'isolement de la prison de Fleury-Mérogis, il nous a transmis ces quelques impressions quant à cette journée du 17 octobre à laquelle juges et ministres ne voulaient vraiment pas qu'ils participent.


Quand ceux qui sont relégués dans les marges assiègent les centres


Dans la nuit du 17 au 18 alors que j'entamais mon quatrième jour de grève de la faim pour protester contre mon placement au quartier disciplinaire (mitard), un médecin a ordonné à l'administration pénitentiaire de m'en extraire au vu de mon état de santé qu'il jugeait préoccupant. J'ai donc partiellement eu gain de cause, car la direction ne m'a pas reconduit en détention « ordinaire », mais dans une aile d'isolement. J'ajoute que je dois passer devant un conseil de discipline (le fameux prétoire [juge et geôlier dans le même temps]) cet après-midi même. Tout ça pour vous dire que j'ai pu accéder à des informations sur la mobilisation de samedi dernier et son prolongement hier – avec, je précise, le philtre déformant de la presse bourgeoise aux ordres. Je vais donc brièvement vous donner mon sentiment sur cette journée dont j'aurai tellement voulu être.


Des cibles identifiées avec brio


Il ne faut pas perdre son temps à défiler et parader loin de tous les espaces de pouvoir. Il faut au contraire aller dans le viseur des institutions stratégiques. Il faut aller là où ça dérange. Il faut qu'ils tremblent. Si après l'attaque d'une cible vous les voyez s'indigner outrancièrement c'est que l'opération est une réussite.


Le 17 octobre j'ai ouï dire qu'un des premiers objectifs fut de prendre d'assaut les locaux du canal de propagande fasciste : CNEWS. C'est excellent ! Les propagandistes de l'ordre établi doivent être mis hors d'état de nuire dans nos manifestations et également dans leurs locaux. Peut-être devrions-nous redoubler d'efforts pour hacker/briser directement leurs sites et antennes de diffusions. Nous devons aussi mener les cyberbatailles. Ensuite j'ai eu des échos en ce qui concerne le saccage de la résidence de la préfète de Bordeaux. Les préfectures sont des cibles cruciales et déterminantes. Elles sont les centres opérationnels de la répression. Par exemple, sans la salle de commandement de la préfecture de police de Paris, les unités de matraqueurs dans la capitale se trouvent aveugles. Des poulaillers ont également fait l'objet d'énergiques prises d'assaut. C'est là aussi salutaire, le symbole est fort. Mais n'en oublions pas pour autant les palais de l'injustice, car c'est là-bas que se trouvent les magistrats qui nous envoient croupir dans des geôles en prison.


Enfin, je n'ai pu que me réjouir en apprenant qu'un groupe a réussi à se rapprocher de l'Élysée. N'oublions pas qu'il y a là-bas au moins une deuxième entrée, à savoir la grille du coq à l'arrière de sa résidence présidentielle.


 Le ruissellement en acte


La bourgeoisie a toujours pris goût à afficher triomphalement, derrière des vitrines, ses produits de luxes que les gueux ne pourront jamais se payer. Il est donc absolument jouissif de voir, comme dirait le poète, ces boutiques s'ouvrir aux enfants du soufre. Les richesses ne circulent que quand les pauvres récupèrent d'autorité leur dû. Ce que l'on a vu samedi c'est le ruissellement en acte.


Les chaînes de distributions alimentaires, qui sont également ouvertes lors de ce type de journées offensives, disent aussi quelque chose de très politique. Il y a à la fois un : « on ne quémande ou mendie plus pour manger mais on se sert ! ». Mais également une apologie, une ode en acte à la gratuité – un réquisitoire contre l'argent roi.


Ils peuvent bien garder leur indignation mondaine. La prochaine fois, on organise un grand banquet populaire dans la Samaritaine. Nous sommes une génération qui hérite de glorieuses pratiques comme l'autoréduction. Et nous le disons fermement : tant que la boulangerie ne sera pas sous notre contrôle collectif, nous refuserons les miettes que l'on nous jette et nous réquisitionnerons toute la production, des chocolatines comme on dit chez moi jusqu'aux baguettes.


Les atouts de la mobilité et de la dispersion


Lorsque l'on défile entre République et Nation, même à 200 000, chacun de nos mouvements …

author: dev
title: À propos du 17 octobre
content:
L'édition de cette semaine a été chamboulée par la belle journée du 17 octobre et les courbatures qui s'en sont suivies. Une avalanche de récits et d'analyses sont en cours d'édition, pour commencer, ces quelques remarques sur l'heure de vérité présente.


L'intox ou le poker menteur


Tout d'abord, le coup de com' gouvernemental : les services de police auraient fait preuve d'impréparation. Le 17 octobre, l'Etat ne s'y attendait pas. Nous aurions surgi comme un orage d'été imprévu, explosant en un instant dans un ciel jusqu'alors si beau, si pur, si lumineux et étoilé - certes brouillé par les mobilisations lycéennes, mais ceci est un détail. Inattendus donc, saccageant sans pitié les mets raffinés dressés sur la table, gâchant le repas, arrachant la jolie nappe fleurie de la paix sociale, emportant tout dans un grondement criminel.


L'Etat, s'il avait vu la météo, aurait pu faire plus, promet-il dès dimanche matin : on aurait mis les assiettes sous cloche. L'Etat, aujourd'hui fait penser à ce type bourré et titubant à la sortie d'une boîte de nuit sur les Champs, sauvé par le gong et ses potes, levant le poing et promettant qu'il était à deux doigts de remporter la bagarre.


Alerte spoiler : c'est faux.


Donc, commençons par le plus facile : griller le bluff. Démasquer l'escroc. Dans sa main aujourd'hui, un 2 de carreau et un 7 de pique, et par conséquent, deux possibilités seulement : se coucher ou tenter de nous arnaquer. La clique à Macron choisit sans surprise la deuxième option.


Pourquoi la thèse de l'impréparation ne tient pas


Avec un budget de 37 milliards d'euros dont 27 milliards dédiés à la Police et la Gendarmerie Nationale, on aurait pu penser les RG suffisamment dotés pour infiltrer nos réseaux, pourtant publics. Tout y était exposé, depuis des semaines. Nos grands-parents étaient dans la rue, à nos côtés, eux qui pourtant n'ont ni Signal, ni Telegram, ni Instagram. Mais l'Etat, lui, ne savait pas. Peut-être devrait-il penser à engager Mamie. Elle est mieux renseignée.


Parenthèse : si c'était vrai ? S'ils n'avaient vraiment rien vu venir ? Alors combien faut-il ne rien comprendre au pays pour ne pas avoir vu l'explosion venir.


Mais ça ne tient pas. Disons les faits. L'Etat savait. Nunez la cuve à pisse savait.


Pour le dire autrement, voici donc ce qu'on tente de nous faire croire.


Si, ce samedi, à Lyon, Limoges, Marseille, Paris, Pau, Rennes, en Guadeloupe, etc. nous avons marché sur la tête des rois, ce n'est pas de notre fait. Non non braves gens, lycéens, étudiants, ouvriers et paysans, grands-mères en colère, gamins affamés, employés insultés, syndicalistes, prolétaires, et j'en passe, ne vous flattez point. Ne gonflez pas vos égos de cette (pourtant) si évidente et resplendissante victoire populaire sur l'autoritarisme et la violence des sociopathes en uniforme à la botte de Nunez. Vous n'avez pas marché sur la tête des rois. Au contraire, le roi, sa cuve à pisse (on ne se lasse pas de l'injure) et toute sa cour se sont laissés piétinés. Mais pourquoi ? Par négligence. Voilà ce qu'on veut nous faire croire. Braves gens, soyez prévenus. Une fois, pas deux.


Telle est l'embrouille, la tentative un peu ridicule et désespérée de poker menteur. Il faut nous faire croire à l'impréparation. Parce que derrière cette martialité de façade, ça tremble, ça panique.


Il faut entendre la chorale médiatique et ses journalistes de préfecture, du

Monde

 à

CNews

 reprendre en un seul et unique chant du cygne l'embrouille gouvernementale et appeler plus ou moins au carnage vengeur.


Voici donc l'Etat et ses préfets, le ministère de l'intérieur et le violeur de la Justice qui se flagellent (ne gâchons pas notre plaisir, c'est sympathique à voir) sans oublier de nous insulter puisque c'est leur unique langage avec celui des armes. Et tous ces bons soldats (à l'exception du chef suprême de ceux-ci bien sûr, car la honte n'a pas de prise sur Macron) proposent leur démission. Ah non ! répond Macron. Ne me laissez pas seul. Car ils ne sont pas loin - presque dans ma couche.


Il faut entendre l'effroi du roi.


Camarades, la victoire se perçoit à l'odeur de merde qui émane du pouvoir. Oui, ils se chient dessus. Dès samedi, repartons au combat.


Le malaise “pillage” ou la constitution d'un peuple révolutionnaire


A propos du piège cuit et recuit de la division des forces révolutionnaires


Âmes sensibles s'abstenir.


Breaking news : la révolution, c'est violent.


Ce qui ne nous empêche pas …
