author: Mag
title: Warum wählen immer mehr ArbeiterInnen in Deutschland die AfD?
content:
Dossier


„

… Arbeiter gehören zu den Berufsgruppen, die die AfD besonders stark unterstützen. (…) In der Parteienforschung wird seit geraumer Zeit diskutiert, ob der besondere Erfolg der AfD diese zu einer neuen Arbeiterpartei macht. Weitgehend unstrittig ist, dass ihr Wahlprogramm nicht unbedingt als arbeiterfreundlich bezeichnet werden kann. Dass sie dennoch unter Arbeitern überdurchschnittlich erfolgreich ist, wird unter anderem darauf zurückgeführt, wie sie Unzufriedenheit und Protest aufgreift. (…) Die Arbeitsbedingungen haben einen direkten Einfluss auf die politische Entscheidungsfindung. Die Studie legt nahe, dass Unzufriedenheit im Arbeitsleben zu einer Hinwendung zu Parteien führt, die radikale Veränderungen versprechen, wie dies bei der AfD der Fall ist

…“

Beitrag von Bernd Müller vom 03. Dezember 2023 in Telepolis


 („Warum wählen immer mehr Arbeiter in Deutschland die AfD?“) über die WSI-Studie zu AfD-Wählern – siehe mehr zu dieser und zum Thema:


Warum die AfD keine Arbeiterpartei ist


„

Bei der Bundestagswahl 2025 gaben 38 Prozent der Arbeiterinnen und Arbeiter ihre Stimme der AfD. Wie kann das sein, wo diese doch eine Politik gegen die Interessen von Arbeitnehmern vertritt? Der Soziologe Klaus Dörre sucht im Gespräch mit Claus-Jürgen Göpfert [am 14.10.2026 in Frankfurt/M.] nach Antworten. Die Veranstaltung findet nicht im Club Voltaire, sondern im Haus am Dom statt. Der Club ist Mitveranstalter

.“

Video von Club Voltaire Frankfurt vom 15.10.2026


 (1:23 Std.) samt Transkript bei youtube


[„Gewerkschaftsratschlag“ und „Megazoom“ der Initiative Arbeiter*innen gegen Faschismus ] Nicht alle stehen rechts 


„

Wenige Tage nach der Landtagswahl in Sachsen-Anhalt, bei der sechs von zehn Arbeiter*innen die AfD wählten, trafen sich über 140 Gewerkschafterinnen, Betriebsrätinnen und Beschäftigte zum „Megazoom“ der Initiative Arbeiter*innen gegen Faschismus. Kolleg*innen aus völlig unterschiedlichen Branchen: Pflege, Logistik, Medien, Bildung und Wissenschaft.


Was als Idee einer Berliner Intensivpflegekraft begann, nimmt konkrete Formen an:

Vom 22. bis 24. Januar 2027 soll eine bundesweite Konferenz unter dem Motto „Verstehen, Vernetzen, Verabreden“ in Halle (Saale) stattfinden

 – also in Sachsen-Anhalt, wo die AfD die meisten Stimmen holte. Mobilisiert wird dabei ohne große finanzielle Mittel, über persönliche und kollegiale Netzwerke in den Betrieben – genau darin sehen die Organisatorinnen ihre größte Stärke.


Zwei Treffen innerhalb einer Woche


Bereits am 8. September, zwei Tage vor dem Megazoom, hatten sich 114 Kolleginnen zum mittlerweile zweiten „Gewerkschaftsratschlag“ getroffen. Unter dem Titel „Sozialstaat verteidigen – Die Reichen zur Kasse“ stand der Austausch zu den Sozialprotesten im Mittelpunkt, mit Berichten einer ver.di-Vertrauensperson und einer Betriebsrätin über die Mobilisierung aus den Betrieben. (…)


Diverse Branchen waren auch hier vertreten: Ein Sporttherapeut aus Berlin moderierte die Videokonferenz, eine Intensivpflegekraft, ein Kollege der Berliner Stadtreinigung, eine Betriebsrätin vom Lufthansa-Bodenpersonal präsentierten sich als Initiatoren. „Wir sind die, die dieses Land am Laufen halten“, brachte es der Kollege der Stadtreinigung auf den Punkt. „Wenn wir uns wehren, dann kann uns keiner aufhalten.“


Wissenschaftlichen Input bei den „Arbeiter:innen gegen Faschismus“, die mittlerweile mehr als 500 Kolleg:innen auf ihrem Informationskanal zählen, lieferte ein Kollege, der sich schon lange mit der AfD beschäftigt. Im Zentrum steht das „AfD-Paradox“: überdurchschnittliche Zustimmung unter Arbeiterinnen bei einem Programm gegen ihre Interessen – verschärft dadurch, dass viele das sogar wissen.


Die AfD bediene den Mythos der „hart arbeitenden Bevölkerung“, der Partei der „Leistungsträger“, und stigmatisiert zugleich Sozialleistungsempfängerinnen: 66 Prozent der AfD-Wählerinnen halten Bürgergeldbezug für ein „bequemes Leben auf Kosten der Gesellschaft“. Zudem steht die Partei der organisierten Arbeiterinnenbewegung offen feindselig gegenüber.


Als Angriffspunkt gegen die AfD böte sich ihre Kampagne gegen „kulturfremde Fachkräfte“ an, die sich gegen so viele Kolleg:innen richtet, ohne die die Betriebe in der Pflege und der Logistik stillstehen würden. Die Diagnose des Referenten: Die Legitimationskrise des Parteienstaats habe ihr Epizentrum in der Arbeiter:innenklasse. Die Antwort muss demokratische Selbstwirksamkeit am Arbeitsplatz sein: Solidarität …

author: Miriam Lafontaine
title: Qikiqtarjuaq man forfeits right to jury trial after sleeping in
content:
A Qikiqtarjuaq man lost his right to a jury trial after he accidentally slept through a court date in early September.


Ronald Audlakiak faces four charges, alleged to have taken place between Nov. 30 and Dec. 5, 2024. They include sexual assault with a weapon, assault involving suffocation, assault and uttering threats.


His four-day jury trial was supposed to begin on the morning of Sept. 1 in Qikiqtarjuaq.


Sixty community members had gathered at Qikiqtarjuaq’s community hall anticipating the start of jury selection, Justice Mark Mossey said in a written decision dated Oct. 15.


When Audlakiak didn’t present himself at court, Mossey delayed the proceedings until the afternoon. He did not give a reason, in an effort to avoid prejudicing the jurors.


Audlakiak then arrived when court reconvened and jury selection proceeded in the afternoon.


The accused once again failed to show up the next morning, for Day 2 of his trial.


Mossey declared a mistrial, issued an arrest warrant and, an hour later, RCMP found him asleep in his mother’s home.


When court reconvened in the afternoon to determine next steps, Audlakiak said he did not want to give up his right to jury trial and requested a hearing to determine whether that right had been waived.


“Mr. Audlakiak took the stand and explained that he simply slept in that morning,” said Mossey in his decision. “His evidence was that he only woke up when the police came to his home to execute the warrant for his arrest. He testified that he had gone to bed relatively early for him, around midnight, but did not have an alarm.”


Audlakiak acknowledged that he could have asked his mother or two adult sisters to wake him up, but he did not.


As for the apparent non-appearance during jury selection, Audlakiak explained he did show up and was in court with the group of potential jurors.


“Mr. Audlakiak did not provide an explanation as to why he did not present himself to the court, or his lawyer,” Mossey wrote.


Audlakiak has a constitutional right to a trial by jury, explained Mossey in his decision. But an accused who fails to appear at their own trial without a reasonable excuse can be deemed to have waived that right.


Defence lawyer Alan Regel argued that the “vast majority” of Qikiqtarjuaq’s population has been impacted by colonialism, and denying Audlakiak the right to a jury by his peers could be seen as an extension of that.


“What message does it send to the community, if the allegations are serious enough that the Crown files a direct indictment, personally signed by the Attorney General of Canada, that he is exposed to a jail term as great as 34 years, he has no chance of a preliminary inquiry — and he loses his right to have a jury simply because he slept in,” Regel said.


Regel also pointed out Audlakiak has been unemployed for years and is not accustomed to keeping a regular schedule.


“The court needs to consider as well, that the concept of time of an Inuit person growing up in a remote northern community … may be different from that of the court,” Regal said.


Mossey sided with the Crown, which argued sleeping in is not a reasonable excuse for missing a jury trial.


He took into consideration the cost — financial and otherwise — of delivering “meaningful access to justice” to people in the communities.


Mossey pointed out that the approximately 10 per cent of Qikiqtarjuaq’s population of approximately 600 people who showed up for jury duty was taken out of the workforce, from child-care duties and from hunting.


“The level of disruption to the community is evident,” Mossey said, adding allowing for a new jury trial would “minimize the cost” of the community fulfilling its jury obligations.


Mossey said at best, Audlakiak took a “cavalier approach to his jury trial” and that he was “wilfully blind in making the mistake of not taking even the smallest of precautions to ensure that he would be awake in time for trial.”


Audlakiak’s trial is set to resume, before a judge alone, on Feb. 25.

title: Özgür Çelik’ten ameliyata alınan tutuklu Belediye Başkanı Mutlu’nun durumuna tepki: Tarih bu zulmü unutmayacak
content:
Silivri Cezaevi’nde tutuklu bulunan Bayrampaşa Belediye Başkanı Hasan Mutlu, sol bacağındaki rahatsızlık nedeniyle sabah saatlerinde ameliyata alındı. Mutlu, geçirdiği ameliyatın ardından yeniden cezaevine götürüldü.

Eylül 2025'te de aynı rahatsızlık nedeniyle acil olarak ameliyata alınan Mutlu, sol bacağındaki rahatsızlık nedeniyle sabah saatlerinde hastanede ameliyat edildi. Eylül ayında ameliyatın ardından taburcu olan Mutlu, dört gün sonra 13 Eylül’de kontrol ve tedavi süreci tamamlanamadan gözaltına alınmış, ardından tutuklanmıştı. Cezaevinde ağrıları ve şikâyetleri artan Mutlu, 22 Ekim’de Silivri Devlet Hastanesi’ne götürülerek kontrol edilmişti.

Tutuklu Bayrampaşa Belediye Başkanı Hasan Mutlu ameliyata alındı

Yeni Parti İstanbul İl Başkanı Özgür Çelik, Mutlu’nun ameliyatının ardından X hesabından açıklama yaptı. Mutlu’nun daha önce de aynı nedenle ameliyat olduğunu hatırlatan Çelik, duruma tepki gösterdi.

"Silivri Zindanı'nda tutuklu bulunan Bayrampaşa'nın seçilmiş Belediye Başkanı Hasan Mutlu bugün sabah saatlerinde hastaneye götürülmüş ve sol bacağından ameliyat olmuştur.

Ameliyatın ardından yeniden cezaevine götürülen başkanımızın daha önce de bu nedenle ameliyat olduğu bilinmekte olduğu halde tutuklu yargılanmaya devam ediyor.

Onlarca dosyası olmasına rağmen halkımızın canına kast edenler, uyuşturucu tacirleri ve suçlular tutuksuz yargılanıp sokaklarda serbestçe dolaşırken Hasan Mutlu'ya ve yol arkadaşlarımıza sadece muhalif olduğu ve Bayrampaşa'yı kazandığı için yapılan zulmü herkes görüyor.

Bu işe sebep olanların, yetkisi olduğu halde kullanmayanların, yasaları bile isteye çiğneyenlerin aldıkları ah çoğalıyor, veballeri iki dünyada da taşıyamayacakları kadar büyüyor.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Эррико Малатеста - О "нашем" Анархизме
content:

Det Anarkistiska Biblioteket (sv)

У меня такое впечатление – и по тому, что появляется в наших различных периодических изданиях в Италии и за границей, и по тому, что присылают нам товарищи и что в значительной части остаётся неопубликованным из-за нехватки места или потому, что набор и вёрстка решительно не поспевают, – у меня, говорю я, впечатление, что нам ещё не удалось добиться, чтобы все поняли цели, которые мы ставим перед этим изданием.

В самом деле, есть те, кто, истолковывая по-своему наше явное стремление к практичности и к осуществлению наших идей, полагает, что мы намерены «начать ревизионистский процесс ценностей теоретического анархизма», и, сообразно со своими склонностями и предпочтениями, боится или надеется, что мы хотим отказаться – на практике, если не в теории – от наших строго анархических воззрений.

В действительности мы не считаем, как некоторые заставили нас сказать, что существует «антиномия между теорией и практикой». Мы, напротив, считаем, что вообще теория верна лишь тогда, когда она подтверждается практикой, и что в нашем случае, если анархию нельзя осуществить сразу, то вовсе не из-за недостаточности теории, а потому, что не все являются анархистами, и анархисты ещё не обладают силой, чтобы завоевать хотя бы свою собственную свободу и заставить уважать её.

Словом, мы остаёмся твёрдыми в идеях, которые с самого возникновения были душой анархического движения, и нам решительно не от чего отрекаться. Говорим это не в качестве заслуги, ибо если бы мы считали, что в прошлом впали в ошибку, мы почли бы своим долгом признать это и исправиться; но говорим это потому, что это факт. И тот, кто знает пропагандистские писания, распространённые повсюду основателями этого Журнала, вряд ли смог бы найти хоть одно противоречие между тем, что мы говорим сейчас, и тем, что говорили более чем пятьдесят лет назад.

Итак, речь идёт не о «ревизии», а о развитии идей и их применении к текущим обстоятельствам.

Когда анархические идеи были новинкой, которая изумляла и ошеломляла, и можно было лишь вести пропаганду ввиду далёкого будущего, а сами попытки восстания и добровольно спровоцированные и принятые на себя судебные процессы служили лишь для привлечения общественного внимания в целях пропаганды, – тогда могло быть достаточно критики современного общества и изложения идеала, к которому стремились. Даже вопросы тактики в сущности были лишь вопросами о лучших средствах для распространения идей и подготовки индивидов и масс к желанным преобразованиям.

Но сегодня времена более зрелые, обстоятельства изменились, и всё заставляет думать, что в срок, который мог бы быть близким, но который уж точно не очень далёк, мы окажемся в возможности и в необходимости применить теории к реальным фактам и показать, что мы не только более правы, чем другие, в силу превосходства нашего идеала свободы, но и потому, что наши идеи и наши методы наиболее практичны для достижения максимума свободы и благосостояния, возможного при нынешнем состоянии цивилизации.

Сама свирепствующая и тревожная реакция держит страну в состоянии неустойчивого равновесия, которое оставляет открытым путь как для всех надежд, так и для всех катастроф. И анархисты могут в любой момент быть призваны показать свою ценность и оказать на события давление, которое поначалу может и не быть преобладающим, но будет тем больше, чем больше будет их число и их моральная и техническая способность.

Следовательно, необходимо воспользоваться этим переходным периодом, который может быть лишь периодом спокойной подготовки, чтобы собрать как можно больше моральных и материальных сил и быть готовыми ко всему, что может произойти.

Факт, который нельзя упускать из виду, таков: мы – относительно небольшое меньшинство и останемся таковым до того …

title: Face à l'expulsion imminente des 280 habitant-es de la place de Milan, rassemblement à 16h devant la Métropole !
content:
La Métropole de Lyon s'apprête à remetrte à la rue 280 personnes dont des femmes et des enfants qui occuement un bâtiment vide place de Milan depuis le 6 mars 2026. Pour cela, elle a demandé à la Préfecture le concours de la force publique. Quelques personnes se verront proposer un hébergement d'urgence. Toutes les autres seront mises dehors, exposé-es à la violence de la rue, et aux intemperies, et bientôt au froid.


Non-assistance à personnes en danger


Le fait de ne pas intervenir volontairement ou de ne pas alerter les secours face à une personne en péril est puni par la loi. Le code pénal prévoit même des sanctions.


Pourtant la Métropole estime qu'un lointain projet de démolition, peut justifier de tels actes. La Préfecture, elle, rencontrée récemment, propose aux personnes de quitter le territoire.


Ainsi les résidentes de l'immeuble, parce qu'étrangères, ne peuvent plus prétendre à l'égalité devant la loi commune à tous et toutes. Ainsi elles se voient refusé le droit à l'hébergement d'urgence pourtant inconditionnel dans la loi. Pour cette raison, la Métropole comme la Préfecture s'apprêtent à faire subir un traitement dégradant et cruel à des personnes et ne reculent pas devant l'ignoble.


Cette politique d'agressivité contre des personnes et à plus forte raison contre des femmes et des enfants est dégradante pour ceux qui décident de ces actes mais aussi pour l'agglomération au nom de laquelle elle agit.


L'absence d'empathie dont la métropole fait preuve est inquiétante pour toutes et tous.


Si l'expulsion a lieu, ce sera un campement de plus dans la ville alors que le bâtiment restera vide.


Il n'est pas trop tard

 

! Ne baissons pas les bras

 

! Beaucoup de voix se sont déjà élevées pour condamner cette violence à l'encontre des occupantes et pour leur témoigner leur soutien.


Nous appelons les citoyens, associations, organisations, élu.es pour qui le respect des autres, la dignité, la fraternité, et l'égalité des droits sont le socle de la vie commune à demander ensemble à la Métropole de Lyon l'abandon de la décision d'expulsion

author: CMI Argentina
title: Juicio Molinos: “Antes de su secuestro, a mi hermano le ofrecieron plata para que dejara la fábrica y abandonara el país”
content:
En la cuarta jornada del debate oral y público por crímenes de lesa humanidad cometidos en la planta de Avellaneda de la firma Molinos Río de La Plata, el extrabajador de la sección Expedición, Guido Almaraz –cuyo hermano Ricardo Avelino Almaraz fue secuestrado el 7 de julio de 1976 junto a su esposa Celia Arzamendia en su casa de Lanús Este- declaró acerca de las protestas y acciones de reclamo por derechos laborales que los obreros llevaron adelante en los años previos al golpe de estado y que desembocaron en el señalamiento, persecución y amenazas de quienes terminarían siendo secuestrados y desaparecidos por un grupo de tareas que operaba directamente en el interior de la fábrica. En este juicio sólo se contemplan tres de un total de 24 trabajadores de Molinos desaparecidos: Francisco Fernández, Santos Ojeda y Roberto José Rivolta Bonino.


El miércoles 14 se llevó a cabo una nueva jornada del juicio en el que se ventila la responsabilidad penal de quien fuera jefe de Personal de la planta de Molinos Avellaneda, Emilio Parodi, en torno al secuestro de tres trabajadores que hasta el día de hoy permanecen desaparecidos: Francisco Fernández, Santos Ojeda y Roberto José Rivolta Bonino.


Los hechos ocurrieron el 7 de julio de 1976 y además de esas víctimas hubo otras 21 cuyos casos se investigan en distintas causas. A instancias del Tribunal Oral Federal 2 de La Plata -con la presidencia del magistrado Pablo Wilk y las vocalías de Nelson Jarazo y Yesica Sircovich-, el juicio atraviesa la etapa de declaraciones testimoniales que, en general y desde distintas perspectivas, aluden a la hipótesis fiscal respecto a un operativo ilegal llevado a cabo por las fuerzas de seguridad cuyos miembros ingresaron armados y portando listas que contenían nombre de trabajadores.


Las personas secuestradas fueron obligadas a subir a un camión del Ejército argentino sin que, hasta el momento, se conozca su destino. En ese marco, el exgerente de Recursos Humanos y jefe de Personal de la planta de Molinos Avellaneda, Emilio Parodi, es quien habría señalado a los trabajadores que luego serían secuestrados y desaparecidos por el Ejército y la Policía Federal.


En este juicio Parodi está siendo juzgado como coautor funcional del delito de privación ilegal de la libertad de Francisco Fernández, Santos Ojeda y Roberto José Rivolta Bonino, en virtud del rol y actividades desplegadas e inherentes al ejercicio de tareas gerenciales o de dirección de la empresa al momento de los hechos.


De acuerdo a la acusación fiscal, esa conducta facilitó la ocurrencia de los hechos y consolidaron dicha situación a través del impedimento del acceso a la información por parte de los familiares de las víctimas y, más allá de la petición solicitada, los hechos que se investigan constituyen delitos de lesa humanidad y en consecuencia son imprescriptibles para el ordenamiento jurídico argentino.


Uno de los testimonios brindados en la jornada del miércoles 14 de octubre fue el de un extrabajador de la sección Expedición de la planta de Molinos situada en Avellaneda, Guido Almaraz, cuyo hermano Ricardo y su cuñada Celia Arzamendia fueron secuestrados aquel 7 de julio de 1976 de su casa de Lanús Este.


“Antes del secuestro de mi hermano, el ambiente era insostenible para los trabajadores de Molinos. Había señalamientos, persecuciones dentro y fuera de la planta, amenazas y una presencia constante de un grupo al que llamaban ´bomberos’ pero que entiendo que eran policías dentro de la fábrica”, contextualizó el testigo.


De acuerdo a su relato, Ricardo Almaraz junto a otros trabajadores habían impulsado desde varios años antes del golpe de Estado las reuniones para intercambiar experiencias y organizar un conjunto de reclamos relativos a las pésimas condiciones laborales y de seguridad que existían en la fábrica que en ese entonces pertenecía al grupo Bunge y Born.


Fue así como nació una primera junta interna y un intento de toma de la fábrica a mediados de 1974 que no pudo terminar con resultados favorables respecto a los objetivos de la acción. Sin embargo, en marzo de 1975 se realizó una toma exitosa que terminó con la aceptación de casi la totalidad de las reivindicaciones que exigieron los trabajadores a la gerencia de Molinos.

title: «No es aumento, es ajuste»: docentes bonaerenses rechazan el 6% de aumento de Kicillof y convocan a paros, ollas populares y movilizaciones
content:
Imagen: Política Obrera.


Las seccionales y agrupaciones de SUTEBA Multicolor y la Asociación de Maestrxs de la Provincia de Buenos Aires convocaron a nuevas medidas de fuerza contra el acuerdo salarial del 6%, en dos tramos del 3%, correspondientes a octubre y noviembre, acordado por la mayoría de los gremios que integran el Frente de Unidad Docente Bonaerense (FUDB) con el gobierno de Axel Kicillof. Las medidas incluyen un paro provincial para este martes 20 de octubre, otro para el miércoles 21, una olla popular frente a la Gobernación bonaerense y una movilización a la Dirección General de Cultura y Educación (DGCyE) para el próximo jueves 22.

La Multicolor denuncia que la conducción provincial de SUTEBA pretende aprobar la propuesta «sin mandato de las escuelas», reclama asambleas por establecimiento para definir las medidas de lucha y, además, la devolución de los descuentos por paros, la defensa del estatuto docente, el rechazo al presentismo, y mejoras en IOMA y en las condiciones de trabajo. En tanto, la Asociación de Maestrxs expresó:  «rechazamos por miserable la propuesta de aumento que le da la espalda a las necesidades de la docencia bonaerense. $10.491 al básico, $ 4.256 al código 455 en gris y $921 al incentivo docente en negro no es aumento, es ajuste».

title: “Şahiya Hebûn û Azadî” events kicks off in Germany
content:
The opening of the “Şahiya Hebûn û Azadî” events, organized in Stuttgart and the nearby cities of Reutlingen and Tübingen, has taken place.


The event, which featured cultural programs and political assessments, addressed the peace and democratic society process currently on the agenda of the Kurdish people.


The program attracted a large audience and featured performances by artists Simar, Narinxan, and Çiwo Bakur.


Speaking at the event, politician Faysal Sarıyıldız drew attention to the current stage of the process and the steps that need to be taken in the period ahead.


Sarıyıldız emphasized the need to embrace the process, take part in the communes to be established, and strengthen social organization. He also highlighted the importance of expanding democratic organization and continuing political activities.


Following the speeches, artists Simar, Narinxan, and Kurdish rap artist Çiwo Bakur took to the stage. The program, which included musical performances and cultural activities, concluded amid strong interest from participants.


As part of “Şahiya Hebûn û Azadî,” various cultural events and commemorative programs will be held over the coming month in Stuttgart and surrounding cities. Different programs are planned for each weekend, with events also expected to continue in other cities across the region.

title: Families demand reconstruction of destroyed guerrilla cemeteries in Şırnak
content:
Following the process initiated by the Call for Peace and a Democratic Society, many cemeteries in Kurdistan that had been prohibited for years were visited for the first time. HPG and YJA Star guerrillas were buried there, but have been demolished. Gravestones had been rendered unrecognizable by excavators, damaged in aerial attacks, and, in some cases, buried in pits. In Şirnak (Şirnex), where such attacks have become systematic, families are calling for the cemeteries to be rebuilt and access routes reopened.


 


The Cuma Bilika and Binevş Edessa Martyrs’ Cemetery on Mount Cûdî was bombed and destroyed in 2015; its surrounding wall, mosque, and guesthouse were also damaged. The cemetery, which could not be visited for years on the grounds that it was in a military security zone, was visited on 2 August 2026, for the first time in 11 years. On 11 October it was discovered that the gravestones had been buried together in a pit. At the cemetery, the family of Cihan Zilan (Hatice Erbağa), who fell as a martyr in 2006, found the grave they had been searching for over the years.


The Martyr Binevş Cemetery in the village of Basret on Mount Gabar was also targeted in the attacks. It was learned that the cemetery, built between 2010 and 2014, had been damaged and that numerous gravestones bearing the names of those who had fallen as martyrs had been broken.


The Goristana Martyr Rojat and Martyr Zelal Cemetery in the Besta region was also damaged in an aerial attack in 2017. The region was then declared a military security zone for many years.


The Kato-Feraşin cemetery is still off limits


Nuri Salgucak, an executive of MEBYA-DER in Şirnak who has visited the cemeteries alongside families and has been working on the issue, spoke about their current condition. Stating that they wanted to rebuild the cemeteries, Salgucak said the attacks constituted crimes against humanity.


Providing information about the number of bodies buried in the cemeteries in Cûdî, Besta, Gabar, and Kato-Feraşin, Salgucak said: “There are four martyrs’ cemeteries: Cûdî, Besta, Gabar, and Kato-Feraşin. There are 98 bodies in Cûdî, 160 in Besta, and 71 in Gabar. We do not know how many bodies are in Feraşin. Access to the area is still prohibited because a police station has been built next to it. Therefore, neither we nor the families are allowed to visit the cemeteries.”


Salgucak said the attacks on cemeteries are unacceptable, adding that “the condition of the cemeteries is terrible; they have demolished all of them. During periods of conflict, they wanted to take revenge on the dead. They have looted everything. They have left nothing among the graves and completely demolished the surrounding areas. We do not know how to describe those images. This is an entirely inhumane policy. Attacks on cemeteries are unacceptable, both legally and morally. It makes a person ashamed of humanity. When families see the cemeteries, they repeatedly say that this is unacceptable and that the cemeteries must be protected. Such attacks do not happen anywhere else in the world.”


Remains have all been identified


Salgucak said: “There are no unclaimed remains in Şirnak. All the families have provided blood samples in connection with their relatives’ remains. Some remains have been identified. However, even though some families provided blood samples years ago, the state has not responded to this matter for a long time. The blood samples have not yielded results, and the families are being kept waiting. Apart from that, there is a mass grave in the city where bodies were buried in the 1990s. It is located in the Cumhuriyet neighborhood of Şirnak. We do not know how many people are buried in this grave.” 


The main demand is reconstruction


Nuri Salgucak said: “As an organization, we are carrying out work on this issue. First, we visit the cemeteries together with the families. We want to rebuild all of these cemeteries. How this proceeds will depend on the course of the ongoing process. The other cemeteries we visit are still officially off-limits, but we are taking the initiative and going there. As the images show, the cemeteries have been left in ruins. They have flattened the Besta Martyrs’ Cemetery with excavators. The situation in Cûdî is no different. This is clearly visible in the footage we have recorded.”

title: Arîn Student Association opens in Istanbul
content:
The Arîn Student Association opened in İskender Paşa neighbourhood in Istanbul's Fatih district, established through the initiative of university students. The association attracted considerable interest from students, young people and local residents within hours of opening.


The opening ceremony began with traditional clothing, slogans, applause and halay dances. Feleknaz Karabaş, a member of the Istanbul Peace Mothers' Assembly, was the first to speak. Karabaş said, “It is a source of pride to see you young people protecting your language and culture. Without you, we are incomplete. Language, culture and art are the foundations of a people's existence. Let us protect our existence.”


 


Students reject impositions and come together to build an alternative


Arîn Student Association member Melisa Çelik then read out a press statement. Çelik highlighted the lack of spaces where students can express themselves freely, saying: “Educational institutions, which should contribute to the qualitative development of society in cultural, scientific and social fields, are instead seeking to create obedient and passive masses serving the interests of those in power in particular and capitalist modernity in general. As students, we reject these impositions and have come together here today to develop an alternative.”


University students then performed a play titled Avare, receiving enthusiastic applause for their message: “Against assimilation, young people turn to Arîn!”


Halay dances and slogans continued outside the Arîn Student Association as members Merve Sultan Daş and Abdulmelik Çelik spoke to ANF about Arîn, which they described as a space where university students could “breathe”.


‘Arîn is an alternative academy’


Merve Sultan Daş began by saying that they were living through a time when coming together as a community was more necessary than ever. Daş said: “Students needed a place where they could express themselves democratically and breathe freely. That is why we decided to open Arîn.”


Abdulmelik Çelik then explained the story behind Arîn's name: “Several alternative names were initially proposed. A democratic process was then launched to choose the name. The main reason we chose ‘Arîn’ was its meanings, such as ‘spark’ and ‘before the fire’. Since this is a student association, we chose the name to harness the revolutionary fire of the youthful spirit.”


Merve Sultan Daş said: “We are actually in the process of building a democratic society,” stressing that developing educational spaces and focusing on culture and the arts were among the most important requirements of this process. Daş added, “That is why we aim to create an environment where students can come and develop their cultural and artistic skills, sing songs and spend time with their friends, learning and developing together. We want this to be an alternative to cafés, a place where they can express themselves freely.”


 


Abdulmelik Çelik described Arîn as an academy established as an alternative to universities. Merve Sultan Daş concluded by outlining the association's plans for workshops and inviting young people to take part: “We will have Kurdish, Zazaki and English language workshops. We will also focus on music, including the saz, a traditional long-necked string instrument, the erbane, a frame drum, and the piano. Our doors are always open, and our tea is always hot. We look forward to welcoming you.”


An International Youth Delegation from eight different countries, which had applied to the Ministry of Justice for a meeting with Kurdish People's Leader Abdullah Öcalan, also joined Kurdish young people in halay dances at Arîn's opening ceremony.


Isabelle W., a member of the German Democratic Youth Union (YUNA) who was part of the delegation, spoke to ANF about the opening of the Arîn Student Association and the Peace and Democratic Society Process.


‘The process is an opportunity to build a communal society’


Isabelle W. spoke against the backdrop of music, halay dances and slogans echoing through the street. Isabelle W. said: “I think it's wonderful that Kurdish students, and indeed all young students, have a place where they can come to learn more about their own cultures, learn their mother tongues and spend time with organised people. We are here now, and there is so much happening in the street... It's really beautiful to see everyone embracing their own culture. Bijî berxwedana ciwanan! (Long live the resistance of the …

title: YBŞ spokesperson: We want genuine integration
content:
Hadi Elyas, spokesperson for the Shengal Resistance Units (YBŞ), spoke about the integration of security and administrative institutions in Shengal into the Iraqi state structure during the program “Hevpeyvîneke Taybet” (Special Interview), broadcast on Çira TV.


Referring to their meetings with Iraqi state officials, Hadi Elyas said: “Our talks with senior security and military officials began in February. The aim was to reach a sound and secure agreement on the integration of our forces, institutions, and community into the Iraqi state system. This is also a process that serves Iraq’s sovereignty. We take this matter very seriously. A formal and legitimate framework is also needed to resolve the other problems facing Shengal. Resolving this issue is a first step toward broader solutions.”


Emphasizing that the problems in Shengal cannot be reduced to security concerns alone, Hadi Elyas continued: “Although security is a very important issue, there are other fundamental matters that need to be addressed, such as the return of displaced people, compensation for citizens, the reconstruction of residential areas, and locating missing persons and those held captive by ISIS. If the security issue is addressed in a formal and systematic manner, it will provide a solid foundation for protecting the identity and achievements of the Yazidi people and guaranteeing their rights within the Iraqi state.”


Noting that discussions on integration came to the fore when Ali Zeydi’s government took office, the YBŞ spokesperson said: “As a force that emerged during a critical period, we were also part of this process. We have never considered ourselves separate from the state. Formal integration is not something that should remain merely on paper. It is a step that will strengthen our forces, our community, and the state itself. We want genuine integration that preserves the distinct characteristics of our community and our forces and prevents a tragedy similar to what happened in 2014 from occurring again.”


Hadi Elyas continued:


“We reached agreement on many points during the talks, particularly in meetings with the prime minister. We want the Êzdîxan Asayish (Yazidi local forces), YBŞ, and YJŞ (Shengal Women’s Units) to become part of the state system. Discussions also focused on protecting the rights of fighters who have resisted since 2014 and integrating them into the system in a way that allows them to continue serving the people of Shengal. Negotiations are still ongoing to achieve an effective outcome.”


Describing the length of the integration process as normal, Hadi Elyas said: “This process is not simply about transferring a military unit. We are dealing with a sensitive issue that will directly affect the future of Shengal, its people, and its forces. It involves aspects that are new to Iraq, such as the presence of women’s forces and the Êzdîxan Asayish. Comprehensive studies and discussions are being conducted on integration, geographical conditions, and the social situation to achieve a lasting and sustainable solution.”


Rejecting allegations that the YBŞ is opposed to the Iraqi state, the YBŞ spokesperson continued: “The Yazidi community and our forces have made sacrifices for Iraq’s sovereignty. At a time when the Iraqi flag was not flying in Anbar, Tikrit, or Mosul, our forces raised it in Shengal. This demonstrates our commitment to this country. Claims to the contrary are nothing more than propaganda. Our community has never considered itself separate from Iraq and has struggled to strengthen the sovereignty of the state.”


Hadi Elyas concluded his remarks with the following message to the Iraqi state:


“Our message to the Iraqi government is that we are serious about formal and systematic integration and want our forces to become part of the state’s security system.


Our message to our people is that this step will safeguard the future, security, and rights of our community.


Genuine stability can only be achieved through the recognition of Yazidi rights, justice, and the reconstruction of Shengal. We hope this process will produce results soon and serve both our community and the sovereignty of the Iraqi state.”

title: DEM Party instructs its municipalities to apply to ministry for Kurdish language units
content:
The DEM Party is advancing efforts to institutionalize Kurdish language promotion within municipal administrations. The party’s Council for Democratic Local Governments has instructed municipalities under its administration to apply to Turkey’s Ministry of Environment, Urbanization and Climate Change for the establishment of independent administrative units dedicated to the preservation and promotion of languages. A corresponding circular has been sent to the municipalities.


The initiative is based on resolutions adopted at the “Conference of Democratic Local Governments” held on June 8 and 9. Under these resolutions, metropolitan municipalities are to establish dedicated departments for the preservation and development of languages. Corresponding directorates are planned for other city, district, and municipal administrations.


Legal obstacles to establishing new departments


During its review of the legal and administrative requirements, the DEM Party found that existing regulations make it difficult to establish these administrative units directly. The Council for Democratic Local Governments therefore developed an alternative approach.


Municipalities are to formally request that the relevant ministry approve changes to the names of administrative units in their existing staffing and organizational structures. The aim is to establish a legal basis for making language promotion a distinct area of responsibility within municipal administrations.


Language promotion to continue without interruption


Regardless of the outcome of the ministry’s review, municipalities are expected to continue their existing programs promoting the Kurdish language. In its circular, the DEM Party emphasizes that developing, institutionalizing, and expanding mother-tongue programs are among the fundamental responsibilities of democratic local governments.


Legal and administrative procedures must therefore not lead to any interruption of ongoing language and cultural activities. Instead, municipalities are called upon to continue their efforts to preserve and further develop the Kurdish language while the necessary conditions for establishing independent administrative units are put in place.

author: CMI Argentina
title: Ataque a la Procuración Penitenciaria de la Nación y al Comité Nacional de Prevención de la Tortura
content:
A varios días del traslado intempestivo, sin cumplir con los protocolos vigentes ni dar aviso a las autoridades judiciales, de las personas detenidas en la cárcel de Devoto en CABA hacia el nuevo complejo federal en Marcos Paz, el Poder Ejecutivo Nacional impide el ingreso de la Procuración Penitenciaria de la Nación y el Comité Nacional de Prevención de la Tortura para controlar las condiciones de detención y entrevistarse con las personas, en el marco de las facultades que le otorga la legislación vigente. En su calidad de Mecanismo Local de Prevención de la Tortura, la Comisión Provincial por la Memoria difundió una declaración reclamando que se permita el ingreso de los organismos de control y resaltando la labor que cumplen.


(Agencia / CPM) Un aspecto central para evaluar la calidad y fortaleza de un estado democrático es, sin lugar a dudas, la autonomía y rigurosidad de sus organismos de control.


El respeto y aceptación de sus evaluaciones, recomendaciones y acciones, muchas veces críticas del accionar del Poder Ejecutivo, fortalecen el principio republicano de gobierno, columna vertebral de nuestro sistema institucional, construido a partir de la división de poderes y la responsabilidad de los funcionarios por sus actos.


Frente a las decisiones y actos arbitrarios de la administración, los organismos de control, tienen la obligación legal y ética de intervenir para revertirlas.


Los gobiernos pueden disentir y discutir sobre las miradas y acciones de estos organismos, pero no deben atacarlos o presionarlos y menos impedir el cumplimiento de sus mandatos legales.


Ante el traslado intempestivo, y sin aviso a las autoridades judiciales, de personas detenidas desde la cárcel de Devoto en CABA hacia el nuevo Complejo Federal VIII de Marcos Paz (provincia de Buenos Aires), la Procuración Penitenciaria de la Nación, en cumplimiento del mandato legal establecido por su ley de creación N° 25.875, inició una serie de acciones administrativas y judiciales tendientes a garantizar sus derechos.


Esto motivó el ataque de la senadora Patricia Bullrich hacia el organismo y su responsable, Ariel Cejas Meliare, hacia quien dirigió además un pedido de informes.


Los traslados se produjeron sin cumplir con los Protocolos vigentes que disponen informar a las autoridades judiciales y defensores de las personas detenidas con 72 horas de anticipación. Se trasladaron a cientos de detenidos sin que sus jueces, defensores o familiares supieran donde estaban alojados.


Esto implicó alojar a las personas lejos de sus hogares, provocando una clara afectación del vínculo familiar. Esto agrava sus condiciones de vida, toda vez que las visitas son indispensables no solo para garantizar este derecho y el sostenimiento afectivo de estas personas sino también para la provisión de alimentos o medicamentos, elementos de higiene y limpieza que son deficientes, escasos o nulos en el ámbito penitenciario.


Por otro lado los detenidos que acceden a la educación universitaria y eran parte del Centro Universitario Devoto -experiencia pionera en el continente- fueron los primeros en ser trasladados sin respetar la finalización del año lectivo, interrumpiéndose así su proceso pedagógico.


A esto se agrega que cuando la Procuración Penitenciaria y el Comité Nacional de Prevención de la Tortura intentaron ingresar al nuevo Complejo de Marcos Paz a controlar las condiciones de detención, las autoridades penitenciarias lo impidieron, violando la normativa legal vigente que crea el Sistema Nacional de Prevención de la Tortura (Ley Nacional N° 26.827) que habilita a los organismos a ingresar de manera irrestricta, y sin avisar previamente a los lugares de encierro, a los fines de su contralor.


El Protocolo Facultativo de la Convención contra la Tortura (OPCAT) que goza de jerarquía constitucional, es decir es parte de nuestra Carta Magna, establece la obligación de garantizar la independencia funcional de los mecanismos de prevención, su acceso efectivo a los lugares de detención, a entrevistar de manera confidencial a las personas detenidas y acceder a toda información vinculada con ellas.


Ambos organismos debieron concurrir a la justicia para lograr dicho acceso, el que aun no se produjo por cuestiones procesales o de trámite, pese a contar con una resolución favorable. Es decir, varios días después de los traslados, aun no pudieron entrevistar a las personas afectadas. Un impedimento muy grave de sus funciones de control.

title: Juan Francisco Solórzano Foppa: Prominent Anti-Corruption Lawyer in Guatemala Assassinated
content:
The prominent Guatemalan anti-corruption lawyer Juan Francisco Solórzano Foppa was fatally shot along with another man on Saturday at a sports center in Guatemala City. For years, Solórzano Foppa had been outspoken against Guatemala’s most powerful politicians, business leaders and companies. He was known for his anti-corruption work as head of the Criminal Investigations Directorate within the Public Prosecutor’s Office and later as head of Guatemala’s tax authority, when he helped prosecute dozens of powerful Guatemalan business figures.


“In more recent years, he developed a social media presence, and he was forcefully denouncing corruption,” says Roman Gressier, a journalist based in Guatemala City. “We were thinking about [the killing of Solórzano Foppa] not only as an assassination, but also having a deep effect on freedom of expression.”


“Juan Francisco was a young lawyer coming from a background of pro-democracy and revolutionary activists,” says Silvia Solórzano Foppa, Juan Francisco’s mother. Her son was 43 years old when he was killed.

title: Spagna chiama Italia: casa e finanziarizzazione
content:
La lotta per il diritto alla casa negli ultimi trent’anni è sempre stata un’invarianza della rigidità che le classi subalterne hanno imposto al potere nella più generale tendenza neo liberista di attacco alle condizioni materiali di vita delle persone. 


Da mesi però assistiamo ad un ritorno di questa lotta come centralità politica a livello internazionale. Partendo dall’elezione a New York del nuovo Sindaco Mamdani, passando per la vittoria a Berlino della candidata Linke Elif Eralp, fino alle imponenti mobilitazioni spagnole partite dalla vicenda Maricarmen la lotta per l’accesso alla casa ha saputo diventare nuovamente una spina nel fianco delle élites capitaliste, anche aggredendo i nuovi meccanismi che la speculazione immobiliare ha messo in campo.


Si possono infatti delineare delle nuove  invarianze in questa ondata  di mobilitazione, ossia l’attacco frontale ai meccanismi di finanziarizzazione della casa e dell’abitare. 


La trasformazione della casa in “asset finanziario” ha infatti inasprito le difficoltà di accedere ad affitti proporzionati ai salari reali e innalzato la barriera economica che divide i proletari e il ceto medio dalla possibilità di acquistare una casa.


In tutti i contesti europei e d’oltreoceano il rapporto fra salario e spesa per garantirsi un tetto sopra la testa è letteralmente saltato, facendo esplodere una vera e propria “bomba” sociale. Questo meccanismo di finanziarizzazione della casa è recentemente approdato anche in Italia, dove le lotte per la casa sono storicamente centrali, ma che negli ultimi anni hanno subito molti attacchi mettendone  a rischio le conquiste del passato. L’insorgere di questo nuovo fenomeno però allarga di fatto la base sociale coinvolta dalla lotta anche nel nostro paese. Siamo di fronte ad un nuovo ciclo di opposizione sociale e antagonista su questo ambito della riproduzione popolare?


Anche se è difficile rispondere a questa domanda crediamo sia importante partire primariamente dai meccanismi materiali alla base di questa scommessa, appunto la finanziarizzazione.


Milano, Firenze, Roma, Torino, Bologna

 e molte altre città sono investite da meccanismi di speculazione immobiliare portate avanti dai fondi che a loro volta sono gestiti e comandati da colossi detti società di gestione del risparmio. Questo meccanismo si somma a quelli storici della gentrificazione, della turistificazione e della speculazione immobiliare intorno all’abitare studentesco.


Abbiamo preso spunto per spiegare questo complesso fenomeno da un’ intervista al Professor Alessandro Volpi apparsa recentemente

qui

.


Il mercato è mosso dalle società di gestione del risparmio che si occupano di immobiliare. Oggi queste hanno un peso importante e sono in sintesi una settantina ed hanno un patrimonio immobiliare che si aggira intorno 145 miliardi di euro. 


Esiste di fatto una grossa concentrazione nella capacità di gestire il patrimonio, infatti tendenzialmente 10 società detengono quasi metà dell’importo complessivo.


 Le società di gestione del risparmio non gestiscono direttamente il patrimonio immobiliare (es Fabrica sgr, Investire sgr), ma generano fondi immobiliari, i quali sono legati a specifici progetti immobiliari, sia di recupero che di acquisto di aree già edificate o di costruzione di nuovi complessi di edifici.


Esistono più o meno 750 fondi immobiliari legati a queste 70 sgr, le 10 più importanti ne hanno di conseguenza una quota maggiore. Quindi diversi fondi immobiliari, nella stessa città o in diverse metropoli italiane, possono usufruire della stessa strategia dovuta al fatto che una singola società di gestione del risparmio ha molti fondi a disposizione.


Il fondo, in particolare, si occupa di decidere i progetti sull’area urbana di riferimento e della gestione del patrimonio immobiliare che possiede. 


Essendo che una sgr guadagna dalle commissioni che gli pagano i fondi, essi vendono le loro quote per finanziarsi.  Fino a poco tempo fa la  tendenza era quella di vendere anche a risparmiatori benestanti di fascia medio alta, ma comunque a patrimonio limitato, se paragonato a grandi agglomerati finanziari, ora  i fondi vengono frammentati e divisi  in quote vendute principalmente a investitori istituzionali. Questi possono essere ad esempio fondi pensione e casse di previdenza degli ordini professionali o altri con grandi capacità. Così facendo vi è quindi un  allargamento della base di reperibilità delle risorse per il fondo, accentrando grosse …

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: Masked Israeli Settlers Nearly Kill Washington Post Journalist as Attacks on Palestinians Escalate
content:
Israeli settlers backed by

IDF

 soldiers brutally assaulted Palestinian olive farmers in the village of Abu Falah, northeast of Ramallah, on Friday. Witnesses say dozens of masked Israeli settlers armed with clubs, sticks, slingshots and guns hurled rocks at Palestinian farmers, set olive trees ablaze and drove people from their fields. Veteran

Washington Post

 photojournalist Heidi Levine, a 64-year-old American, was documenting the attack when settlers began beating her. She suffered stab wounds, a broken rib, four broken vertebrae and a severe hand injury. Levine was wearing a clearly marked press vest and a helmet at the time of the attack. According to the Israeli human rights group Yesh Din, Israeli settlers have carried out at least 170 attacks against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank since September 27, which marked the start of this year’s olive harvest.


“It looked like they were killing her,” says independent American journalist Jasper Nathaniel, who witnessed the attack on Levine and helped intervene. “The Palestinian youth, the

shabab

, stepped up. They ran out ahead, and they started beating the settlers back by throwing stones at them, which is the only thing that allowed me to then run out front and grab Heidi.” As the journalists and Palestinians retreated into Abu Falah, “The Israeli military jeep that had been standing by the settlers who were attacking us then drives into the village itself, … and they start firing into crowds of Palestinian people.”

author: Miriam Lafontaine
title: ‘Burnout and hardship’: Nunavut teachers struggle with loss of student support workers
content:
Teachers in Nunavut have access to fewer student support assistants this year after school-related requests became ineligible for funding under the Inuit Child First Initiative.


The federal funding program, similar to Jordan’s Principle, is designed to ensure Inuit children across Canada have equal access to health, social and educational supports.


In the 2024-25 school year, the Inuit Child First Initiative allowed Nunavut’s 27 district education authorities to pay the salaries of 88 casual student support workers. The staff worked in elementary and high schools, according to figures provided to Nunatsiaq News by Nunavut’s Education Department.


Last year, the department approved 75 casual workers, said department spokesperson Kuthula Matshazi in an email.


He declined to say how many casual support workers are working in Nunavut schools this year. Instead, he characterized it as a “limited number.”


“When that funding was readily available,” said Nunavut Teachers Association president Justin Matchett in an interview, “there were a lot of schools that were accessing that and getting additional support staff.”


Student support workers join classroom teachers to help deliver curriculum, with a particular focus on students who require accommodations.


In February 2025, Indigenous Services Canada annoucned that requests for student support assistants would no longer be eligible for funding under the Inuit Child First Initiative, except for in exceptional cases.


Nunavut’s classrooms look very different without that funding, Matchett said.


“There’s a lot of behaviour needs, a lot of medical diagnoses that need and deserve special attention,” he said. “It definitely causes a lot of stress, burnout and hardship on the teachers when they’re trying to manage all of that on top of teaching the curriculum.”


The Nunavut Employees Union, which represents the GN’s permanent student support staff, isn’t opposed to the government hiring fewer casual student support assistants, said president Jason Rochon in an email.


He has been concerned about support staff roles going to non-unionized workers.


“These were casual, lesser paid and non-unionized roles for essentially the same work as unionized [support] positions under our collective agreement with the GN,” said Rochon.


“All [support] positions should be unionized and covered by the NEU’s collective agreement with the Government of Nunavut,” he added. “We encourage the employer to ensure that enough [support workers] are hired across Nunavut schools.”


Indigenous Services Minister Mandy Gull-Masty promised in November 2025 to revamp Inuit Child First Initiative and make it permanent. She

announced

 a $115-million, one-year extension in February.


The $115-million top up ensures “continuity” while the department works on a long-term approach for Inuit Child First Initiative, said Carolane Gratton, spokesperson for the department, in an email to Nunatsiaq News.


In the interim, all funding for school-related needs are reviewed on a case to case basis.


“Although the Inuit Child First Initiative can support child-specific education-related requests, such as psycho educational assessments, technology supports, and tutoring to meet individual student needs, it is not intended to replace existing federal/provincial or territorial universal programs,” Gratton said.

author: anred
title: De España a Francia y de Portugal a Italia, pasando por Albania: estalla la juventud europea sin futuro
content:
Foto: Martin Barzilai


En alianza con otros sectores y movimientos de otras edades y trayectorias, una juventud politizada y harta de no tener futuro trae a Europa los ecos de las revoluciones de la Generación Z.

Por Martín Cúneo (@MartinCuneo78), para El Salto Diario.


Desde mayo de 2025 y hasta julio de este año, la llamada Generación Z, jóvenes nacidos cerca del cambio de milenio, impulsaron o se convirtieron en la cara más visible de revueltas que sacudieron la vida política de países tan dispersos y diversos como Bangladesh, Nepal, Indonesia, Marruecos, Madagascar, Perú, Bulgaria, Filipinas, Camerún, Timor Oriental o India.


En

Nepal

,

Madagascar

,

Bangladesh

 y

Bulgaria

 contribuyeron o causaron directamente la caída del Gobierno. En otros casos, las revueltas consiguieron que se retiraran privilegios (

Timor

 o

Indonesia

), conquistaron aumentos nunca vistos en servicios públicos (

Marruecos

) o lograron dimisiones de ministros (

India

).


No fueron solo los jóvenes quienes se movilizaron, pero en todos estos casos se convirtieron en el centro de coaliciones más amplias con otros sectores descontentos para protestar contra la desigualdad, los privilegios, la corrupción, el deterioro del nivel de vida, la pobreza y la crisis económica.


Esta fórmula se está replicando este otoño en muchos países europeos, una región que apenas había sentido los movimientos sísmicos de aquellas revueltas.


Aunque las protestas por la vivienda tuvieron en un inicio un carácter intergeneracional, las acampadas fueron protagonizadas por jóvenes que ya nacieron en el siglo XXI y que miran con recelo su futuro


España, al igual que hace 15 años, se ha convertido en foco de inspiración para otros países con la revuelta por la vivienda iniciada por el Sindicato de Inquilinas tras el desahucio de Maricarmen el pasado 23 de septiembre. Aunque las protestas tuvieron en un inicio un carácter intergeneracional, las acampadas fueron y siguen siendo protagonizadas por jóvenes que nacieron ya en el siglo XXI

, 

que no superan los 25 años y miran con recelo su futuro, su capacidad de independizarse o de construir una vida propia.


El movimiento de vivienda —que va mucho más allá de la Generación Z— ha conseguido establecer alianzas con otros grandes movimientos de los últimos años: la lucha por la

sanidad

 y por la

educación públic

a. Estas causas han confluido en las últimas semanas en movilizaciones históricas con una importante presencia de trabajadores y pensionistas, pero también de una marea de jóvenes nacidos en este siglo, una diversidad que desafía las definiciones simplistas. Las movilizaciones en el marco de la huelga educativa en Madrid, especialmente en la Universidad Complutense han dejado imágenes de encierros, bloqueos, piquetes, manifestaciones, protestas y

una represión policial desatada

.


Las alianzas se han extendido también al mundo del trabajo con la convocatoria de la

huelga general del 11N

 y la creación de centenares de comités para la preparación del paro. Aunque no lo explican todo, tanto en la vivienda como en la educación, la llamada Generación Z y en algunos casos la Generación Alfa —nacidos después de 2010— están jugando un papel determinante con muestras de una juventud mucho más politizada y dispuesta a movilizarse de lo que los estereotipos y los grandes medios apuntaban. Más claro aún es el caso de Francia y la revuelta de los liceos.


Francia


Además de España, el otro 

gran polo de protestas

 en Europa es Francia, donde la respuesta de los estudiantes al paquete de recortes ha vuelto a poner al primer ministro Emmanuel Macron ante una crisis de Gobierno. El movimiento iniciado por los estudiantes de secundaria del norte de París —pertenecientes más bien bien a la Generación Alfa— se extendió a más de mil institutos, llegó a las universidades y prendió en los sindicatos de trabajadores y las asociaciones de padres y madres de alumnos. El martes 6 de octubre, más de medio millón de personas salía a las calles para protestar contra las medidas neoliberales de Macrón.


Le mouvement des lycéens se poursuit et fait naître chaque jour un peu plus une lueur d’espoir pour l’avenir de la France. Merci. https://t.co/XkqQoYJKC7

content:
Dossier


„…

„Als erste Hochschule hat die Ruhr-Universität Bochum einen Einstellungsstopp verhängt, um die im Zuge der Energiekrise massiv steigenden Gas- und Stromkosten auszugleichen. Ein Einstellungsstopp trifft insbesondere befristet beschäftigte Wissenschaftlerinnen und Wissenschaftler. Er führt zu Einschnitten in der Lehre. …“

GEW-Pressemitteilung vom 08.12.2022


, siehe Infos zu Bochum, Darmstadt und Berlin…


Hochschulpolitik: Bund und Länder setzen den Rotstift an – ein Überblick


„… Für 2027 sieht der Regierungsentwurf (

21/7300


) für das Forschungsministerium 21,97 Milliarden Euro vor, rund 3,95 Prozent des Gesamthaushalts. Das ist mehr als 2026, als der Etat bei etwa 21,3 Milliarden Euro lag. Doch ein steigender Haushalt ist noch keine Trendwende. Die Bundesregierung erhöht den Etat, nachdem sie ihn zuvor deutlich zusammengestrichen hat. Gemessen am Gesamthaushalt verliert die Forschung weiter an Gewicht. (…) Gekürzt wurde dabei nicht gleichmäßig. Am stärksten traf es Bildungswesen und Nachwuchsförderung, darunter die Begabtenförderung. Ein Teil des Rückgangs geht allerdings auf das Auslaufen des Digitalpakts Schule zurück. Die Hightech-Agenda blieb dagegen weitgehend unangetastet. Auch der Anteil der Forschung am Gesamthaushalt ist seither gesunken. Das Magazin Forschung & Lehre

berichtete


 schon damals von Einschnitten bei BAföG und DAAD. (…)


Die Studierendenzahlen liefern jedenfalls keine überzeugende Begründung für den Sparkurs. Im Wintersemester 2025/26 stieg ihre Zahl bundesweit um 0,4 Prozent auf 2,88 Millionen. Auch die Zahl der Erstsemester lag über den Prognosen der Kultusministerkonferenz. (…) Die

GEW


 forderte schon im Juli 2025 unter dem Titel „Hochschulbudgets ausbauen – nicht kürzen“ einen Kurswechsel. Ihr Hochschulvorstand Andreas Keller nannte Berlin, Hessen, Nordrhein-Westfalen, Sachsen und Schleswig-Holstein als Länder mit angekündigten Kürzungen und merkte an, dass ausgerechnet in der Exzellenzstrategie erfolgreiche Länder besonders drastisch sparen wollten. (…)


In Nordrhein-Westfalen sinkt die Grundfinanzierung der Hochschulen 2026 um 120 Millionen Euro, rund 2,29 Prozent von über 5 Milliarden. Das Ministerium verweist auf steigende Gesamtausgaben im Hochschulbereich, von 6,13 auf 6,52 Milliarden Euro, und erwartet, dass die Hochschulen Rücklagen einsetzen. Kölns Rektor Joybrato Mukherjee entgegnet, dass die nominell steigenden Budgets die Personalkostensteigerungen nicht ausgleichen. Der SPD-Politiker Bastian Hartmann verteidigt dies auch noch und verweist auf die Sachverständigen im Landtag: Gespart werden könne nur beim Personal, getroffen würden vor allem befristet Beschäftigte. Auch in Hessen zwingt der

Hochschulpakt 2026 bis 2031


 die Hochschulen zum Sparen. Marburg muss bis 2031 insgesamt 141 Millionen Euro einsparen und streicht 100 Dauerstellen. Kassel will auf bis zu 30 Professuren verzichten, die TU Darmstadt schließt ihr Institut für Sportwissenschaft. In Gießen fielen binnen eines halben Jahres mehr als 100 Vollzeitstellen weg, in Frankfurt sind Berufungen und Investitionen gestoppt. Wissenschaftsminister Timon Gremmels (SPD) sieht die Hochschulen dennoch auf dem „richtigen Kurs“. (…)


Gegen diese Entwicklung reicht es nicht, wenn jede Hochschule, jeder Fachbereich und jede Statusgruppe nur die eigenen Ressourcen verteidigt. Eine solche Konkurrenz spielt der Sparpolitik in die Hände. Gefragt ist Solidarität zwischen Studierenden, wissenschaftlichem Nachwuchs, befristet Beschäftigten, Professoren und anderen Hochschulbeschäftigten. Die Verteidigung einzelner Stellen und Fächer muss mit der Forderung nach einer verlässlichen Finanzierung der Hochschulen insgesamt verbunden werden. Dabei geht es nicht allein um Geld. author: Julius Gavroche
title: The Invisible Committee: Becoming Alive, Autonomous, and Explosive
content:
from

Ill Will

, 17/10/2026


The following interview was published on the French website

Frustration

 on October 16, 2026.


Other languages:


Français


Whether it’s a coincidence or a sign of the times, it is in the midst of a youth revolt and on the eve of a possible “return of the Yellow Vests” that the Invisible Committee is releasing its new book,

Survival Manual,

 on October 16. 


For twenty years now, through its many textual interventions (

The Coming Insurrection, To Our Friends, Now…

), it has both inspired, and produced the critical balance sheets of, successive waves of revolt and the situations that followed. With its “survival manual,” the group offers a stringent, unflinching, self-critical perspective — one free of flattery, yet also capable of being generous and honest.


Many of the questions the book raises are also, at times, our own, just as they are, ultimately, those of many people frustrated by defeat and a feeling of powerlessness: How should we make sense of repeated defeats, even despite the persistence of conflictual forms of action? What conclusions are we to draw from this? How are we to “survive” the present moment? How do our enemies continue to prosper? How can we confront capital with seriousness and strategy and truly reinvigorate revolutionary ethics and perspectives? In line with their explicit critique of the public sphere, their public statements remain rare. However, two contributors to the Invisible Committee’s

Survival Manual

 answered our questions about the book, while offering their own analysis of the current moment.


Survival Manual


argues that the Yellow Vests carried out a form of insurrection long awaited by autonomists, yet they did so without them: a movement born out of the encounter between singular, previously-isolated experiences, rather than from any preexisting forms of organization. Are there any similarities with the current youth revolt, or is this just yet another left-wing mobilization destined to be channeled, co-opted, or even sabotaged by unions and political parties?


What is shaking the country right now is not a social movement, it is a vital movement. The world of the “adults” in charge is hurtling headlong toward a wall — it’s even accelerating. It doesn’t care about anything; it wants to keep enjoying itself until the very last drop of oil. Claiming to be “responsible,” “reasonable,” and the custodians of “authority” is the height of their ferocious infantilism. A society of geriatrics can only be youth-obsessed, if not actually young. It wants all the trappings of youth, but detests its vitality. High school students have no reason to feel solidarity with such a civilization of suicidal people. They’ve seen their parents and teachers submit to all the humiliating aberrations of COVID management, then spout vague justifications to lock them down and subject them to the same treatment in turn. So much so that, when they speak up, it’s as if we were hearing the parents of their own parents. “Just because you accept being treated like worthless dogs, getting paid peanuts, unable to afford a full month of groceries doesn’t mean everyone else has to suffer because you didn’t have the guts to speak up — I’m sorry,” a student explodes. The reverse is also true. That infamous Nazi, Henry Ford, used to say, “It is well enough that people of the nation do not understand our banking and monetary system, for if they did, I believe there would be a revolution before tomorrow morning.” If students knew what — with very few exceptions, and all the more precious for it — their teachers say about them in the teachers’ lounge, there’d be few high schools left standing in France. Governing a world with no promise other than that of its own collapse is shaping up to be more complicated than expected. It’s not clear that parental geolocation will suffice.


In an administered society, what we call “youth” is simply the free element, those who are not yet bound by a career, a boss, a loan, or a social circle, and who can therefore afford to say aloud what the rest see but prefer to keep quiet about. We generationalize the revolt in order to prevent it from generalizing. The current revolt of “young people” is primarily over our common condition. What is the point of pursuing a career in a world where temperatures reach 45°C — and therefore of pursuing an education in it? How dare this society treat its untenable contradictions as a “psychological …

title: Los obreros de Fate conquistan el pago de los salarios
content:
El Juzgado Nacional del Trabajo N°17 ordenó pagar los salarios devengados hasta el 30 de junio a los trabajadores en lucha contra el lock out. La confirmación de que el cierre fue un lockout.

Por Prensa Obrera.


El Sutna informó el viernes 16 de octubre que el Juzgado Nacional del Trabajo N°17 ordenó pagar los salarios devengados hasta el 30 de junio a los trabajadores de Fate, que desde hace ocho meses se mantienen firmes en la lucha contra el lock out patronal de Madanes Quintanilla.


En una conferencia de prensa desde la puerta de la planta donde obreros realizan una permanencia para defender sus puestos de trabajo, el secretario general del Sutna, Alejandro Crespo, comunicó que los pagos se harán con los fondos de Fate que la tenacidad de la pelea logró embargar.


Si bien denunció que los montos de los pagos son insuficientes y por eso apelarán, valoró que el fallo le da aire a la lucha por la reapertura productiva de la planta y que es la confirmación judicial de que el cierre fue un lock out patronal y no un despido.


 


Ver esta publicación en Instagram


 


Una publicación compartida por SUTNA (@sutnanacional)


«Si se pagan salarios posteriores al 18 de febrero, cuando la patronal cerró la fábrica y los trabajadores resistieron, es porque violó el compromiso que firmó con el Sutna de no despedir a cambio de recibir beneficios estatales. Si Fate hubiera despedido legítimamente no debería pagar un peso», declaró Crespo.


También destacó que el fallo «es fruto de ocho meses de permanencia y resistencia constante de los trabajadores de Fate dentro de la fábrica, sosteniendo la lucha frente a las intimaciones y el intento de criminalizar el derecho de huelga con la justicia penal. Esa resistencia recibió una enorme respuesta del pueblo argentino y puso a Madanes contra las cuerdas en los tribunales. Sobre esa base el sindicato exigió judicialmente el cumplimiento del acuerdo ante una empresa que declaró que no pagaría y embargó sus cuentas».


Luego agregó que el fallo no incluye a los compañeros que firmaron los mal llamados retiros voluntarios, lo que hicieron bajo la extorsión económica y psicológica de semanas sin cobrar un salario y con la fábrica cerrada. «Vamos a seguir reclamando en todas las instancias la nulidad de esos acuerdos y el pago de los salarios que les corresponden. Nuestro reclamo es y seguirá siendo por la totalidad de los trabajadores que formaban parte de Fate al momento del lock out. Nadie queda afuera». Cuestionó además que los montos fijados por el juzgado no cubren la antigüedad del convenio ni la actualización por inflación, y que van a apelar para corregirlo.


Por último comunicó que desde el Sutna presentarán una nueva acción judicial para seguir cobrando los salarios posteriores al 1 de julio, que se declare el lock out ofensivo y que se reabra la fábrica de neumáticos.

author: infolibre
title: «Μουσείο, Εκπαίδευση και Κοινωνία» του ιστορικού Στάθη Γκότση
content:
Για το βιβλίο του Στάθη Γκότση «Μουσείο, Εκπαίδευση και Κοινωνία» (Εκδόσεις Τόπος)


Την άνοιξη του 2026 κυκλοφόρησε από τις Εκδόσεις Τόπος το βιβλίο «Μουσείο,


Εκπαίδευση και Κοινωνία», μια ανθολογία δημοσιευμένων και αδημοσίευτων κειμένων του


ιστορικού και μουσειοπαιδαγωγού Στάθη Γκότση. Πρόκειται για κείμενα – «τεκμήρια» μιας


πλούσιας, καινοτόμας και κάθε άλλο παρά συμβατικής διαδρομής, στην οποία ο


συγγραφέας έχει συγκεράσει τη μουσειοπαιδαγωγική, την ιστορία και την αρχαιολογία, τη


θεωρία του υλικού πολιτισμού, τη δημόσια αρχαιολογία και την κριτική παιδαγωγική.


Αναμφίβολα, η έκδοση αυτή εμπλουτίζει την ελληνόγλωσση βιβλιογραφία για τη


μουσειακή εκπαίδευση και είναι ιδιαίτερα αισιόδοξο το γεγονός ότι σχεδόν συμπίπτει


χρονικά με ένα άλλο, επίσης, πολύ ενδιαφέρον βιβλίο που αφορά στο ίδιο πεδίο, αυτό της


Ειρήνης Γαβριλάκη «Μουσεία: τόποι (αυτο) αναφοράς και Παιδείας» που κυκλοφόρησε στα


τέλη του 2025.


Συγγραφέας: Στάθης Γκότσης, ιστορικός

Εκδότης: Εκδόσεις Τόπος

Έτος έκδοσης: Απρίλιος 2026

Έκταση: 312 σελίδες

ISBN: 978-960-499-609-4

Πρόλογος: Δημήτρης Πλάντζος

Επίλογος: Αμαλία Τσιτούρη


Γνωρίζοντας τον Στάθη Γκότση για πάνω από 25 χρόνια, η έκδοση αυτή υπήρξε για μένα μια


ιδανική ευκαιρία να επαναεπισκεπτώ κάποια από τα παλαιότερα δημοσιευμένα κείμενά


του και να προσπελάσω για πρώτη φορά κάποια νεότερα ή αδημοσίευτα. Το σημαντικό σε


αυτό το βιβλίο είναι ότι μέσα από τα κεφάλαια του αποκρυσταλλώνονται και


τεκμηριώνονται σημαντικές όψεις της ιστορίας της μουσειακής εκπαίδευσης στην Ελλάδα,


είτε αυτή θεωρήσουμε ότι ξεκινά το 1978 όπως συμβατικά προτείνεται λόγω της πρώτης


απόπειρας για εκπαιδευτικές δράσεις στα λαογραφικά μουσεία είτε το 1985 με την ίδρυση


του Κέντρου Εκπαιδευτικών Προγραμμάτων (ΚΕΠ) από το ΥΠ.ΠΟ., εκδοχή την οποία και


προτιμώ. Ο Στάθης Γκότσης είναι σχεδόν από τα πρώτα χρόνια εκεί, από το 1991, αρχικά


στο ΚΕΠ όπου συμμετέχει στο σχεδιασμό και την υλοποίηση πληθώρας καινοτόμων


δράσεων σε μουσεία, μνημεία και χώρους πολιτισμικής αναφοράς και ιστορικής σημασίας


(όπως το Γκάζι) και μετά στο Βυζαντινό & Χριστιανικό Μουσείο, στο οποίο –σε συνεργασία


με τον Π. Βοσνίδη– σχεδιάζει εκπαιδευτικά προγράμματα και άλλες δράσεις, αρχικά για


σχολικές ομάδες για να επεκταθεί σταδιακά και σε άλλες ομάδες κοινού με αδυναμία


πρόσβασης, φυσικής, νοητικής, σωματικής, ηλικιακής ή και για κοινωνικά και πολιτιστικά


αποκλεισμένους όπως οι Ρομά, οι ψυχικά ασθενείς, οι φυλακισμένοι. Πρόκειται για


καινοτόμες εκπαιδευτικές απόπειρες που ερείδονται σε στέρεες θεωρητικές βάσεις και με


σαφείς ιδεολογικές αφετηρίες.


Αυτές οι καινοτόμες πρωτοβουλίες, πολλές από τις οποίες παρουσιάζονται και


τεκμηριώνονται σε κεφάλαια του βιβλίου του, είχα τη χαρά, προσωπικά, να τις ακούω από


πρώτο χέρι, γιατί ο Στάθης Γκότσης στήριξε συστηματικά με τη διδασκαλία του έως το 2022


το Πρόγραμμα Μεταπτυχιακών Σπουδών «Μουσειολογία – Διαχείριση Πολιτισμού», μια


σύμπραξη των Τμημάτων Αρχιτεκτονικής, Μηχανολόγων Μηχανικών, ΤΕΠΑΕ (Τμήμα


Επιστημών Προσχολικής Αγωγής και Εκπαίδευσης) του ΑΠΘ με το ΠΤΔΕ Φλώρινας, ΠΔΜ.


Συγκεκριμένα, στην ενότητα «Μουσειοπαιδαγωγική», την οποία συντονίζαμε με τον


Ανδρέα Ανδρέου και την Νινέττα Παπαντωνίου, ο Στάθης Γκότσης με τον ζωντανό και


καθηλωτικό του λόγο παρουσίαζε, με αφορμή την εμπειρία του στο ΚΕΠ και τη


συγκροτημένη εκπαιδευτική πολιτική του Βυζαντινού Μουσείου, πολλές από τις δράσεις


που αφορούσαν τις τυπικές σχολικές ομάδες όσο και τις ειδικές ομάδες κοινού,


εκπαιδεύοντας με αυτόν τον τρόπο πάνω από 250 μουσειολόγους που πολλοί και πολλές


σήμερα στελεχώνουν τα μουσεία της χώρας.


Ουσιαστικά η πλούσια μουσειοπαιδαγωγική εμπειρία του Στάθη Γκότση –μέρος της οποίας


μπορεί κανείς να διαπιστώσει μέσα από τη θεωρητική τεκμηρίωση και τη περιγραφή των


ποικίλλων εκπαιδευτικών δράσεων στο βιβλίο του– μας φέρνει στον νου τον πρόσφατο


ορισμό του ICOM για το θεσμό του Μουσείου, προϊόν μεγάλης διαβούλευσης ώστε να


αντικατασταθεί ο προηγούμενος και πολύ γνωστός της δεκαετίας του 1970 με μια


οριοθέτηση που θα αποκρυσταλλώνει τις σύγχρονες συνθήκες για τον κοινωνικό, πολιτικό


και πολιτιστικό ρόλο του μουσείου. Σύμφωνα με αυτόν «Το μουσείο είναι ένας μόνιμος, μη


κερδοσκοπικός οργανισμός, στην υπηρεσία της κοινωνίας, ο οποίος ερευνά, συλλέγει,


συντηρεί, ερμηνεύει και εκθέτει τεκμήρια υλικής και άυλης κληρονομιάς. Ανοικτά και


προσβάσιμα στο κοινό, χωρίς αποκλεισμούς, τα μουσεία προάγουν την ποικιλομορφία και


την αειφορία …
